text.title: 死亡与诅咒
text.objectives: 赶到达拉然，然后搭乘泽奥姆斯前往破碎海滩。抵达之后进入恶魔之门，寻找斯利文男爵并取得诅咒之喉。
text.description: <你的脑海里又感应到一股强大的意识。>$b$b裂肉者高瑞里克斯是一个可怕的恶魔。他已经屠戮了数千个世界，并用一把名为诅咒之喉的斧子灭绝了无数个种族。$b$b黑锋骑士团派出了一支队伍去消灭他，但是他们现在下落不明。你必须完成他们的任务。$b$b这次我不会让你单独行动，我派出了斯利文男爵来协助你。$b$b去吧，务必消灭高瑞里克斯并取得诅咒之喉。

english.title: The Dead and the Damned
english.objectives: Travel to Dalaran and fly upon Zeomus to Darkstone Isle. While there, travel through the Demon Portal, find Baron Sliver, and obtain the Maw of the Damned.
english.description: <A powerful mind again touches your thoughts.>$b$bGorelix the Fleshripper is a monstrous demon. The butcher of a thousand worlds, he has exterminated countless races with his axe, the Maw of the Damned.$b$bA group of Ebon Blade was dispatched to slay him but they have gone missing. You will succeed where they failed.$b$bYou will not be alone in this, I've sent Baron Sliver ahead to assist you.$b$bGo, obtain the Maw of the Damned and ensure that Gorelix is no more.

enders.name: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼
大领主达里安·莫格莱尼

objectiveDetails.description: 可选：搭乘泽奥姆斯前往破碎海滩

text.title: 古老的配方
text.objectives: 收集6个鹰身人利爪。
text.description: 苏拉玛是……曾经是……智慧种族的理想城市。$b$b我们在那里钻研所有的事物，从炼金术、艺术……到魔法的性质。我们当时怎么会愚蠢地接受他们进入城市呢？$b$b瞧我又在这想入非非了，还有许多事情要做呢。我需要一些非常难搞的材料，$r。不如你帮我去找找？$b$b我需要一些鹰身人利爪。把它们碾成粉末以后可以做成强效试剂。

english.title: An Ancient Recipe
english.objectives: Collect 6 Harpy Talons.
english.description: Suramar is... was... an intellectual's dream.$b$bWe studied everything in there, from alchemy and the arts to the very nature of magic itself. How could we be so foolish as to accept them in?$b$bLook at me, lost in the clouds again when there is much to be done. My work requires some fairly difficult ingredients, $r. Perhaps you would help me procure them?$b$bI am going to need some harpy talons. Crushed into a powder, they will be a potent reagent.

text.title: 换班
text.objectives: 躲在篮子里，等待守卫出现。跟随守卫到达他们的目的地。
text.description:
这是个救出维伦妮的女儿的好机会。

我们的计划是这样的。

你得在这里等换班的守卫经过。找个地方躲起来。

<希尔格林在你的地图上做了一个标记。>

守卫都穿着亮红色的护甲，你一眼就能认出来。

跟紧点，不过也不要太接近，否则你会被发现的。如果你想抵达目的地，你可能就必须杀死守卫。

这孩子的名字叫做康妮。祝你好运。

english.title: Shift Change
english.objectives: Hide in the basket and wait for the guard to appear. Follow the guard to their destination.
english.description:
This is as good a chance as we are going to get to rescue Verene's daughter.

Here is how this is going to work. 

You are going to wait here for the guard to pass by on their way to their guard shift. Look for something to hide in.

<Silgryn marks a spot on your map.>

You will know the guard by their bright red armor.

Follow closely, but not so closely that you are seen. It may be necessary to kill the guard when you reach your destination.

The child's name is Korine. Good luck.

text.title: 人民之一
text.objectives: 在苏拉玛城与凡瑟尔会面。
text.description:
是时候让你进入城中心区域了，$n。我要送你去见我忠诚的朋友凡瑟尔。我真心希望你还记得他——我保证他还记得你。

我没法陪你一起去，但我必须强调一下，我给你的这套伪装并非万无一失。走路小心一点，避开那些一直盯着你看的人。

我们暂且一别。

english.title: One of the People
english.objectives: Meet with Vanthir in Suramar City.
english.description:
It is time for you to enter the city proper, $n.

I am sending you to my loyal friend Vanthir. I do hope you remember him- I can guarantee that he remembers you.

I will not be able to accompany you, but I must stress that the disguise I have granted you is not impervious. Tread carefully, and avoid those who stare too long.

Farewell for now.

text.title: 精妙的传送艺术
text.objectives: 在欧库勒斯的工作室收集歪斜的传送道标和破损的跃迁套筒。
text.description:
我在逃离宫殿的时候来不及收拾工具，所以我来这里回收一些器材。

这座工作室其实是由传送板连接的几个房间组成的。

艾利桑德的手下正在这里搜查我的下落，不过我可以在这里调整传送网络，让他们一直兜圈子。

你走进去，我会追踪你的位置，确保传送装置为你提供正常的功能。

找到这两种零件，把它们带回来！

english.title: The Delicate Art of Telemancy
english.objectives: Collect the Weathered Telemancy Beacon and Cracked Warpsleeve from Oculeth's Workshop.
english.description:
I hadn't the time to gather my instruments before fleeing the palace. I came here to salvage some equipment.

This old workshop is actually several rooms connected by teleporter pads.

Elisande's goons are already scouring the place looking for me, but from here I can alter the teleporter network and keep them moving in circles.

You go in. I'll monitor your position and ensure the teleporters work normally for you.

Find these two parts and bring them back!

objectiveDetails.description: 在欧库勒斯的工作室使用传送装置

text.title: 网络安全
text.objectives: 在欧库勒斯的测试间完成封锁程序。
text.description:
我们必须封锁设施，否则宫里来的“尊贵”同事可能会发现我的秘密。这样的话，我为你和塔莉萨建造的传送装置就有危险了。

<欧库勒斯身旁原本待机的协调设备发出嗡鸣并运转起来。>

它会带我们前往我在山底的秘密测试间。我们可以在那里启动封锁程序然后逃出去！

english.title: Network Security
english.objectives: Complete the lockdown sequence in Oculeth's Test Chamber.
english.description:
We must lock down the facility. Otherwise my esteemed colleagues from the palace could uncover my secrets, which puts any teleporters I build for you and Thalyssra at risk.

<The inactive attunement device near Oculeth hums to life.>

This will take us to my secret test chamber beneath the mountain. From there we can begin the lockdown sequence and make our escape!

text.title: A Token of Remembrance
text.objectives: Place 4 Bouquets of Moon Lilies.
text.description: The flower rests peacefully in your hand, glowing softly.$b$bWhile it doesn't appear to be growing anywhere nearby, there are small bouquets of the flower on some of the memorials around here.$b$bPerhaps laying down some flowers on the remaining graves will ease the gloom.

english.objectives: Place 4 Bouquets of Moon Lilies.
english.description: The flower rests peacefully in your hand, glowing softly.$b$bWhile it doesn't appear to be growing anywhere nearby, there are small bouquets of the flower on some of the memorials around here.$b$bPerhaps laying down some flowers on the remaining graves will ease the gloom.

text.title: 埋入书堆
text.objectives: 与卡德加一起进入卡拉赞并寻找有关创世之柱的知识。
text.description: 麦格尼的信息对我有很大启发。有个具有泰坦之耳的朋友会很方便。$b$b是时候去卡拉赞了。不要嫌我啰嗦，那地方真的十分危险。有无数层法术在高塔内外纵横交错，而各种力量之间的相互作用带来的结果可能……难以预测。提高警惕。$b$b我会在里面和你会合。我需要一些时间来……整理一下思绪。这地方承载着我的很多回忆。
text.completion: Not long after you left, the first wave of demons struck. We're holding them at bay... for now.$b$bI'll keep this tome safe until we have a chance to study it.$b$bGood work in there. I should like to delve into the libraries of Karazhan myself one day. At least... I think I would.
text.completed: 把书籍带给卡拉赞上空达拉然的大法师茉德拉。

english.title: Hiding in the Stacks
english.objectives: Enter Karazhan and search for knowledge of the Pillars of Creation with Khadgar.
english.description: Magni's information was enlightening. It should prove handy to have a friend who has the ear of a titan.$b$bIt's time to head into Karazhan. Not that I need to remind you, but it can be a dangerous place. There are countless strata of spells woven throughout the tower, and the interactions of the forces within can be... unpredictable. Be on your guard.$b$bI'll join you inside. I need a moment to... gather my thoughts. This place holds a lot of memories for me.
english.completion: Not long after you left, the first wave of demons struck. We're holding them at bay... for now.$b$bI'll keep this tome safe until we have a chance to study it.$b$bGood work in there. I should like to delve into the libraries of Karazhan myself one day. At least... I think I would.
english.completed: Take the Tome to Archmage Modera in Dalaran above Karazhan

objectiveDetails.description: 寻找关于创世之柱的知识

text.title: 使者
text.objectives: 与食魂者阿莱利谈一谈。
text.description: 好像嫌局面不够乱似的，不速之客……伊利达雷出现了。$b$b自从他们的主人在黑暗神殿中陨落之后，这些恶魔猎手便一直被囚禁着。守望者竟然将他们释放出来，这只能说明如今的危机已不容小觑。$b$b他们的使节领袖“食魂者”阿莱利声称，奥格瑞玛正面临着隐藏的威胁。我让他们在城内搭建起了一个营地……这只是暂时性的做法。$B$B你马上去和她对话。查明这种威胁是否可信。

english.title: Emissary
english.objectives: Speak with Allari the Souleater.
english.description: As if things weren't unsettled enough, guests have arrived... the Illidari.$b$bThese demon hunters have been imprisoned since their master's fall at the Black Temple. For the Wardens to release them can only mean the peril is dire indeed.$b$bTheir delegation's leader, Allari "the Souleater," claims Orgimmar faces a hidden threat. I gave them leave to establish a camp within the city... for now.$B$BYou will speak with her at once. Find out whether this threat is credible.

text.title: 奥罗纳尔的低语
text.objectives: 调查奥罗纳尔废墟。
text.description: 虚灵、虚空、黑暗纳鲁……我感觉它们之间有联系。$b$b在你和维伦寻找执政团之冠的时候，我探索了下方的废墟。那里还有幸存者，$n。$b$b破碎者们在我们西边的建筑群附近徘徊——我听不太懂他们的话，但我怀疑他们已经不清醒了。$b$b如果虚空是罪魁祸首的话，我们需要从那里着手调查。$b$b与此同时，我也会自己进行搜索。

english.title: Whispers from Oronaar
english.objectives: Investigate the Ruins of Oronaar.
english.description: Ethereals, the Void, a Dark Naaru... I feel they are all connected.$b$bI explored the ruins below while you and Velen were seeking the Crown. There are survivors, $n.$b$bBroken wander the cluster of buildings to our west- I cannot understand much of what they say but I suspect that their minds are not their own.$b$bIf the Void is to blame, we will need to start our investigation there.$b$bI will conduct my own search in the meantime.

text.title: 堕落的下场
text.objectives: 把指挥官多米蒂勒的头盔交给洛休斯·唤月。
text.description:
指挥官多米蒂勒最能代表夜之子的堕落本质。排斥他人的力量，对他们的大魔导师肝脑涂地，并且一心想要毁掉月之守卫。

把她的头盔交给洛休斯，作为她死亡的证据。

english.title: Zealot's Dues
english.objectives: Take Commander Domitille's Helm to Lothrius Mooncaller.
english.description:
Commander Domitille represents the very essence of the Nightborne's corruption. Abhorrent of power not their own, enamoured with their Grand Magistrix to the point of zealotry, and focused utterly on the destruction of the Moon Guard.

Take her helm to Lothrius as proof of her demise.

text.title: Casual Redistribution
text.objectives: Collect 20 Bottles of Arcwine.
text.description:
Lately there have been a disturbing array of changes involving our most precious resource, Arcwine. 

I imagine Thalyssra has thoroughly educated you about what happens when a Nightborne does not have access to a source of power like Arcwine.

With the presence of the demons came rationing. There are many who do not have enough to sustain themselves.

Bring me as much Arcwine as you can carry. I will see that it gets to the right people.

english.objectives: Collect 20 Bottles of Arcwine.

I imagine Thalyssra has thoroughly educated you about what happens when a Nightborne does not have access to a source of power like Arcwine.

With the presence of the demons came rationing. There are many who do not have enough to sustain themselves.

Bring me as much Arcwine as you can carry. I will see that it gets to the right people.

text.title: Tracking Quest - W1 - Intro to Illidari Complete

english.title: Tracking Quest - W1 - Intro to Illidari Complete

text.title: Kazok'thul
text.objectives: Find and slay Kazok'thul in Azurewing Repose.
text.description: A rogue felhunter known as Kazok'thul has been terrorizing Azurewing Repose in Azsuna.$b$bFelhunters feed on arcane energy and it seems that Kazok'thul has been gorging itself on the mana from nearby Azurewing whelps.$b$bTravel to Azurewing Repose and speak with Ardonu to find the last known location of Kazok'thul.$b$bSlay the demon and return here when your mission is complete.

english.title: Kazok'thul
english.objectives: Find and slay Kazok'thul in Azurewing Repose.
english.description: A rogue felhunter known as Kazok'thul has been terrorizing Azurewing Repose in Azsuna.$b$bFelhunters feed on arcane energy and it seems that Kazok'thul has been gorging itself on the mana from nearby Azurewing whelps.$b$bTravel to Azurewing Repose and speak with Ardonu to find the last known location of Kazok'thul.$b$bSlay the demon and return here when your mission is complete.

text.title: 月神镰刀
text.objectives: 前往暮色森林，在黎明森林和瓦洛恩·静枝会面。
text.description:
我收到消息，泰兰德亲自下令解禁月神镰刀，这把强大的神器将让我们在对抗燃烧军团时如虎添翼。镰刀本为瓦洛恩·静枝调查暮色森林的狼人诅咒所用，现在他已经同意交出武器。

勇士，我相信你可以发挥神器的威力，而不会受到它的兽性狂怒所支配。你必须前往暮色森林取得镰刀，用它来对付我们的敌人！

english.title: The Scythe of Elune
english.objectives: Meet with Valorn Stillbough in the Twilight Grove in Duskwood.
english.description:
I have received word that Tyrande herself has authorized the release of a great artifact, the Scythe of Elune, to aid our cause. Valorn Stillbough has agreed to give up the weapon, which he has kept as part of an investigation into the cursed worgen of Duskwood.

I believe that you, champion, will be our best hope at wielding its power without succumbing to the animal rage that ebbs within. You must go to Duskwood, and take up the scythe against our foes!

objectiveDetails.description: （可选）：穿越梦境之路前往暮色森林

text.title: 适得其所
text.objectives: 从瓦洛恩手里接过月神镰刀。
text.description:
虽然我不大赞同，但是泰兰德希望再次解放月神镰刀，以对付燃烧军团的威胁。把它交给你这位致力于守护平衡的英雄，我也比较放心一些。

要知道，镰刀上一次带来了巨大的灾难。你必须时刻警醒，控制它有所蕴含的兽性狂怒。

将这些话铭记于心，用这把镰刀铲除敌人。愿艾露恩之光保护你。

english.title: Its Rightful Place
english.objectives: Take the Scythe of Elune from Valorn.
english.description:
Though it goes against my better judgment, it is Tyrande's wish that the Scythe of Elune be brandished once more against the new Legion threat. It is a small comfort to see it wielded by a keeper of the balance, such as yourself.

Know that the last time the scythe was wielded, it resulted in great calamity. You must be vigilant to contain the bestial wrath that ebbs within. 

With those words in your heart, take the scythe and bring its fury against our foes. May the light of Elune protect you.

text.title: 黑暗的敌人
text.objectives: 在暮色森林的密斯特曼托庄园开始搜寻月神镰刀的下落。
text.description:
我不相信黑暗骑士能找到我们这里。他们找寻镰刀很久了，他们对艾泽拉斯神器的迷恋程度昭然若揭。我们以为林地可以保护我们……

现在，瓦洛恩不在了……

你必须追查下去，$n。找到黑暗骑士并取回镰刀。我们上次在暮色森林的密斯特曼托庄园遇到过他们。你可以从那里着手。

还有，$n……为瓦洛恩报仇。黑暗骑士必须付出代价。

english.title: A Foe of the Dark
english.objectives: Start your search for the Scythe of Elune at Manor Mistmantle in Duskwood.
english.description:
I cannot believe the Dark Riders found us here. Long have they hunted the scythe to sate their lust for the artifacts of Azeroth. We thought we would be protected within the grove...

And now, Valorn is gone...

You must become the hunter, $n. Seek the Dark Riders and recover the scythe. We last encountered them near Manor Mistmantle in Duskwood. Start your search there.

And $n... bring justice to Valorn. The rider must pay.

objectiveDetails.description: 在暮色森林调查密斯特曼托庄园

text.title: 阴燃的余烬
text.objectives: 把阴燃的时空扭曲余烬交给奥格瑞玛的琪雅科。
text.description: 你刚摸到这块余烬时，它还是冷的。接着，它又毫无征兆地迸发出火星，然后又迅速熄灭。当这块石头躺在你手中时，你的脑海中就浮现出烈焰与巨龙共舞的场面，但你又能听见在奥格瑞玛的说话声。最后，则浮现出了熟悉的圆形传送门。

english.title: The Smoldering Ember
english.objectives: Bring the Smoldering Timewarped Ember to Kiatke in Orgrimmar.
english.description: Cold to the touch when you first reach for it, this ember bursts into flame without warning and snuffs itself just as quickly. As the stone rests in your hand, visions of fire and of dragons dance through your mind, but you can hear conversation taking place in Orgrimmar and the familiar sight of circle portals bubbles to the top.

text.title: 阴燃的余烬
text.objectives: 把阴燃的时空扭曲余烬交给暴风城的琪雅科。
text.description: 你刚摸到这块余烬时，它还是冷的。接着，它又毫无征兆地迸发出火星，然后又迅速熄灭。当这块石头躺在你手中时，你的脑海中就浮现出烈焰与巨龙共舞的场面，但你又能听见在暴风城的说话声。最后，则浮现出了熟悉的圆形传送门。

english.title: The Smoldering Ember
english.objectives: Bring the Smoldering Timewarped Ember to Kiatke in Stormwind.
english.description: Cold to the touch when you first reach for it, this ember bursts into flame without warning and snuffs itself just as quickly. As the stone rests in your hand, visions of fire and of dragons dance through your mind, but you can hear the hustle and bustle of Stormwind and the familiar sight of circle portals bubbles to the top.

text.title: 崩裂的时光之路
text.objectives: 完成5个时空漫游地下城。
text.description: 毁灭者之星透射出光芒，照耀着大地，就连灵魂也退避到阴影之中。这颗星星与天空中其他的星星完全不同，它可以揭示人们的弱点，哪怕是最勇敢的英雄也不例外。在它的影响持续期间，新的道路将被打开，通往遥远的空间与时间。没有哪位贤者真正了解这一预兆的涵义，但英勇的行为总会得到幸运的眷顾。

english.title: A Shattered Path Through Time
english.objectives: Complete 5 Timewalking dungeons.
english.description: The Destroyer's star shines upon the land with its piercing light as even the spirits retreat to the shadows. This star is unlike any other in the skies, laying bare the weaknesses of even the boldest heroes. While its influence holds, new paths may open up, to distant places and even distant times. No sage truly understands the nature of this sign, but fortune favors the daring.

text.title: 未雨绸缪
text.objectives: 与许大师谈一谈。
text.description: 你的武器现在无比强大，该是发挥它的威力，主动向燃烧军团出击的时候了。$b$b许大师已经在训练场旁边设置了一个指挥台，并且从艾泽拉斯各地的盟军和战友那里收集到一些情报。$b$b等你准备好就去找他，大宗师，他会向你汇报最新的战况。

english.title: A Matter of Planning
english.objectives: Speak to Master Hsu.
english.description: Your weapon is stronger than ever, now is the perfect time to put it to use and take our fight to the Legion.$b$bMaster Hsu has set up a command table by the training grounds, and has collected reports from our friends and allies around all of Azeroth.$b$bWhen you are ready, Grandmaster, he should have an update prepared for you.

text.title: 女王的复仇号的命运
text.objectives: 前往达拉然，把船长日志交给灰牙之地的苏提斯中尉。
text.description: <这种消息应该汇报上去。或许在达拉然的灰牙之地会有人知道该怎么处理。>
text.completion:
<The officer looks down at what you're offering him and his eyes light up.>

Do you know what you have here? You might have just delivered some of the most significant intel of the campaign.

I will see to it personally that this gets into Lord Greymane's hands.

english.title: Fate of the Queen's Reprisal
english.objectives: Take the Captain's Log to Lieutenant Surtees at the Greyfang Enclave on Dalaran.
english.description: <This is the kind of intelligence that should be shared. Perhaps someone at the Greyfang Enclave on Dalaran will know what to do with it.>
english.completion:
<The officer looks down at what you're offering him and his eyes light up.>

Do you know what you have here? You might have just delivered some of the most significant intel of the campaign.

I will see to it personally that this gets into Lord Greymane's hands.

text.title: 战斗开始
text.objectives: 选择你在破碎群岛的首个攻击目标。
text.description: 燃烧军团在整个艾泽拉斯留下了毁灭的痕迹。如果我们想结束这场战争，就必须攻打他们位于破碎群岛的基地。$b$b我准备了一份群岛的地图，以及我们需要在那里完成的一系列任务。$b$b等你有机会仔细查看地图之后，需要选出我们发起首次攻击的地点。

english.title: The Fight Begins
english.objectives: Select your first assault point on the Broken Isles.
english.description: The Burning Legion has left a trail of ruin all across the face of Azeroth. We must strike at their bases within the Broken Isles if we are to have any hope of ending this war.$b$bI've put together a map of the isles and a list of tasks that we will need to have done there.$b$bOnce you've had a chance to peruse the map, you should choose where we will begin our assault.

text.title: 徘徊在边缘
text.objectives: 将100份远古魔力交给阿布索隆。
text.description:
我曾犯下……错误……

<阿布索隆粗哑地喘着气。>

我要纠正错误……我要活下去！但这种疯狂……这种凋零……

我正在……衰败。

<阿布索隆无助地看着你。>

english.title: Lingering on the Edge
english.objectives: Give Absolon 100 Ancient Mana.
english.description:
I h-have made... mistakes...

<Absolon draws in a rasping breath.>

I want to make it right... I want to live! But the madness... the WITHERING..

I am... fading.

<Absolon stares at you helplessly.>

text.title: 紧握希望
text.objectives: 将一封信交给阿布索隆的妻子诺瑞莎
text.description:
你的善良激励了我，朋友。

我以为自己会永远游荡在空壳一般的枯法者之间，但是塔莉萨邀请了我。

我选择和我的同胞一起留在这里，我们会一起夺回苏拉玛。

现在，我只有一个请求。

把这封信交给我的妻子。主要是想让她知道我还活着。

让她像我一样从你身上看到希望。

english.title: Cling to Hope
english.objectives: Deliver a letter to Absolon's Wife, Noressa.
english.description:
Your kindness has inspired me, friend.

I thought I would wander forever among the empty husks of the Withered, but Thalyssra invited me in.

I have chosen to remain here with my people and together we will take back Suramar.

For now I have but one request.

Take this letter to my wife. She should know that I still live, among other things.

Give her the hope that you gave me.

text.title: 生存下去的必要力量
text.objectives: 选择追求哪件神器。
text.description: 长久以来，我们一直依赖伊利丹大人消灭燃烧军团最厉害的战士，许多人担心没有他以后我们可以贡献多少力量。$B$B不过，以后不会再有这些顾虑了。$B$B据说有两副比伊利丹大人的兵刃还要强大的武器，而且它们并非遥不可及。$B$B如果我们动作够快，就可以取得其中的一副，并且不会耽误我们监视燃烧军团的活动。$B$B至于哪一副武器更值得我们去争取，就由你来决定，$n。

english.title: The Power to Survive
english.objectives: Select an artifact weapon to pursue.
english.description: We have long relied on Lord Illidan to vanquish the Legion's strongest warriors - many have expressed concern over our efforts without him.$B$BThankfully, their concerns may not matter much longer.$B$BWe know of two pairs of blades rumored to be more powerful than even Lord Illidan's that are not yet out of reach.$B$BIf we act quickly we should be able to hunt down one without forsaking our watch over the Legion's movements.$B$BI must defer judgment on which is most worthy of our time to you, $n.

text.title: 从内部瓦解
text.objectives: 在法罗纳尔的征服岗哨寻找考瓦斯·血棘。
text.description:
我们的恶魔猎手考瓦斯·血棘和赛娅娜·夜刃已经带着一小支伊利达雷部队前往法罗纳尔。他们的任务是从内部削弱燃烧军团。

我有一阵子没收到他们的消息了。

如果你能去找到他们，并且带领他们完成任务，那就再好不过了。你愿意吗？

english.title: From Within
english.objectives: Find Kor'vas Bloodthorn on Faronaar at Vanquish Point.
english.description:
Our demon hunters, Kor'vas Bloodthorn and Cyana Nightglaive took a small force of the Illidari across to Faronaar. Their mission was to weaken the Legion from within.

I haven't heard from them in a while.

It would be best if you could find and lead them to success. Agreed?

text.title: 生存下去的必要力量
text.objectives: 选择追求哪件神器。
text.description: 我跟伊利丹虽然不合，但是他的确非常强大。多亏了他，我们才能消灭燃烧军团最厉害的爪牙。$B$B不过，这已经不重要了。$B$B据说有两副比伊利丹的兵刃还要强大的武器，我们或许可以拿到它们。$B$B只可惜，我们的人手非常有限，没有办法同时追求这两副武器，毕竟我们还要继续监视燃烧军团的活动。我担心大好机会稍纵即逝。$B$B身为一名杰出的伊利达雷，你必须做出选择。

english.title: The Power to Survive
english.objectives: Select an artifact weapon to pursue.
english.description: Illidan and I may have disagreed, but he was unarguably powerful. He was pivotal in vanquishing some of the Legion's most powerful soldiers.$B$BHowever, that may not matter much longer.$B$BThere are two pairs of blades rumored to be more powerful than even Illidan's that may still be within reach.$B$BRegrettably, our numbers are too few to hunt both while maintaining our vigil over the Legion. I fear our window of opportunity is waning quickly.$B$BAs the ranking Illidari, that decision falls to you.

text.title: 事务安排
text.objectives: 在紫罗兰监狱外面与凯恩·日怒见面。
text.description: 你还记得瓦雷迪斯吗，$n？他曾是我们的首席训练师，多年前跟着黑暗神殿一起覆灭。$B$B……至少我们以前是这么以为的。$B$B考瓦斯看到那个叛徒跟燃烧军团搅和在一起……他手里的战刃灌注了一种考瓦斯从未见过的力量。$B$B肯瑞托在紫罗兰监狱里囚禁了一个艾瑞达首领，他应该知道瓦雷迪斯的堡垒在哪里。典狱官答应会考虑让我们探视那个恶魔。$B$B是时候去说服他了。

english.title: Making Arrangements
english.objectives: Meet Kayn Sunfury outside the Violet Hold.
english.description: Do you recall Varedis, $n? He was once our lead trainer, but fell with the Black Temple years ago.$B$B...or so we thought.$B$BKor'vas spotted the traitor alongside the Legion... wielding glaives imbued with power unlike anything she'd ever seen.$B$BThe Kirin Tor have an eredar lord locked away in the Violet Hold that will know where Varedis' stronghold lies. The prison warden has agreed to consider granting us access to the fiend.$B$BTime to do some convincing.

text.title: 势不可挡
text.objectives: 使用魔血祭坛解锁你的第一个神器专长。
text.description:
贾格诺斯的仆从现在由你指挥，大领主，不过这里还有更多的力量！

你可以在大领主之座找到一个特别的祭坛。它由深渊领主的血液铸成，因此祭坛充满了他的力量，而这股力量可以转移到你的新武器之中。

到祭坛去，大领主，将贾格诺斯的力量占为己有！

english.title: Power Overwhelming
english.objectives: Use the Felblood Altar to unlock your first Artifact Trait.
english.description:
Jagganoth's minions are now yours to command, Overlord, but there is more power to this place than just that!

Here, at the Seat of the Overlord, you will find a special altar, formed of the pit lord's blood and charged with his power. This power can be transferred to your new weapon.

Approach the altar, Overlord, and claim Jagganoth's power for your own!

text.title: 重建议会
text.objectives: 在恐痕裂隙拯救雷特森·焰怒。
text.description:
看来朋友引起了孟菲斯托斯的注意。这真是一个坏消息，恐惧魔王肯定想为他失去的手下大将报仇。

朋友不仅需要恐痕的力量来对付他，而且你还需要那些被俘虏的强大术士的帮助。

卡里杜斯认为那个兽人还在曾经束缚你的深渊里面。朋友必须把他救出来，然后重建议会！

english.title: Rebuilding the Council
english.objectives: Resurrect Ritssyn Flamescowl in Dreadscar Rift.
english.description:
It seems that friend has caught the attention of Mephistroth. This is very bad news, as the dreadlord will surely wish to seek revenge for losing his general.

Friend will need more than the Dreadscar to stand against him, you will need powerful warlocks such as those who were captured.

Calydus thinks the orc still lies in the pit where you were chained. Friend must revive him, and rebuild the council!

text.title: 恐痕的道路
text.objectives: 使用恐痕作战计划选择你的首个行动地点。
text.description:
看得出来，你在议会失败的地方获得了巨大的成功。这些恐痕应该可以成为强大的盟友，但是光靠他们的力量还不够。

现在，我们必须进行重建。我会派出人手，寻找被俘虏的议会成员的下落，同时也会寻找其他有能力为我们提供帮助的术士。

到占卜之池来找我，然后我们在那里制定行动计划。

english.title: The Path of the Dreadscar
english.objectives: Use the Dreadscar Battle Plans to choose your first zone.
english.description:
It would seem that where the council has failed, you have found untold success. These Dreadscar should prove powerful allies, but they may not be enough.

For now, we must look to rebuild. I will send agents out to locate the whereabouts of the captured council members, as well as any other warlocks who may be able to aid the cause.

Meet me at the scrying pool, and we will plan our action from there.

text.title: 近在咫尺
text.objectives: 带首席传送师欧库勒斯去见沙尔艾兰的塔莉萨。
text.description:
<欧库勒斯眼神涣散，声音也颤抖起来。>

我们……快到了吗？

我好饿……

english.title: Close Enough
english.objectives: Carry Chief Telemancer Oculeth to Thalyssra in Shal'Aran.
english.description:
<Oculeth's eyes have dulled. His voice trembles.>

Are we... are we close?

So hungry...

objectiveDetails.description: 把欧库勒斯带到塔莉萨附近
带欧库勒斯进入沙尔艾兰

text.title: 无冕者的召唤
text.objectives: 查看密封的信函，并听从里面的指示。
text.description: 我的上级对我下达了严格的指令，务必把这封信尽快送到你手里。$B$B信件的内容只有你可以看。$B$B祝你好运。

english.title: Call of The Uncrowned
english.objectives: Read the Sealed Letter and follow the instructions within.
english.description: My masters gave me strict instructions to deliver this letter to you as quickly as possible.$B$BIts contents are for you and you alone.$B$BGood luck.

objectiveDetails.description: 对“红发”杰克·芬德说出暗号

text.title: 追踪诅咒
text.objectives: 护送瑞维尔·考斯特从暮色森林的密斯特曼托庄园前往逆风小径的埃瑞丁营地。
text.description:
先前与敌人交战的时候，我瞥见了他们的过去。圣洁斗篷向我展示了一个场景，让我看到了黑暗骑士以前的身份。

来吧，我们必须到逆风小径的埃瑞丁营地去。我可以在路上为你解释要点。

english.title: Following the Curse
english.objectives: Escort Revil Kost from Manor Mistmantle in Duskwood to Ariden's Camp in Deadwind Pass.
english.description:
In my previous confrontation with your foe, I was able to see a glimpse into their past. Granted blessed vision by the Cloak of Purity, I saw the Dark Riders for who they once were.

Come, we must go to Ariden's Camp in Deadwind Pass. I can explain its significance along the way.

objectiveDetails.description: 跟随瑞维尔前往埃瑞丁营地

text.title: 调查过去
text.objectives: 搜查埃瑞丁营地，寻找关于黑暗骑士的线索。
text.description:
这里就是商人埃瑞丁所设的营地，当年他在这里向巫师麦迪文供应可疑的商品。这么多年过去了，这里居然没有丝毫变化。所以，我怀疑这可能跟它以前的主人有关系。

帮我搜查这个营地，看看能不能找到有关黑暗骑士的线索。

english.title: Disturbing the Past
english.objectives: Search around Ariden's Camp for clues leading to the Dark Riders.
english.description:
This place is where the merchant, Ariden, set up camp while he was trying to ply his dubious wares to the sorcerer Medivh. It has remained strangely untouched for all this time, which leads me to believe it may still have a connection to its former owner.

Help me search the camp. Let's see if we can find something to lead us to the Dark Riders.

text.title: 逆风追杀
text.objectives: 跟随夜行狼人的踪迹。
text.description:
夜行狼人！如果他们在逆风小径，那他们一定也在寻找镰刀。

我们分头追踪他们。让我们看看他们的踪迹去向何处……

english.title: The Deadwind Hunt
english.objectives: Follow the tracks of the Nightbane worgen.
english.description:
The Nightbane! If they are in Deadwind Pass, then they may be seeking the scythe as well.

Let's split up and try to track them down. We'll see where their trail leads...

text.title: 黑暗骑士
text.objectives: 打败黑暗骑士并取得月神镰刀。
text.description:
这扇下水道格栅通向卡拉赞的地下墓穴。我以前从没留意过它，不过看来夜行狼人正是被引向了这个的地方。

真是没想到，黑暗骑士可能一直都在我们眼皮子底下！走吧，我们去看看里面会有什么。

english.title: The Dark Riders
english.objectives: Defeat the Dark Riders and claim the Scythe of Elune.
english.description:
This sewer grate leads to the catacombs underneath Karazhan. I've never paid it much attention, but it seems to be where the Nightbane are being drawn to.

To think, the Dark Riders may have been under our noses this entire time! Come, let us see where this leads.

text.title: 最后一席
text.objectives: 入座并加入影行者议会。
text.description: 你已步入无冕者的殿堂。我们是弑君者，是帝国覆灭的策划者，是撰写这个世界真正历史的无形操纵者。$B$B坐在你面前的是影行者议会，负责引导无冕者按照我们的计划行动。$B$B我们今天带你来此是有事相商。加入我们，填补最后一个影行者之缺，协助我们领导无冕者。$B$B你意下如何？

english.title: The Final Shadow
english.objectives: Take your seat in the Council of Shadows.
english.description: You walk in the halls of the Uncrowned. We are the slayers of kings, the downfall of empires, the unseen blades that write the true history of this world.$B$BSeated before you are the Shadows, the council which aims the blades of the Uncrowned wherever our will demands.$B$BWe have brought you here today with an offer. Take your seat as the final Shadow and help us lead the Uncrowned.$B$BWhat do you say?

text.title: 称手武器
text.objectives: 选择追求哪件神器。
text.description: 长久以来，我们一直在寻找能够在这些厅堂以外有所作为的人。$B$B$n，这个人就是你。你将成为黑暗中的利刃，为我们击杀敌人。$B$B为了达到这个目的，你需要能够消灭军团精英的武器。$B$B格雷迈恩、特塞斯和瓦莉拉分别有不同的计划，来帮你取得足以迎接未来挑战的称手武器。我建议你先跟他们谈谈，然后再做决定。

english.title: A Worthy Blade
english.objectives: Select a weapon to pursue.
english.description: For quite some time, we've been looking for someone who can operate outside these halls.$B$B$n, you are the answer to that search. You will be the blade in the dark that vanquishes our foes.$B$BIn order to do so, you require weapons capable of striking down the Legion's best.$B$BGreymane, Tethys, and Valeera each have devised plans to obtain weapons worthy of the tasks to come. I suggest you hear each out before proceeding.

objectiveDetails.description: 考虑舰队上将特塞斯的计划

text.title: 合算的计划
text.objectives: 在藏宝海湾的红雾号上和舰队上将特塞斯见面。
text.description: 我想跟你商量个事。$B$B亡灵将军伊丽扎凭着手里的一对受到诅咒的利器，成为了南部海域的一大祸患。她还偷走了我最精良的舰船之一——大地之末号——并且把它停靠在阿苏纳的海岸边上。$B$B如果你可以帮我夺回舰船，那么她的那对武器就归你所有。$B$B如果你同意这个计划，就到红雾号上跟我汇合。它就停在藏宝海湾——费用可不便宜。

english.title: A Friendly Accord
english.objectives: Meet Fleet Admiral Tethys aboard the Crimson Veil in Booty Bay.
english.description: I'd like to offer ya an accord.$B$BThe Dread Admiral Eliza wields a pair of cursed blades that have made her the scourge of the south seas. She also stole one of me best ships - the Horizon's Edge - and has it anchored off the shore of Azsuna as we speak. $B$BIf you help me take back me ship, then her cursed blades are yours.$B$BNow, assuming that sounds agreeable, meet me aboard the Crimson Veil. We have her docked right in Booty Bay - not a cheap arrangement.

objectiveDetails.description: （可选）使用传送门前往卡拉赞

text.title: 恐惧之刃
text.objectives: 夺回大地之末号并获取恐惧之刃。
text.description: 我可以带你安全抵达伊丽扎的所在之处，到那之后的事情就不敢保证了……这个我们都懂的。$B$B计划很简单。我们把红雾号停在尽可能靠近的地方，但是不能让他们发现或者登上我们的船。$B$B靠岸以后，我们立刻登上大地之末号，收买那些叛徒船员，让他们把船交给我们。然后找到并且干掉伊丽扎，再取得她的传说武器。$B$B你准备好了就告诉我。

english.title: The Dreadblades
english.objectives: Capture the Horizon's Edge and obtain the Dreadblades.
english.description: I can promise ya a safe journey to Eliza's position, but once we're there... well, we both know there be no guarantees.$B$BThe plan is simple. We'll take the Crimson Veil as close as we can get her without being seen and disembark from there.$B$BOnce we're ashore, we'll board the Horizon's Edge, bribe her mutinous crew to hand it over, and hunt down Eliza and her legendary blades wherever she may be.$B$BJust say the word when yer ready.

text.title: 无限可能
text.objectives: 把魔能机甲外壳还给达拉然的钳工蒂迪。
text.description: 你来了啊，我有件东西可能会让你感兴趣。$b$b<菲果指着一副躺在他身后的废物堆里的外壳。>$b$b它是我在阿苏纳的海岸上找到的。我敢确定只要稍微修理一下，像你这种水平的工程师马上就可以让它变得生龙活虎。$b$b说不定还可以用来对付燃烧军团。我还真有点喜欢以暴制暴的感觉，呵呵！
text.completion: How did you get your hands on this?!$b$b<Didi begins inspecting the husk.>$b$bDo you realize what we could do with something like this? Our own personal fel reaver?!$b$bWe could lay waste to our enemies!$b$bWe could advance our knowledge of science and technology!$b$bWe could make it serve us drinks!

english.title: Endless Possibilities
english.objectives: Bring the Fel Reaver Husk back to Didi the Wrench in Dalaran.
english.description: Say, since you're down here, I have something that you might be interested in.$b$b<Filgo points over to a husk lying in the junk behind him.>$b$bI found that thingy down in Azsuna, just lying on the beach. I'm sure with a little tinkering, an engineer like you could probably get it up and running in no time.$b$bMight even be useful against the Legion. Kind of like fighting fel with fel, heh!
english.completion: How did you get your hands on this?!$b$b<Didi begins inspecting the husk.>$b$bDo you realize what we could do with something like this? Our own personal fel reaver?!$b$bWe could lay waste to our enemies!$b$bWe could advance our knowledge of science and technology!$b$bWe could make it serve us drinks!

text.title: 阿苏纳的同事
text.objectives: 在阿苏纳的邪焰隘口附近找到法戈·弗林特洛克。
text.description: 哎呀！好吧。这玩意缺少好多零件。$b$b我会尽量修理它的框架，你可以找些新的装备或者其他什么材料吗？$b$b我们在阿苏纳的一位同事或许可以帮忙。他叫弗林特洛克。$b$b找东西对他来说应该没有问题，只是别让他制作任何东西。
text.completion: Shush-it, $c! This 'ere place is crawlin' with demony things.$b$bAye, Didi sent ye, did she? How is tha wee lass?$b$bIf yer lookin' for demon parts, I can certainly help yeh with that!

english.title: Our Man in Azsuna
english.objectives: Find Fargo Flintlocke in Azsuna near the Felblaze Ingress.
english.description: Yikes! OK. This thing is missing a LOT of parts.$b$bWhy don't you go hunt down some new gears or whatever while I do what I can to its existing frame?$b$bA colleague of ours, down in Azsuna, may be able to help out here. His name's Flintlocke.$b$bFetching parts should keep him out of trouble. Just don't let him BUILD anything.
english.completion: Shush-it, $c! This 'ere place is crawlin' with demony things.$b$bAye, Didi sent ye, did she? How is tha wee lass?$b$bIf yer lookin' for demon parts, I can certainly help yeh with that!

text.title: 高昂的代价
text.objectives: 在邪焰隘口收集魔能机甲手臂和魔能机甲腿部。
text.description: 想要恶魔部件？OK，你来对地方了，这里最不缺的就是那些邪恶的玩意。$b$b这里到处都是他们的传送门，你要找的东西很可能就在东南边的传送门附近。
text.completion: Just wat are ye and Didi puttin' together exactly?$b$bIs it big? Dangerous? Rer-diculous?$b$bI want in!

english.title: It'll Cost You
english.objectives: Collect a Fel Reaver Arm and a Fel Reaver Leg from within the Felblaze Ingress.
english.description: If yeh need demon parts, oh aye, this place is right teeming with them fel buggers.$b$bYer bound ta find what'yer lookin' fer probably near them portals they've got jus' sou'east of 'ere.
english.completion: Just wat are ye and Didi puttin' together exactly?$b$bIs it big? Dangerous? Rer-diculous?$b$bI want in!

text.title: Bits and Pieces
text.objectives: Meet with Brann Bronzebeard in Stormheim.
text.description: So many artifacts to catalogue, and never enough time.$b$bGood to see you again, $n. Brann Bronzebeard and the Explorers' League are in Stormheim right now and could use your help tracking down an ancient titan relic.$b$bBrann can fill you in on the details when you arrive.

english.title: Bits and Pieces
english.objectives: Meet with Brann Bronzebeard in Stormheim.
english.description: So many artifacts to catalogue, and never enough time.$b$bGood to see you again, $n. Brann Bronzebeard and the Explorers' League are in Stormheim right now and could use your help tracking down an ancient titan relic.$b$bBrann can fill you in on the details when you arrive.

text.title: 缺失的部件
text.objectives: 回达拉然找钳工蒂迪。
text.description: 看来你要的东西都找齐了。把东西带回到蒂迪那里，记得帮我拍一下她的后背，转达问候！
text.completion: <You give Didi a slap on the back.>$b$bUgh! I take it Flintlocke says hello?$b$bLet's see what you brought me! Oh good, these will work perfectly.$b$bI'll get started on the repairs using a new invention of mine, the Auto-Hammer.$b$bHere's a copy of the blueprints for it if you're interested in making one for yourself.

english.title: The Missing Pieces
english.objectives: Head back to Didi the Wrench in Dalaran.
english.description: Yeh seem ta 'ave everything yeh need. Head back to Didi now wit' yer supplies and giv'er a slap on tha back from me!
english.completion: <You give Didi a slap on the back.>$b$bUgh! I take it Flintlocke says hello?$b$bLet's see what you brought me! Oh good, these will work perfectly.$b$bI'll get started on the repairs using a new invention of mine, the Auto-Hammer.$b$bHere's a copy of the blueprints for it if you're interested in making one for yourself.

text.title: 最新潮流：头戴式机枪！
text.objectives: 用弗林特洛克的头戴式机枪原型杀死$1oa只被邪能污染的小动物。
text.description: 这么说钩锤有大量多余的枪械，是吗？太好了！我忍不住想，“如果把它们放头上会怎样？”$b$b听我说完！$b$b想想看，你的双手要使用现在的武器，那你的头在干嘛？就像个摆设一样放着，傻乎乎地望来望去。我的计划就是，武装你的头！$b$b你，幸运的$g小伙子:小姑娘;，可以进行测试。系上这个。现在，炸掉下面的那些被邪能污染的小动物。轰轰轰！
text.completion: What'd I tell ya? Now THAT's usin' yer HEAD!$b$bYeh see what I did there?$b$bSeeing as 'ow yeh tested them out fer me, I'll let yeh 'ave a copy of the blueprint fer 'em.

english.title: The Latest Fashion: Headguns!
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Fel Critters using Flintlocke's Headgun Prototype.
english.description: So Grapplehammer's got hisself a whole lotta extra guns, right? Glorious! An'it got me ta thinkin', "What if we put 'em on our heads?"$b$bHear me out!$b$bSee, yer hands are already busy with yer current weapons, but what's yer head doin'? It's just sittin' there LOOKIN' at stuff. That's me plan. Weaponize yer head!$b$bYou, me lucky $glad:lass;, can test it out. Strap this on. Now, go blast some fel-tainted critters down below. Blammo!
english.completion: What'd I tell ya? Now THAT's usin' yer HEAD!$b$bYeh see what I did there?$b$bSeeing as 'ow yeh tested them out fer me, I'll let yeh 'ave a copy of the blueprint fer 'em.

objectiveDetails.description: 用被邪能污染的小动物测试头戴式机枪

text.title: 补给前线
text.objectives: 把弹药箱送到瓦尔莎拉的法戈·弗林特洛克手上。
text.description: $n，我要你帮我跑跑腿。$b$b弗林特洛克从瓦尔莎拉送来消息，说他们的弹药用完了。$b$b我派他过去的时候，给他准备了可以把整个星球炸成两半那么多的弹药，但是弗林特洛克消耗弹药的速度就像我们消耗……空气一样快。去帮帮他！

english.title: Resupplying the Line
english.objectives: Deliver the Crate of Ammunition to Fargo Flintlocke in Val'sharah.
english.description: $n, I need you to make a delivery for me.$b$bFlintlocke's sent word from Val'sharah stating that they're out of bullets.$b$bI sent him down there with enough ammo to cut the planet in half, but Flintlocke goes through ammunition the way you or I go through... air. Go help him out!

text.title: 志在必得
text.objectives: 在眠月河滩回收$1oa个便携式洒弹器零件。
text.description: 我的全新发明耗光了所有的弹药。它叫：便携式洒弹器！$b$b没错，它可以省去麻烦又啰嗦的“瞄准”和“思考”时间，直接进行大面积扫射，完全像我们这种爽快人的风格。$b$b这些植物从树林里冒出来制造混乱的时候，我们就在东边安装了一些洒弹器。$b$b我没有时间去回收它们，你愿意为我代劳吗？不管炮台变成什么样，都帮我拿回来好吗？

english.title: In My Sights
english.objectives: Recover $1oa Deployable Bullet Dispenser Parts around Moonrest.
english.description: I used up all me bullets on a wee invention of mine. I call it: Tha Deployable Bullet Dispenser!$b$bOh aye. It shoots in-der-scriminantly wit'out all that messy and time-consumin' "aiming" or "thinkin'" that us people-folk are wont ta do.$b$bWe had deployed quite a few of 'em east o' here when this swarm of plants came a'thrashin from tha trees.$b$bI didn't 'ave time ta go back an' get me turrets. Would ye mind gettin' them back fer me? Or at least, what's left of 'em?

text.title: 植物大轰炸
text.objectives: 用弗林特洛克的火药炸弹消灭$1oa个荧光夹竹桃。
text.description: 如果你要进入这片林地，就需要带上额外的火力。这些植物可不好对付。$b$b我带了些特殊的炸药，应该可以把那些突变的肥料炸成灰。$b$b拿去好好教训那些藤蔓怪物！

english.title: All Charged Up
english.objectives: Use Flintlocke's Gunpowder Charges to kill $1oa Shimmering Oleanders.
english.description: If yer gonna wander inta these woods, ye'll be wantin' somethin' with some punch. These plants are a might grabby.$b$bI've got me special explosive charges here that should send those fertilizer mutations back to the dirt.$b$bTake 'em with yeh and give them viney beasties a what-fer!

text.title: 总是差一步
text.objectives: 为蒂迪的设计找到合适的能量源并交给她，然后看看她的新电池可不可以使用。
text.description: 嗯，我全部搞定了。加了好些零件，还给动力核心装了一个新的防护罩。$b$b问题是我这里的所有电池都用不了。我觉得，我们需要尝试一些新的方案。$b$b我需要你的帮助，$n。首先让我们试试街那边的珠宝加工店里的充能宝石。
text.completion: We did it! That's one fully functional, killer-lookin' fel reaver.$b$bShould it ever run out of power, here's the schematic for that battery I came up with.$b$bJust pop a new one in it and you should be good to go.$b$bBy the way, whatcha think we should name it? I was thinking somethin' deadly, like "Reaves."

english.title: Always the Last Thing
english.objectives: Find a suitable power source for Didi's design and deliver it to her. Then, see if her new battery actually works.
english.description: Well, I've worked out all the kinks. Added a few nuts and bolts, and fitted a new housing for the power core.$b$bProblem is, none of the batteries I have here seem to work. I think we're gonna have to fashion somethin' new together.$b$bI'm gonna need your help, $n. Let's start by trying a charged gem from the jewelcrafting shop down the way.
english.completion: We did it! That's one fully functional, killer-lookin' fel reaver.$b$bShould it ever run out of power, here's the schematic for that battery I came up with.$b$bJust pop a new one in it and you should be good to go.$b$bBy the way, whatcha think we should name it? I was thinking somethin' deadly, like "Reaves."

text.title: 模块修改
text.objectives: 制作里弗斯模块：零食发放模式，然后召唤里弗斯并进行安装。
text.description: 我们已经修好了这个宝贝，现在应该给它添加一些酷炫的能力。$b$b在修理里弗斯的时候，我在它的主板上安装了一个模块端口。我们可以通过这个端口上传任何想要的东西。$b$b我会教你一个我的模块设计，然后你需要把它装到里弗斯上面。

english.title: Modular Modifications
english.objectives: Create a Reaves Module: Snack Distribution Mode. Then summon Reaves and install it into him.
english.description: Now that we got this baby running, let's give it some cool abilities.$b$bWhen I was fixing Reaves up, I installed a module port onto his motherboard. This will allow us to upload anything we want.$b$bI'll teach you one of my module designs and you install it on Reaves.

objectiveDetails.description: 召唤里弗斯并安装模块
制造里弗斯模块：零食发放模式

text.title: 小事一桩
text.objectives: 在风暴峡湾寻找法戈·弗林特洛克。
text.description: $n，我又得让你帮我寻找弗林特洛克了。$b$b我派他去风暴峡湾为我的一项发明收集材料，但是好多天过去了，他一直没有回来。$b$b我不是担心弗林特洛克，而是担心风暴峡湾会出什么事。$b$b去看看你能不能找到他！

english.title: It's Not Rocket Science
english.objectives: Find Fargo Flintlocke in Stormheim.
english.description: $n, I need you to help me track down Flintlocke again.$b$bI sent him to Stormheim to gather some materials for an invention of mine and he hasn't been back for days. I'm not worried about Flintlocke, but I DO fear for Stormheim.$b$bSee if you can find him!

text.title: 你是说贝壳？
text.objectives: 消灭鱼人，帮法戈·弗林特洛克收集$1oa个贝壳。
text.description: 我知道老菲兹让我到这里来帮他收集他那些宝贵的鱼人玻璃，但是我也有自己的设计！$b$b我看到那些鱼人佩戴着一些贝壳，它们的样子很有趣，跟我正在制作的音乐盒非常搭配。$b$b你当前锋，我跟在后面。

english.title: The Shell, You Say?
english.objectives: Slay murlocs to collect  $1oa of their shells for Fargo Flintlocke.
english.description: I know ol' Hobart sent me down 'ere to acquire 'is precious murloc glass thingies, but I have designs of me own!$b$bI've seen those murlocs carrying interesting lookin' shells that would go perfectly into me music box I've been workin on.$b$bYa lead the charge an'a I'll be right behind ya.

text.title: 鱼人饰品
text.objectives: 在鱼人营地附近收集$1oa件鱼人饰品。
text.description: 老霍巴特要我收集鱼人身上的闪亮玻璃饰品，但是那些该死的混蛋不愿老实交出来！$b$b我试着跟他们沟通，但是我不会说鱼人的语言，所以只能朝他们射击了。$b$b或许你的运气比较好，可以拿到他们的小玩意。

english.title: Bubble Baubles
english.objectives: Gather $1oa Murloc Trinkets from around their camps.
english.description: Ol' Hobart wanted me ta gather up these shiny, glass trinkets the murlocs carry around, but those bloody buggers ain't willin' to jes' hand 'em over!$b$bI tried the dip-ler-matic approach, but I don't speak murloc, so I just end up shootin' 'em.$b$bMaybe you might have better luck gettin' them baubles.

text.title: 时间与波浪，变化无常
text.objectives: 把鱼人饰品交给达拉然的霍巴特·钩锤。
text.description: 我这里的事情还没做完，不如你帮我把那些饰品带回去交给霍巴特吧。$b$b而且，我觉得比起我来，他更喜欢你。

english.title: Wibbly-Wobbly, Timey-Wimey
english.objectives: Deliver the Murloc Trinkets to Hobart Grapplehammer in Dalaran.
english.description: I gotta finish up 'ere, so why don'tcha take those trinkets back to Hobart fer me.$b$b'Sides, I'ma thinkin' he likes ya more than me.

text.title: 射后不理
text.objectives: 在达拉然对受伤的肯瑞托卫士测试泵动式绷带枪原型机。如有必要，对枪械进行校准。
text.description: 我有一大堆枪械不知道怎么处理。俗话说“要用是宝，不用是草”。$b$b所以，我一直进行各种尝试，希望把这些枪械变成有用的工具。$b$b我最近改造出了一种可以发射绷带的枪！想象一下：你在战场里看到盟友倒下了，现在，你拿出绷带枪朝他发射，然后轰的一下，他又可以继续战斗了！$b$b我只需要你先进行一下测试，确保它的安全性。

english.title: Fire and Forget
english.objectives: Test out the Prototype Pump-Action Bandage Gun on Wounded Kirin Tor Guardians in Dalaran. Use the gun to calibrate it when needed.
english.description: They say, "When life gives you lemons, make lemonade." Well, life gave me a butt-load of guns.$b$bSo I've been figuring out ways to turn these guns into useful tools.$b$bMy latest modification is a gun that shoots bandages! Imagine it, you're on the battlefield, you see your ally go down, you pull out your bandage gun, shoot him with it and bam, he's back in the fight!$b$bI just need you to test it first and make sure it's safe.

objectiveDetails.description: 再次使用枪械以进行校准

text.title: 好景在望
text.objectives: 从达拉然的孩童身上找回蒂迪的烟火。
text.description: $n，那些小流氓抢走了我所有的烟火。$b$b你没看到他们吗？眼看着我为里弗斯设计的新模块就要大功告成，但是这些小崽子冲进来抢走了我的烟火。$b$b要完成我辛苦制作的模块的话，就必须找回烟火。你可以帮我找回来吗？

english.title: Here Comes the BOOM!
english.objectives: Get Didi's fireworks back from the children in Dalaran.
english.description: $n, they stole all my fireworks, the little scamps.$b$bYou didn't see them? I was just on the verge of creating a new module for Reaves when these kids came in here and ran off with my fireworks.$b$bI need them back if I'm going to finish what I'm working on. Can you go get them back for me?

text.title: 法戈的工作
text.objectives: 在阿苏纳寻找法戈·弗林特洛克。
text.description: 弗林特洛克一直在找你，$n。我觉得他又需要你帮忙了。$b$b我让他回阿苏纳去测试我的一些新发明。你可以到欧逊努斯海窟的西部海岸线找他。

english.title: 'Locke and Load
english.objectives: Find Fargo Flintlocke in Azsuna.
english.description: Flintlocke's been looking for you, $n. I think he needs your help again.$b$bI sent him out to test out a couple of new inventions of mine back down in Azsuna. Look for him on the shoreline west of Oceanus Cove!

text.title: 酷炫装备
text.objectives: 用火枪鞋在水面上滑行，并收集$1oa块枪械包残片。
text.description: 当我在，呃，帮霍巴特测试新飞行枪械包的时候，它不知怎么就爆炸了，还把我横空甩到了那边去。$b$b你可以在那边的水里看到所有零件。$b$b现在还有一双霍巴特给我的鞋子需要测试，但是它们不合我的脚。$b$b我想我们可以一石二鸟，你可以在测试鞋子功能的时候顺便把枪械包的零件捡回来。$b$b提醒一下，小心水里的鲨鱼。

english.title: Going Out With a Bang
english.objectives: Use the Gunshoes to skim across the water while picking up $1oa pieces of Gunpack Debris.
english.description: While I was, eh, testin' out this new flight pack fer Hobart, it sorta exploded an' sent me flyin' back over 'ere.$b$bYou can see all the pieces out there in tha water.$b$bNow, I've got these boots 'ere that Hobart gave me to test out too, but they're not quite me size.$b$bI figure we could kill two birds with one stone and 'ave ye test 'em out while pickin' up the broken bits of the pack.$b$bMind tha sharks while yer out there.

text.title: 火药要干
text.objectives: 在阿苏纳收集$1oa桶火药，然后带回去交给法戈。
text.description: 虽然我们找回了枪械包的零件，但是恐怕我们的火药已经用完了。$b$b这堪称我这辈子遇到的最倒霉的事儿。$b$b不过还是有希望的。北边的山洞里面装满了船只的残骸，里面说不定就有一两艘是被海巨人的大炮给轰烂的。而炮弹需要火药才可以发射。$b$b到那些洞穴里去找一些火药，然后带回来。

english.title: Keep Yer Powder Dry
english.objectives: Gather $1oa Barrels of Gunpowder and return them to Fargo in Azsuna.
english.description: So while we've got all tha parts for tha pack again, I'm afraid I'm all outta gunpowder.$b$bThis is the worst thing ta ever happen ta me.$b$bBut there's hope. Just o'er to tha north are caves filled with crashed ships. Chances are them sea giants crashed one or two ships with cannons. And cannons mean gunpowder, sweet gunpowder.$b$bSearch their caves fer sum powder an' bring it on back.

text.title: 我也想自己做的，但是……
text.objectives: 在欧逊努斯海窟消灭$1oa个积怨奴隶主。
text.description: 如果你到海巨人的洞窟里，记得帮我好好教训那些滑不拉几的纳迦混蛋。$b$b他们掳走了我的好朋友，我必须跟他们算账。$b$b我本该自己出马的，但是我不能扔下老霍巴特的东西不管，不然他不会给我好日子过的。

english.title: I'd Do It Myself, But...
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Hatecoil Slavemasters in the Oceanus Cove.
english.description: If yer headed over ta tha sea giant caves, do me a favor give those slimy naga a right bludgerin'.$b$bThey done run oft with me rogue friend an' I figure some revenge is in order.$b$bI'd do it meself but ol' Hobart would give me wut-fer if I abandoned his stuff.

text.title: 暴殄天物
text.objectives: 在海巨人的洞穴里找到矮爆，把他的头剃光，然后从他头上拓印一份结构图。
text.description: 我们来到这里的时候，我的侏儒好朋友矮爆$b遭到那些可恶的纳迦绑架。他被掳走了！他们把矮爆拖到那个洞穴去了！$b$b问题是我的一个最伟大的发明的结构图还在他身上。$b$b“在他身上”是指那张图就纹在他的脑袋上面。这是为了保险起见！$b$b你找到他之后，剃光他的头，赶快把设计复制下来。

english.title: Going to Waste
english.objectives: Find Lowping in the sea giant caves, shave his head, and make a copy of the schematic that's tattooed there.
english.description: Me wee rogue friend Lowping were$bgnome-napped by them dirty naga when we got 'ere. He's gone! They drug him right oft toward tha cove!$b$bBut 'ere's tha real issue. He 'ad a schematic on 'im fer one of me greatest inventions.$b$bAnd by "on 'im," I mean I tattooed it to tha top o' his head. FOR SAFETY!$b$bWhen ye find 'im, jes shave 'is head and make a quick copy o' tha design.

objectiveDetails.description: 找到矮爆并剃光他的头

text.title: 整装待发
text.objectives: 回达拉然找霍巴特，并向他汇报弗林特洛克的工作。
text.description: 嗯，我在这里的事情做得差不多了。我会开始打包，然后返回达拉然。$b$b请你把这里的情况告诉霍巴特，可以吗？或许你可以省略爆炸、淹死和俘虏的事情，只汇报其他的就好。$b$b你是一个好伙伴，$n！

english.title: 'Locke, Stock and Barrel
english.objectives: Return to Hobart in Dalaran and inform him of Flintlocke's work.
english.description: Well that jes' about wraps up me work 'ere. I'll start packin up an'ead back ta Dalaran.$b$bIf yeh wouldn't mind, could yeh tell Hobart 'ow things went down 'ere? Maybe leave out tha bits with tha explodin', tha drownin', an' tha gettin captured an' what not.$b$bYer a proper friend, $n!

text.title: 英灵殿：纵枪行乐
text.objectives: 前往英灵殿，从奥丁手里取得活力符文石。
text.description: 为了完成我的最新发明，我需要一件叫做活力符文石的特殊圣物。$b$b据说英灵殿之王奥丁就是用它为构造体赋予生命。$b$b我这任务很不好办——我要你从奥丁手里夺走符文石，并拿回来给我。

english.title: Halls of Valor: Trigger Happy
english.objectives: Obtain the Runestone of Vitality from Odyn in the Halls of Valor.
english.description: In order to complete my latest invention, I need a special relic known as the Runestone of Vitality.$b$bOdyn, king of the Halls of Valor is known to use it to breathe life into his constructs.$b$bWhat I'm asking is no easy task, but I need to take the runestone from Odyn and bring it back to me.

text.title: 突袭紫罗兰监狱：装死
text.objectives: 制作$1oa个故障检测晶塔。前往紫罗兰监狱并获取一个离子激光螺栓。然后把所有东西交给达拉然的钳工蒂迪。
text.description: 霍巴特向我展示你的设计副本时，我想到了一种新的里弗斯模块。$b$b不幸的是，我没有测试所需的材料。$b$b你可以帮我制作一些故障检测晶塔吗？$b$b我还需要一个离子激光螺栓，在紫罗兰监狱就能找到。

english.title: Assault on Violet Hold: Cheating Death
english.objectives: Craft $1oa Failure Detection Pylons. Go to the Violet Hold and recover a Plasmatic Laser Bolt and return everything to Didi the Wrench in Dalaran.
english.description: Hobart was showing me a copy of a design you found, and it got me to thinking of a new module for Reaves.$b$bUnfortunately I didn't have the materials required to test it.$b$bCould you make me a couple Failure Detection Pylons?$b$bI'll also need a plasmatic laser bolt. You should be able to find one in the Violet Hold.

objectiveDetails.description: 击败第三个逃跑的囚犯

text.title: 短路
text.objectives: 找出布林顿的发明者。
text.description: 既然你在这里，你能不能帮我追查一件事情。$b$b我相信你对布林顿不会陌生吧？哎呀，我一直到处打听，但似乎没人知道它的设计来源。不过，我听说了一个比较可靠的传言：$b$b52区。$b$b有兴趣来一次实地考察吗？

english.title: Short Circuit
english.objectives: Find the inventor of Blingtron.
english.description: While I've got you here, I was wondering if you could track something down for me.$b$bI'm sure you're familiar with a Blingtron, yes? Well, I started askin' around, and it seems no one really knows where the design for it came from. One rumor does pop up more than others, though:$b$bArea 52.$b$bInterested in a field trip?

objectiveDetails.description: 找到葛诺佩托的工作室
在塔纳利斯东部与温琪交谈
在加基森与尼克斯·斯普克斯宾交谈
在棘齿城与首席工程师福特交谈
与52区的火箭主管弗斯拉格交谈

text.title: 成功的关键
text.objectives: 回去找达拉然的钳工蒂迪，并且把你找到的东西给她看。
text.description: 蒂迪肯定会对你发现的日志感兴趣，而且肯定想要检查这种电路设计。$b$b你应该尽快回去找她。

english.title: Oil Rags to Riches
english.objectives: Return to Didi the Wrench in Dalaran and show her the items you've found.
english.description: Didi will be very interested in reading the journal you found as well as examining the circuit design.$b$bYou should return to her as soon as you can.

text.title: 群星庭院：改良后坐力
text.objectives: 进入群星庭院，为霍巴特取回奥能压缩器。
text.description: $n，我正在弗林特洛克的护目镜设计基础之上开发一种新型的改良版本。听到这个消息你肯定非常激动吧。$b$b我的作品有双倍的功率，但不幸的是它也有双倍的后坐力。如果你使用这副护目镜的话，恐怕它会扭断你的脖子。$b$b好在我找到了解决方案。苏拉玛城的深处有一台神奇的装置，它可以把后坐力减少到几乎可以忽略不计。$b$b为我取得那台装置，然后我们就没有后顾之忧啦！

english.title: Court of Stars: Revamping the Recoil
english.objectives: Go into the Court of Stars and recover the Arcanic Compressor for Hobart.
english.description: $n, you'll be very excited to hear that I've been working on a newer, better version of those goggles that Flintlocke rigged up.$b$bThe ones I've designed have double the power, but unfortunately they also have double the recoil. I'm afraid if you use them, they'll break your neck.$b$bBut I found a solution. Deep inside Suramar City lies a magical mechanism that will reduce the recoil to practically nothing.$b$bRecover that mechanism for me and we're in business!

text.title: 守卫的命运
text.objectives: 找到尼耶鲁斯·织星、加拉图斯·河树以及凯丽娅·风羽的尸体，并为他们举行安魂仪式。
text.description:
<萨尔雷纳斯仔细打量着你。>

你不是他们的人。

苏拉玛的护盾降下来后几小时，夜之子曾敲响我们的大门。虽然长久分离，但我们把他们当做朋友。

然而我们错了。

他们涌入我们的要塞，然后开始屠杀。我们猝不及防。虽然我们反抗过，但还是被击败了。

要塞失守。我们的领袖纷纷丧命，暴尸街头。

找到他们，为他们举行应有的安魂仪式。

在你搜索尸体的时候，也留意一下幸存者。可以的话，请帮助他们。

english.title: Fate of the Guard
english.objectives: Find the corpses of Nyellus Starweaver, Galar'thus Rivertree, and Kailea Windfeather and perform funereal rites for them.
english.description:
<Thalrenus looks you over.>

You are not one of them.

The Nightborne came to our gates hours after the shield over Suramar fell. We thought them friends, despite our long separation.

We were wrong.

They poured into our stronghold and began the slaughter. We were unprepared. Though we fought, we were beaten.

The keep is lost. Our leaders have perished and their corpses lay in the streets.

Find them, give them their final rites.

While you search, look for survivors. Help them if you can.

objectiveDetails.description: 为凯丽娅·风羽举行仪式
为加拉图斯·河树举行仪式
为尼耶鲁斯·织星举行仪式

text.title: 艾露恩之泪
text.objectives: 使用达拉然的中央传送器，把艾露恩之泪放到画像室里。
text.description: 艾露恩之泪轻盈地漂浮着，在一道空灵的月光之下熠熠生辉。
text.completion: <Archmage Khadgar has set aside a space here for the Tears of Elune, as well as the rest of the Pillars of Creation.>

english.title: The Tears of Elune
english.objectives: Use the central teleporter in Dalaran and then place the Tears of Elune in the Portrait Room.
english.description: The Tear of Elune floats effortlessly, glistening in an ethereal pillar of moonlight.
english.completion: <Archmage Khadgar has set aside a space here for the Tears of Elune, as well as the rest of the Pillars of Creation.>

objectiveDetails.description: 使用达拉然的中央传送器

text.title: 新鲜的肉
text.objectives: 收集$1oa块新鲜的邪火蜥蜴肉。
text.description: 这里有大量的邪火蜥蜴。$b$b虽然它们可能不是最狡猾的生物，但是它们跟恶魔一样邪恶、危险。$b$b不过，它们或许对我们还有点用处。消灭蜥蜴并给我带回几块灌注了邪能的蜥蜴肉。$b$b我已经想好要拿新鲜的蜥蜴肉来做什么了……

english.title: Fresh Meat
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Fresh Fel-Flesh.
english.description: This crater is infested with felfire basilisks.$b$bThey may not be the most cunning of creatures, but they are as vile and dangerous as any demon.$b$bHowever, they may yet prove useful to us. Slay the basilisks, but return to me with chunks of their fel-infused flesh.$b$bI have plans to make use of their freshly carved flesh...

text.title: 肩负重任
text.objectives: 回梦境林地去找大德鲁伊巨蹄。
text.description:
你在对抗黑暗骑士的过程中提供了重大的帮助，向圣光贡献了自己的力量。虽然我们有不同的信仰，但我知道我们有共同的目标。

你帮助我完成了使命，把神器交到了正确的人手里，对此我十分感激。至于月神镰刀，我觉得只有交给你才最为妥当。

希望它可以帮你好好对付燃烧军团，$n。

english.title: The Burden Borne
english.objectives: Return to Arch Druid Greathoof in the Dreamgrove.
english.description:
Your assistance against the Dark Riders has proven a great service to the Light. Though our beliefs may separate us, I know that we share one goal.

You have allowed me to fill my purpose in returning these artifacts to their rightful owners, and for this I am thankful. As for the Scythe of Elune, I can think of no safer place than in your care. 

May it serve you well against the Legion, $n.

text.title: 吞噬者恐翼
text.objectives: 消灭吞噬者恐翼。
text.description: 谢谢你把我救出来，$c。$b$b不过，阿佐兰不是一个普通的恶魔。他是号令燃烧军团上层阶级的强大艾瑞达。$b$b如果你想继续跟着我行动，就得拿出自己的实力给我看看。$b$b吞噬者恐翼是最强大的魔蝠，正好可以用来考验你的能力。把蜥蜴的肉放到北边的祭坛上，等它出现就拿下它。$b$b只要你拿回它的徽记，我就不再质疑你的能力。

english.title: Grimwing the Devourer
english.objectives: Slay Grimwing the Devourer.
english.description: You have my thanks for rescuing me from captivity, $c.$b$bHowever, Azoran is no mere demon. He is a powerful eredar who commands great rank within the Burning Legion.$b$bIf you wish to continue with me, I need proof of your strength.$b$bGrimwing the Devourer is the strongest of the felbats and a suitable test of skill. Place the basilisk flesh upon the altar to the north and slay Grimwing when she appears.$b$bReturn to me with her head and I will not doubt your ability.

text.title: 污染者的阴影
text.objectives: 询问月光林地的守护者，看看他们是否了解这个混沌残片的本质。
text.description: 赤红色的能量在这个令人不安的东西中翻腾，你每次瞥见它时，它的形状似乎都有些许变化。$B$B它的力量极为陌生，和你在德拉诺或者与燃烧军团的战斗中所见到的完全不同。或许艾泽拉斯的月光林地中的守护者们会知道些什么。

english.title: Shadow of the Defiler
english.objectives: Consult the keepers of Moonglade to see if they can shed any light on the nature of the Remnant of Chaos.
english.description: Crimson energy swirls within this disturbing object, which seems to have slightly different contours each time your gaze returns to it.$B$BIts power is utterly foreign, unlike anything you have seen in Draenor or during your battles with the Legion. Perhaps the keepers of Moonglade, back on Azeroth, might have some insight into its nature.

text.title: Serpents from the Deep
text.objectives: Speak with Toryl outside of Jandvik.
text.description: Hail, $c.$B$BMy village of Jandvik has fallen under siege by a group of naga called the Sashj'tar.$B$BNormally I would not seek out the help of an outsider, but we are facing an enemy that we are incapable of defeating.$B$BMany powerful elven relics can be found in the ruins around Jandvik. In exchange for your help, you will have your just rewards.$B$BDo we have an accord?

english.title: Serpents from the Deep
english.objectives: Speak with Toryl outside of Jandvik.
english.description: Hail, $c.$B$BMy village of Jandvik has fallen under siege by a group of naga called the Sashj'tar.$B$BNormally I would not seek out the help of an outsider, but we are facing an enemy that we are incapable of defeating.$B$BMany powerful elven relics can be found in the ruins around Jandvik. In exchange for your help, you will have your just rewards.$B$BDo we have an accord?

text.title: 铲除障碍
text.objectives: 在贾德维克打败卡尔德和艾纳尔。
text.description: $C！想挣点外快吗？$B$B贾德维克的族长失踪了，有两个任性的小崽子正在争夺领导权。下任族长应该是我而不是他们！$B$B我要你进入贾德维克，在生死决斗中打败卡尔德和艾纳尔。$B$B虽然我通常不会相信外来者，但是以现在这种情况我只能向你求助。如果我的双手沾上了他们的鲜血的话，贾德维克的人肯定会怪罪我的。$B$B你成功以后就到贾德维克的中心来找我。

english.title: Removing Obstacles
english.objectives: Kill Calder and Eynar in Jandvik.
english.description: $C! Interested in earning some coin?$B$BThe jarl of Jandvik is missing and two headstrong whelps are vying to take over leadership. I should be the next jarl, not them!$B$BI want you to enter Jandvik and defeat Calder and Eynar in mortal combat.$B$BI would not normally put my trust in an outsider, but this situation requires the aid of someone like you. Jandvik would condemn me if I were caught with their blood on my hands.$B$BMeet me in the center of Jandvik when the deed is done.

text.title: 族长，回来吧
text.objectives: 在蓝风海湾寻找索迪尔族长。
text.description: 看来你完美地执行了我的命令，$n。或许我还可以用到你。$B$B贾德维克的领袖，索迪尔族长，已经失踪很久了。据我推测，他应该是在对抗萨吉塔纳迦入侵的战斗中牺牲了，但是我必须知道确切的情况。$B$B查明他的遭遇。$B$B只要你帮我做好这件事，我可以向你保证，我的维库同胞不会伤害你。

english.title: Jarl Come Back Now
english.objectives: Locate Jarl Throndyr in Azuregale Bay.
english.description: You seem to follow my commands well, $n. Perhaps I can use you again.$B$BJarl Throndyr, the leader of Jandvik, has been missing for some time now. I assume that he has fallen in battle to the invading Sashj'tar naga, but I must know for certain.$B$BFind out what has become of him.$B$BDo this task for me and I can assure you that my vrykul will not harm you.

text.title: Black Rook Hold Normal Reward Quest

english.title: Black Rook Hold Normal Reward Quest

text.title: Black Rook Hold Heroic Reward Quest

english.title: Black Rook Hold Heroic Reward Quest

text.title: 杀蝠取皮
text.objectives: 帮凯托斯收集$1oa块魔蝠皮碎片。
text.description: 啊，是我忠实的助手啊。我正好有个任务要交给你。$b$b如你所见，邪能会渗透活体组织，而且可以被轻松引导出来。$b$b另外，这些该死的蝙蝠快把我逼疯了。看来有办法一石二鸟呢。石头当然是你去扔。$b$b拿着这块水晶。用它应该能把天上的那些鬼东西拽到你跟前。$b$b你最好把它们的皮带回来，就算可以拿来塞住角落里那家伙的嘴也好。
text.end: 帮凯托斯收集100块魔蝠皮碎片。

english.title: Fel Bent for Leather
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Felbat Hide Scraps for Kyrtos.
english.description: Ah, my faithful assistant. I have just the task for you.$b$bAs you have seen, fel power permeates living tissue and can easily be coaxed out.$b$bAlso, these damned bats are driving me to my wits' end. There is an opportunity to kill two bats with one blade, it seems. Your blade.$b$bTake this crystal. It should rip those hellions from the sky and into your waiting arms.$b$bYou may as well bring back their hides, if only to shut up that fellow in the corner for a few moments.
english.end: Collect 100 Felbat Hide Scraps for Kyrtos.

text.title: 贾德维克的最后希望
text.objectives: 在萨吉塔岩洞与托尔里见面。
text.description: 指挥官马尔特希斯在跟海巨人打交道？$B$B如果没有你的帮助，村庄肯定会在萨吉塔和海巨人的联合攻击之下陷落。$B$B<托尔里站在那里，沉默了一会。>$B$B我们到蓝风海湾的地下洞穴碰头。$B$B我想给你看一样东西，它或许可以改变战争的局势。

english.title: Jandvik's Last Hope
english.objectives: Meet with Toryl in the Sashj'tar Grotto.
english.description: Commander Malt'his was conferring with a sea giant?$B$BWithout your help, this village will surely fall to the combined forces of the Sashj'tar and the sea giants.$B$B<Toryl stands there quietly for a moment.>$B$BMeet me in an underground cave out in Azuregale Bay.$B$BI want to show you something that may turn the tide in this battle.

text.title: 力量的象征
text.objectives: 收集$1oa个军团徽记。
text.description: 这个恶魔知道的情报可以让我们找出他们的首领。$b$b不幸的是，他惧怕自己的主人超过惧怕我们。我们必须让他改变主意。$b$b燃烧军团最强大的士兵通常会携带一种徽记，那象征着他们在恶魔大军里的身份和地位。$b$b在邪魂堡垒找到强大的恶魔并消灭他们，然后给我带回他们的徽记。$b$b我们要让这个虫语仆从看看，他到底应该惧怕谁……

english.title: Symbols of Power
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Legion Emblems.
english.description: This demon has information that could lead us to those in charge.$b$bUnfortunately, he is more fearful of his master than he is of us. We need to change his mind about that.$b$bThe most powerful Burning Legion soldiers often carry an emblem of their rank and status within the demon army.$b$bSeek out the stronger demons in Felsoul Hold, slay them, and return to me with their emblems.$b$bWe will show this wyrmtongue servant who it is he should fear...

text.title: 天启
text.objectives: 在暮色森林的密斯特曼托庄园开始搜寻天启。
text.description:
<巫妖王冰冷的声音再度充斥你的脑海>

有一把古老的利剑遗失在时光的长河里。它的力量可以帮我向燃烧军团复仇。

这把剑叫做天启。

我已经感受到，它就在逆风小径的黑暗骑士手里。他们用魔法躲过了我的视线，但是他们逃不出天灾的掌心！我的密探曾看到他们在一个叫做密斯特曼托庄园的地方出没。

到那里去，$n。击败黑暗骑士，取得天启！

english.title: Apocalypse
english.objectives: Start your search for Apocalypse at Manor Mistmantle in Duskwood.
english.description:
<The Lich King's chill voice fills your mind once again>

There is an ancient blade, lost in the echoes of time, that has the power to bring my vengeance upon the Legion. 

It is known as Apocalypse.

I've sensed the blade in the possession of the Dark Riders of Deadwind Pass. Their magic conceals them from my sight but they cannot hide from the scourge! They were last seen by my agents near a place called Manor Mistmantle.

Go there, $n. Defeat the Dark Riders, and claim the blade!

objectiveDetails.description: 在暮色森林调查密斯特曼托庄园
（可选）使用达拉然的传送门前往卡拉赞

text.title: 追踪诅咒
text.objectives: 护送瑞维尔·考斯特从暮色森林的密斯特曼托庄园前往逆风小径的埃瑞丁营地。
text.description:
很好。看来我得做一下自我介绍。我叫瑞维尔·考斯特，一名圣光牧师，我在寻找遗失的神器。我以前跟黑暗骑士打过交道，这次回来是为了彻底清理掉他们。

黑暗骑士一向神出鬼没，但是我可能有关于他们行踪的线索。先前交战的时候，我瞥见了他们的过去。圣洁斗篷向我展示了一个场景，让我看到了黑暗骑士以前的身份。

跟我一起到埃瑞丁营地去。我会在路上跟你解释。

english.title: Following the Curse
english.objectives: Escort Revil Kost from Manor Mistmantle in Duskwood to Ariden's Camp in Deadwind Pass.
english.description:
Very well. I suppose an introduction is in order. I am Revil Kost, priest of the Light and a seeker of lost artifacts. I've dealt with the Dark Riders before, and have returned to rid this place of them.

The Riders are elusive, but I may have a clue to their whereabouts. In our previous confrontation, I was able to see a glimpse into their past. Granted blessed vision by the Cloak of Purity, I saw the Dark Riders for who they were before.

Come with me to Ariden's camp. I will explain on the way.

objectiveDetails.description: 跟随瑞维尔前往埃瑞丁营地

text.title: 调查过去
text.objectives: 搜查埃瑞丁营地，寻找关于黑暗骑士的线索。
text.description:
这里就是商人埃瑞丁所设的营地，当年他在这里向巫师麦迪文供应可疑的商品。

这么多年过去了，这里居然没有丝毫变化。所以，我怀疑这可能跟它以前的主人有关系。

帮我搜查这个营地，看看能不能找到有关黑暗骑士的线索。

english.title: Disturbing the Past
english.objectives: Search around Ariden's Camp for clues leading to the Dark Riders.
english.description:
This place is where the merchant, Ariden, set up camp while he was trying to ply his dubious wares to the sorcerer Medivh. 

It has remained strangely untouched for all this time, which leads me to believe it may still have a connection to its former owner.

Help me search the camp. Let's see if we can find something to lead us to the Dark Riders.

text.title: 恐怖任务
text.objectives: 在逆风小径唤起埋葬在潮湿墓地里的亡者，直到你找到一位可以指出黑暗骑士位置的亡者为止。
text.description:
潮湿土壤？低浅墓穴？

我觉得日记里讲的地方是卡拉赞附近的湖边墓地。没人知道里面埋的是谁，不过那可能就是找到黑暗骑士的关键。

你可以……和亡灵沟通，是吗？

english.title: A Grisly Task
english.objectives: Raise the dead buried in the Sodden Graves in Deadwind Pass until you find one who can point you to the Dark Riders location.
english.description:
Wet soil? Shallow graves?

I think the journal is referring to the gravesites off of the lake near Karazhan. Nobody knows who is buried there, but they may be the key to finding the Dark Riders.

You can... speak to the dead, yes?

text.title: 黑暗骑士
text.objectives: 在卡拉赞墓穴打败黑暗骑士并取得天启。
text.description:
地下墓穴？我从没听说过这种地方。难道他指的是那里……

河流边上有一扇下水道格栅，它可以通向卡拉赞的地下墓穴。我以前从没留意过它，不过那里可能就是幽灵所说的地方。

想一想，黑暗骑士可能一直都在我们眼皮子底下！走吧，我们去看看里面会有什么。

english.title: The Dark Riders
english.objectives: Defeat the Dark Riders in the Karazhan Catacombs and claim Apocalypse.
english.description:
The catacombs? I've never heard of such a place. Unless, he means...

There's a sewer grate along the edge of the river leading to a catacombs underneath Karazhan. I've never paid it much attention, but it could lead to the catacombs that the spirit spoke of. 

To think, the Dark Riders may have been under our noses this entire time! Come, let us see where this leads.

text.title: 复仇的呼唤
text.objectives: 使用黑锋之门前往冰封王座，并获取巫妖王的印记。
text.description:
我误会你了，死亡骑士。在对抗黑暗骑士的过程中，你向圣光贡献了自己的力量。或许我不该这么武断。

不管怎么说，因为你的帮助我才能完成使命，把神器交到正确的人手里。至于天启，我觉得只有交给你才最为妥当。

希望它能帮你打败燃烧军团，死亡骑士。

english.title: The Call of Vengeance
english.objectives: Take the Death Gate to the Frozen Throne, and receive the Mark of the Lich King.
english.description:
I was wrong about you, death knight. Your assistance against the Dark Riders has proven a great service to the Light. Perhaps I should not be so quick to judge.

Nevertheless, you have allowed me to fill my purpose in returning these artifacts to their rightful owners. As for Apocalypse, I can think of no safer place than in your care. 

May it serve you well against the Legion, death knight.

enders.name: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼
大领主达里安·莫格莱尼

objectiveDetails.description: 使用黑锋之门前往阿彻鲁斯
使用黑锋之门前往冰封王座

text.title: 圣光与虚空
text.objectives: 帮助维伦执行他的神秘任务。
text.description: 阿隆索斯·法奥是一位强大的盟友，他果然没有看错你。有一个造福世界的任务，我认为只有你帮得上忙。$b$b我会带你前往艾泽拉斯以外的一个地方，完成我们一族在很久以前就开始的工作。你愿意帮助我们吗？

english.title: The Light and the Void
english.objectives: Aid Velen with his mysterious task.
english.description: Alonsus Faol has been a valuable ally, and his instincts about you have proven true. I believe you are uniquely suited to assist in a matter that will bring a great force of good into this world.$b$bI must take you somewhere far from Azeroth to finish a task my people began long ago. Will you aid us?

objectiveDetails.description: 聆听阿隆索斯·法奥说话
使用传送门前往虚空之光神殿
跟随维伦前往传送门处

text.title: Test Quest Two
text.description: 占位符

english.title: Test Quest Two
english.description: [PH]

text.title: 密报：突袭黑石矿坑
text.objectives: 突袭戈尔隆德黑石矿坑中的黑石部队。
text.description:
来自戈尔隆德黑石矿坑中的黑石大军是钢铁部落军队的中坚力量。如果我们能在他们自己的土地上粉碎他们的话，钢铁部落的其余成员就几乎没有跟我们抗衡的希望了。

要是你决意战斗，记得带上朋友一同前往。黑石氏族可没那么容易对付。

english.title: Missive: Assault on the Pit
english.objectives: Assault the Blackrock forces at the Pit in Gorgrond.
english.description:
The Blackrock forces based out of the Pit in Gorgrond make up the bulk of the Iron Horde army. If we crush them on their home soil, the rest of the Iron Horde will have little hope of standing against us.

If you choose the battle, bring friends. The Blackrock won't be defeated easily.

objectiveDetails.description: 突袭黑石矿坑中的黑石部队

text.title: 密报：突袭黑石矿坑
text.objectives: 突袭戈尔隆德黑石矿坑中的黑石兽人。
text.description:
来自戈尔隆德黑石矿坑中的黑石大军是钢铁部落军队的中坚力量。如果我们能在他们自己的土地上粉碎他们的话，钢铁部落的其余成员就几乎没有跟我们抗衡的希望了。

要是你决意战斗，记得带上朋友一同前往。黑石氏族可没那么容易对付。

english.title: Missive: Assault on the Pit
english.objectives: Assault the Blackrock orcs at the Pit in Gorgrond.
english.description:
The Blackrock forces based out of the Pit in Gorgrond make up the bulk of the Iron Horde army. If we crush them on their home soil, the rest of the Iron Horde will have little hope of standing against us.

If you choose the battle, bring friends. The Blackrock won't be defeated easily.

objectiveDetails.description: 突袭黑石矿坑中的黑石兽人

text.title: 密报：突袭沙塔斯市中心
text.objectives: 突袭塔拉多沙塔斯城的萨格雷军队。
text.description:
沙塔斯城中的萨格雷军力每天都在增强，而且变得越来越大胆。我们决不能再对他们的威胁置之不理了。

如果你想到城市深处去对抗萨格雷的话，记得叫上几个同伴。

english.title: Missive: Assault on the Heart of Shattrath
english.objectives: Assault the Sargerei force in Shattrath City in Talador.
english.description:
Sargerei forces from deep in Shattrath have grown stronger and bolder by the day. We can no longer risk ignoring the threat that they pose.

Bring allies if you wish to face the Sargerei so deep within the city.

objectiveDetails.description: 突袭沙塔斯城的萨格雷军队

text.title: 密报：突袭沙塔斯市中心
text.objectives: 突袭塔拉多沙塔斯城中的萨格雷军队。
text.description:
沙塔斯城中的萨格雷军力每天都在增强，而且变得越来越大胆。我们决不能再对他们的威胁置之不理了。

如果你想到城市深处去对抗萨格雷的话，记得叫上几个同伴。

english.title: Missive: Assault on the Heart of Shattrath
english.objectives: Assault the Sargerei forces deep within Shattrath City in Talador.
english.description:
Sargerei forces from deep in Shattrath have grown stronger and bolder by the day. We can no longer risk ignoring the threat that they pose.

Bring allies if you wish to face the Sargerei so deep within the city.

objectiveDetails.description: 突袭沙塔斯城的萨格雷军队

text.title: 特快专递
text.objectives: 用夜之子魔刃从夜之子信使身上取得3叠信件。
text.description:
维伦妮的孩子失踪了。我可以猜到发生了什么，但我必须确认一下。

大多数守卫使用信使传递敏感信息。这次事件中，只有高级官员才能管理魔法。

拿着这把魔刃。别碰刀刃。用它悄悄地伏击信使，然后收集他们携带的所有信件。

运气够好的话，这些公文会告诉我们到底该去哪里寻找那个女孩。

毕竟我们守卫可是无所不知的。

<希尔格林向你露出一个胜利的微笑>。

english.title: Special Delivery
english.objectives: Acquire 3 Stacks of Letters from Nightborne Couriers using the Nightborne Spellblade.
english.description:
Verene's child has gone missing. I can guess what happened, but I need to be sure.

Most guardsmen use couriers to relay delicate information. In this, magic is strictly the province of high ranking officials.

Take this blade. Do not touch the cutting edge. Use it to silently waylay the couriers and collect any correspondence they carry.

With any luck, the missives will tell us exactly where to find the girl.

We guards know everything, after all.

<Silgryn offers you a winning smile.>

text.title: 青山不改，绿水长流
text.objectives: 劝阻5只徘徊的月落角鹰兽。
text.description:
我一直在观察你，你不是他们的人。

<伊凡内尔轻轻咳嗽起来。>

我将不久于人世，但趁你在这里，有一件事我希望你能够做到。

角鹰兽们依旧在为自己的家园和月之守卫的伙伴奋勇战斗。它们还未接受月之守卫已经溃败的事实。

拜托……请送它们走吧。让它们知道，这里已经没有值得它们奋斗的东西了。

english.title: Not Their Last Stand
english.objectives: Dissuade 5 Lingering Moonfall Hippogryphs
english.description:
I've been watching you- you are not with them.

<Ivanel coughs quietly.>

I am not long for this world, but there is one thing I would have you do while you are here.

The hippogryphs here still fight bitterly to defend their home and their companions in the Moon Guard. They have not accepted that the Guard is no more. 

Please... send them away. Let them know there is nothing left for them to fight for here.

text.title: 庆祝成功
text.objectives: 你已成功取得神器，和影行者同胞一起庆祝一番。
text.description: 一切进展顺利。你的新武器就是最好的证明。$B$B今后，你和我们所有人都必须全力以赴。不过，如果不趁此机会好好庆祝一下的话，就太没劲了。$B$B你觉得呢？

english.title: Honoring Success
english.objectives: Celebrate the successful acquistion of your artifact with your fellow Shadows.
english.description: All has gone as planned. Your new blades are a testament to that.$B$BWe will demand a great deal of you in the weeks and months to come, as we must. But we would be remiss if we failed to take a moment to celebrate a job well done.$B$BWhat do you say?

text.title: 猎人对猎人
text.objectives: 前往达拉然的猎人用品店与伊墨瑞尔·影卫谈一谈。
text.description: 既然你拥有了萨斯多拉，现在是时候进一步了解让你踏上这段旅程的暗夜精灵了。$b$b我建议你返回猎人用品店，也就是你遇到我的信使的地方。不管这个伊墨瑞尔·影卫是谁，似乎她在对抗燃烧军团的战争中起着一定的作用。

english.title: Hunter to Hunter
english.objectives: Go to the Hunter's Reach shop in Dalaran and speak to Emmarel Shadewarden.
english.description: Now that you wield Thas'dorah, it's time to learn more about the night elf who set you on this journey$b$bI suggest returning to the Hunter's Reach shop where you met my courier. Whoever this Emmarel Shadewarden is, it seems she has some part to play in the war against the Legion.

text.title: 雄鹰之翼
text.objectives: 在至高岭的神射手营地与伊墨瑞尔·影卫见面。
text.description: 从遥远的时代以来，我的组织一直监视着破碎群岛，提防燃烧军团再次出现。我们只剩下了一小部分人……但是今天一切都变了。$b$b你手里的神器不仅仅是一件武器，它还是一个标志，遍布世界各地，拥有不同信仰的猎人们都会因它而集结。$b$b我知道你肯定有一肚子疑问。到至高岭的神射手营地跟我汇合，然后用自己的双眼去见证等待着我们的奇迹。我和雪羽会一起前往那里。

english.title: On Eagle's Wings
english.objectives: Meet Emmarel Shadewarden at Trueshot Lodge in Highmountain.
english.description: Since ancient times, my order has stood vigil on these Broken Isles, watching for the Legion's return. Only a handful of us remain... but that changes today.$b$bThe artifact you hold is more than a weapon. It is a symbol that will unite hunters of all kingdoms and creeds.$b$bI'm sure you have questions. Meet me at the Trueshot Lodge in Highmountain and see with your own eyes what awaits us. Snowfeather and I will make our own way there.

objectiveDetails.description: 在神射手营地与伊墨瑞尔·影卫见面
（可选）在克拉苏斯平台与飞行管理员交谈

text.title: 隐秘通途
text.objectives: 倾听伊墨瑞尔的故事。
text.description: 一千年以来，隐秘通途一直在监视、等待。我们的人数不多，在艾泽拉斯需要的时候，我们会静静地在幕后操作。只有一些必要的人知道我们组织的存在。$b$b但是，在暗影中徘徊的日子已经结束了。$b$b在我们开始行动以前，你应该进一步了解隐秘通途。

english.title: The Unseen Path
english.objectives: Hear Emmarel's tale.
english.description: For a thousand years, the Unseen Path has watched and waited. We remained few in number, quietly acting behind the scenes when Azeroth needed us. Only a select few even knew our group existed.$b$bBut the time for lingering in the shadows is over.$b$bBefore we begin our work, you should hear more about the Unseen Path.

text.title: 宣誓
text.objectives: 跪拜雄鹰雕像，并向隐秘通途宣誓。
text.description: 在你面前集结的是我们世界众多伟大的弓箭手、游侠、驯兽师和陷阱师，他们已经准备好跟燃烧军团作战。$b$b是时候让你踏出第一步，并逐渐成长为猎人们的真正领袖了。$b$b我们在篝火处聚集，在欧恩哈拉的雕像前面宣誓。在我宣读誓言的时候，跪拜并触摸雕像，这样隐秘通途就会得到重生！

english.title: Oath of Service
english.objectives: Kneel before the eagle statue and pledge your service to the Unseen Path.
english.description: Assembled before you are many of our world's greatest archers, rangers, beast masters, and trappers, ready to fight the Legion as one.$b$bIt is time to take your first step in becoming a true leader of hunters.$b$bWe gather at the fire pit and take our oaths of service before the statue of Ohn'ahra. Touch the statue and kneel before it while I recite the oath, and the Unseen Path will be reborn!

text.title: 传送侦测
text.objectives: 用传送道标侦测艾露尼斯废墟。
text.description: 该是为我们的传送网络建立第一个安全连接的时候了。$B$B把道标带到上面的艾露尼斯废墟，在那里进行侦测并找到一个合适的地点。$B$B侦测完毕以后就安置道标，我会从这里锚定连接。

english.title: Survey Says...
english.objectives: Use the Telemancy Beacon to survey the Ruins of Elune'eth.
english.description: It is time to establish the first secure connection in our teleportation network.$B$BTake this beacon to the Ruins of Elune'eth above us and survey the area to find a suitable location.$B$BOnce your survey is complete, place the beacon and I will anchor a connection to it from here.

text.title: 战术考量
text.objectives: 在神射手营地与战术家蒂德菲尔谈一谈。
text.description: 既然你的神器已经就绪，是时候计划对燃烧军团发起攻击了。$b$b去找战术家蒂德菲尔谈一谈，他是这方面的专家。

english.title: Tactical Matters
english.objectives: Speak to Tactician Tinderfell in the Trueshot Lodge.
english.description: Now that your artifact is ready, it's time to plan your first strike against the Legion.$b$bSpeak to Tactician Tinderfell, our expert on such matters.

text.title: 反击开始
text.objectives: 在指挥地图上选择首个攻击地点。
text.description: 燃烧军团以为我们还在破碎海滩的挫败中萎靡不振。$B$B让我们证明他们错了。$B$B我们的斥候绘制了破碎群岛的地图，并且努力打探各地的情报，为我们即将发起的攻击做准备。$b$b选择首个出击地点，并亲率隐秘通途出征。

english.title: The Campaign Begins
english.objectives: Choose an initial assault point on the Command Map
english.description: The Legion believes we are still reeling from our loss on the Broken Shore.$B$BLet's prove them wrong.$B$BOur scouts have mapped out the Broken Isles, learning everything we can about each region for our imminent assault.$b$bChoose where to strike first, and you will lead the Unseen Path's efforts personally.

text.title: 夜明珠
text.objectives: 把夜明珠带给达拉然的大法师卡德加。
text.description: 你在鱼钩上面发现了一颗与众不同的珍珠。它散发出一道恒定的冷光，而且它的大小和重量在你的手中不断变化。$b$b这明显是一件魔法物品，应该把它带给魔法方面的专业人士。

english.title: Luminous Pearl
english.objectives: Bring the Luminous Pearl to Archmage Khadgar in Dalaran.
english.description: Balanced upon your fishing hook, you find a pearl unlike any other you've seen before. It shines with a cold, steady light, and its size and weight fluctuate in your hand.$b$bThis is clearly a magical item, and should be brought to a magical person.

text.title: 达拉然喷泉
text.objectives: 把夜明珠放到达拉然的喷泉里面。
text.description: 这是你钓上来的，真的假的？我……我不是很确定你想让我做什么。过来吧。$b$b<卡德加轻轻地拍了拍你的头。>$b$b“干得好。”$b$b至于这颗珍珠嘛……看起来确实是一件魔法物品，但是我也没有更多的了解。如果把它放到达拉然的喷泉里面，应该会挺漂亮的吧？

english.title: The Dalaran Fountain
english.objectives: Bring the Luminous Pearl to the fountain in Dalaran.
english.description: You fished this up, did you? I'm... not quite sure what you want ME to do about that. Here.$b$b<Khadgar pats you on the head.>$b$b"Good job."$b$bWith regard to the pearl... it does seem to be magical, but I couldn't tell you much more than that. Perhaps it might look nice in the Dalaran fountain?

text.title: 黑暗之水
text.objectives: 陪伴玛法里奥前往月神湖，揭示混沌残片的本质。
text.description: 跟我去月神湖畔吧。它晶莹剔透的湖水可以净化最黑暗的面纱，揭示其内在的本质。

english.title: Dark Waters
english.objectives: Accompany Malfurion to Elune'ara to reveal the nature of the Remnant of Chaos.
english.description: Come with me to the edge of Elune'ara. Its crystal waters can wash away even the darkest shroud to reveal the truth within.

objectiveDetails.description: 陪伴玛法里奥前往月神湖

text.title: 角鹰兽之爪
text.objectives: 吸引3只野生月落角鹰兽，并利用它们干掉月落栖木的夜之子。
text.description:
我们应该预料到这个结果。我的姐妹死了，我的朋友受了伤，而我们也很有可能死在这里。

我要复仇。

<莱瑞娅将一个装满绿色液体的瓶子交给了你。>

我们无法战胜他们，但我们可以利用这座要塞来对抗他们。

野生的角鹰兽们会被这个瓶子的味道所吸引过来。如果吸引它们的东西实际上并不是角鹰兽，野生的角鹰兽就会变得极为狂暴。

我们可以利用它来清出一条通往要塞内部的道路。

english.title: Take Them in Claw
english.objectives: Attract 3 Wild Moonfall Hippogryphs to deal with the Nightborne at Moonfall Roost.
english.description:
We should have seen this coming. My sister is dead, my friends are wounded and we will likely die here.

I want revenge.

<Lyrea hands you a vial full of growing green liquid.>

We cannot beat them, but we can turn the Stronghold against them.

Wild hippogryphs are attracted to the scent in this bottle. Wild hippogryphs are also notoriously violent when the object of their attraction is not a hippogryph.

Use it to clear a path deeper into the stronghold.

text.title: 夹缝求生
text.objectives: 在图书馆中找到洛休斯·唤月。
text.description:
夜之子涌入要塞的时候，我跟洛休斯在一起。

他和他的构造体设法将我们大多数人送出了图书馆，但他自己却没能及时逃出来，还被敌人给包围了。

我知道他还活着——我感觉得到！但我没法回去救他，我的伤势太严重了。

大嘴会把你带到我们最后见到洛休斯的地方。你准备好了就告诉它。

快点去吧，祝你好运！

english.title: The Rift Between
english.objectives: Locate Lothrius Mooncaller in the Athenaeum.
english.description:
I was with Lothrius when the Nightborne poured into the stronghold.
