He and his constructs managed to get the majority of us out of the Athenaeum, but he was cornered before he could make good on his own escape.

I know he still lives- I feel it in my gut!- but I cannot go back for him myself. My injuries are too severe.

Beakbuck will take you to where we last saw Lothrius. Simply let him know when you are ready to leave.

Go quickly, and good luck!

text.title: 设置陷阱
text.objectives: 用陷阱符文消灭50个夜之子。
text.description:
他们洗劫了我的图书馆，$n。

如果他们想要领教一下我们的知识，那我们就让他们见识一下。

这张符文可以让你在地面上设下一道法术陷阱。当夜之子们越过陷阱时，他们就将见识到月之守卫的真正力量。

给他们点颜色看看！

english.title: Lay Waste, Lay Mines
english.objectives: Slay 50 Nightborne With the Trap Rune.
english.description:
They ransacked my library, $n.

If they want our knowledge, we will give it to them. 

This piece of rune work will allow you to cast an ensnaring spell on the ground. When the Nightborne cross the threshold they will see the true might of the Moon Guard.

Teach them well!

text.title: 硕果仅存
text.objectives: 找到《月之守卫全集》、《论月亮的魔力表征》和《永恒之井的余波》。
text.description:
有三本魔典对我们一族相当重要，不过我不能丢下我的守卫不管而自己去寻找。

魔典里的秘密和咒语万万不能落入夜之子的手里。

<洛休斯把手伸向你的额头，三本魔典的名称在你的脑海中浮现>

如果我们无法打败他们，我们就必须尽量保管好我们的资源。抓紧时间，$n。

english.title: Precious Little Left
english.objectives: Locate and recover "Anthology of the Guard", "Magical Manifest of the Moon", and "Aftermath of the Well".
english.description:
I have not been able to leave the safety of my guardians to search, but there are three tomes of great importance to me and mine. 

They contain secrets and cantrips that the Nightborne must NOT obtain. 

<Lothrius raises his hand to your forehead, cementing the names of three tomes into your mind> 

If we cannot best them, we must preserve all we can. Hurry, $n.

text.title: 恢复失窃能量
text.objectives: 获取一个不稳定的法术焦镜。
text.description:
虽然我的伤不致命，却让我失去了战斗能力。对于怎么解决剩下的夜之子，我已经有了主意。

他们一来就破坏了我们的防御矩阵。所以他们中肯定有人带着重新激活矩阵所需的法术焦镜。

把焦镜找出来，然后乘上一只角鹰兽。它们会在堡垒周围盘桓。

这些忠诚的野兽会带着你飞向天空，完成剩下的工作。

english.title: Recovering Stolen Power
english.objectives: Acquire a Volatile Spell Focus.
english.description:
My injuries will not kill me, but I cannot fight. I have my own idea of how to deal with the remaining Nightborne.

They destroyed our defense matrix as soon as they arrived. Surely one of them carries the spell focus necessary to reactivate it.

Find it, then go to a hippogryph. They linger throughout the Stronghold.

These loyal beasts will take you to the skies and take care of the rest.

text.title: 织星的命运
text.objectives: 寻找赛拉娜·织星
text.description:
我会把这些魔典交给萨伦努斯。

我还有一件非常担心的事，我想请你替我处理。

我妻子及人生伴侣赛拉娜·织星就住在桥对面的织星圣殿里。夜之子进入堡垒没多久那里就沦陷了。

如果她还活着，就必须让她知道我们的行动。我们非常需要她的力量。

替我转达我的问候，我随后就会跟上。

english.title: Starweaver's Fate
english.objectives: Locate Syrana Starweaver
english.description:
I will take these tomes to Thalrenus.

There is one thing that weighs heavily on my mind, and I would like for you to attend to it in my stead. 

My wife and life partner, Syrana Starweaver, resides in the Starweaver's Sanctum across the bridge. It fell shortly after the Nightborne entered the Stronghold. 

If she still lives she will need to know of our efforts. Her power is sorely needed. 

Give her my best- I will be along shortly.

text.title: 谱写哀歌
text.objectives: 消灭咒法师泰勒里安并取得星术师的钥石。
text.description:
我们必须阻止咒法师泰勒里安。

在他到来之后，他就立刻发现了我父亲的秘密研究资料，并再也没有出现过。我担心他已经找到了那件非常危险的东西。

它叫做“星术师的钥石”。它的作用是操纵这座要塞的防御系统。

这道魔法本来是用来保护月之守卫的，但后来却被用于其它的目的，并最终变成了极具毁灭性的武器。

你必须夺回钥石。如果必要的话，就杀死咒法师泰勒里安。

english.title: The Orchestrator of Our Demise
english.objectives: Slay Conjurer Thalerian and acquire the Astromancer's Keystone.
english.description:
Conjurer Thalerian must be stopped.

He immediately sought out my father's private study when he arrived and he has not yet emerged. I worry that he may have found a very dangerous item.

It is called the Astromancer's Keystone. It is used to manipulate the stronghold's defenses.

Such magic was meant to protect the Moon Guard- used for any other purpose and it becomes unspeakably destructive.

Retrieve the Keystone. Slay Conjurer Thalerian to get it, if you must.

text.title: 强力干扰
text.objectives: 利用惰性水晶超载3个皇家咒法师。你必须站在魔力聚焦器上才能使用这块水晶。
text.description:
你看到房间外面的夜之子了吗？

他们将我们困在了这里，就像笼子里的老鼠一样。只要将我们困住，他们就能轻松地在密室中寻找我父亲的遗物。

我和同伴们可以想办法逃到更高的地方。

拿上这块水晶。当你站在魔力聚焦符文上面时，你就可以用它来超载敌人的咒法师。

他们的召唤物将反戈对抗他们，并为我们打开一条通路。

好好地利用它。等道路扫清后，我们在要塞顶部汇合。

english.title: Overwhelming Distraction
english.objectives: Overcharge 3 Imperial Conjurers using the Inert Crystal. You must be standing on a Mana Focuser to use the crystal.
english.description:
Do you see the Nightborne outside this room?

They hold us here, like mice in a cage. It is more convenient for them that we are pinned down while they search the Sanctum for my father's relics.

My companions and I can escape to higher ground with some help.

Take this crystal. While standing on a mana focusing rune, use it to overcharge a Conjurer.

Their summons will turn on them and create an opening.

Use it well, and we will meet you atop the stronghold when the way is clear.

text.title: 月之守卫的最后一搏
text.objectives: 与萨伦努斯、洛休斯和赛拉娜一起离开月之守卫要塞。
text.description:
剩下的月之守卫全在这里了。

好好看一看吧。

我们只是曾经先辈们的遗族，而夜之子则为我们带来了毁灭。

现在，我们已经没有了任何的选择。如果我们想要活下去，就必须立刻离开这里。

君子报仇，十年不晚。

english.title: Last Stand of the Moon Guard
english.objectives: Leave Moon Guard Stronghold with Thalrenus, Lothrius, and Syrana.
english.description:
This is all that remains of the Moon Guard.

Take a good look.

We are but a shadow of our former selves, and we have the Nightborne to thank for our demise.

For now there is nothing more we can do. If we want to live, we must leave immediately.

Retribution can wait.

text.title: Creating Time
text.objectives: Defend Syrana Starweaver.
text.description:
Thanks in large part to your substantial efforts, we have discovered the whereabouts of a powerful piece of our history. It should enable us to survive whatever else the Nightborne have to throw at us, and hopefully more.

However, recovering it will require a great deal of our energy and focus. We will bolster the Starweaver's scrying efforts, but the slightest disruption will ruin this delicate spellwork. See that we are not disturbed.

Speak to Syrana Starweaver when you are ready to begin.

english.title: Creating Time
english.objectives: Defend Syrana Starweaver.
english.description:
Thanks in large part to your substantial efforts, we have discovered the whereabouts of a powerful piece of our history. It should enable us to survive whatever else the Nightborne have to throw at us, and hopefully more.

However, recovering it will require a great deal of our energy and focus. We will bolster the Starweaver's scrying efforts, but the slightest disruption will ruin this delicate spellwork. See that we are not disturbed.

Speak to Syrana Starweaver when you are ready to begin.

text.title: Latosius' Trial
text.objectives: Survive the Trial of Latosius.
text.description: I bow to Latosius' wisdom. If we are to endure, it must be you who claims the Amulet. Survive this challenge, $n, and the might of the Moon Guard will be yours forevermore.

english.title: Latosius' Trial
english.objectives: Survive the Trial of Latosius.
english.description: I bow to Latosius' wisdom. If we are to endure, it must be you who claims the Amulet. Survive this challenge, $n, and the might of the Moon Guard will be yours forevermore.

text.title: 酋长的接见
text.objectives: 与萨鲁法尔大王谈一谈。
text.description: 欢迎来到奥格瑞玛，这里是部落的心脏。$b$b这里的氛围很紧张，恶魔猎手。沃金酋长在破碎群岛的激战中受了重伤。$B$B在别人怀疑你来这里的动机之前，你最好先主动向部落请缨。$b$b城里的防务都由萨鲁法尔大王负责。虽然他十分提防伊利达雷，不过我觉得他应该会给你一个证明自己的机会。$b$b去跟他谈谈，申请进入格罗玛什要塞的许可。

english.title: Audience with the Warchief
english.objectives: Speak to High Overlord Saurfang.
english.description: Welcome to Orgrimmar, the Horde's seat of power.$b$bTensions are running high, demon hunter. Warchief Vol'jin was gravely wounded in a disastrous assault on the Broken Shore.$B$BI suggest you offer your skills in service of the Horde before your presence is... misinterpreted.$b$bHigh Overlord Saurfang commands the city's defenses. Though wary of the Illidari, I believe he will give you a chance to prove your worth.$b$bSpeak to him and request passage into Grommash Hold.

text.title: 洞察视觉
text.objectives: 使用幽灵视觉。
text.description: 希尔瓦娜斯出任大酋长的事情有许多争议。她生前是一位人尽皆知的优秀游侠。但是，自从她经历天灾成为女妖之王后，就连她自己的一些同胞也对她失去了信任。$B$B燃烧军团只要发现我们内部有一点混乱的迹象，就会立刻打过来。$B$B我现在都能感觉到哪里不太对劲，$n。恐怕事情没有看起来那么简单。$B$B快使用幽灵视觉。我们必须确认有没有敌人隐藏在我们当中。

english.title: Second Sight
english.objectives: Use your Spectral Sight.
english.description: Sylvanas becoming Warchief may be problematic. In life she was a proud ranger, known to many in our ranks. But since the Scourge took her, some of her own allies do not trust the Banshee Queen.$B$BThe Legion will strike at the first hint of dissension.$B$BEven now, I sense something amiss, $n. I fear that not all is as it seems.$B$BQuickly, use your Spectral Sight. We must know if there are foes among us!

text.title: 恶魔四伏
text.objectives: 保护酋长。
text.description: 果然不出我们所料，$n！恶魔还以为他们可以偷袭我们。$B$B快点，武装起来！保护女妖之王！

english.title: Demons Among Them
english.objectives: Protect the Warchief.
english.description: It is just as we suspected, $n! The demons thought they could take us by surprise.$B$BQuickly, to arms! Protect the Banshee Queen!

objectiveDetails.description: 警告大酋长希尔瓦娜斯

text.title: 黑暗骑士
text.objectives: 在卡拉赞墓穴打败黑暗骑士并取得天启。
text.description:
地下墓穴？我从没听说过这种地方。难道他指的是那里……

河流边上有一扇下水道格栅，它可以通向卡拉赞的地下墓穴。我以前从没留意过它，不过那里可能就是幽灵所说的地方。

想一想，黑暗骑士可能一直都在我们眼皮子底下！走吧，我们去看看里面会有什么。

english.title: The Dark Riders
english.objectives: Defeat the Dark Riders in the Karazhan Catacombs and claim Apocalypse.
english.description:
The catacombs? I've never heard of such a place. Unless, he means...

There's a sewer grate along the edge of the river leading to a catacombs underneath Karazhan. I've never paid it much attention, but it could lead to the catacombs that the spirit spoke of. 

To think, the Dark Riders may have been under our noses this entire time! Come, let us see where this leads.

text.title: 复仇的呼唤
text.objectives: 使用黑锋之门前往冰封王座，并获取巫妖王的印记。
text.description:
我们的目标已经达成，死亡骑士，是时候说再见了。我想我会很高兴和你分道扬镳的。

走吧，回去找你的黑暗主人。我们到此为止吧。

english.title: The Call of Vengeance
english.objectives: Take the Death Gate to the Frozen Throne, and receive the Mark of the Lich King.
english.description:
Our goals have been met, death knight, and it is time we part ways.  I think I will be glad to see the last of you.

Go on, return to your dark masters. We are done here.

enders.name: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼
大领主达里安·莫格莱尼

objectiveDetails.description: 使用黑锋之门前往阿彻鲁斯
使用黑锋之门前往冰封王座

text.title: 厨师太多
text.objectives: 在达拉然与诺米见面。
text.description: 你好。我叫诺米。$b$b我不禁注意到你刚才捡起的一张食谱……好吧，你可能难以置信，不过我也算是一位厨师。$b$b不幸的是，我的战斗能力有限，而这个地方又十分危险。相反，你显然是一位厉害的$c。$b$b到达拉然找我。也许我们可以合作一下！
text.completion: $C! I was hoping you'd come back.$b$bHere, take a sample of some of the recipes and dishes I've been working on.

english.title: Too Many Cooks
english.objectives: Meet Nomi in Dalaran.
english.description: Greetings. I am called Nomi.$b$bI couldn't help but notice that recipe that you just picked up and... well, you'd never guess it, but I'm a bit of a chef myself.$b$bUnfortunately, I'm not much of a fighter, and this place is dangerous. You, on the other hand, are clearly an accomplished $c.$b$bCome find me in Dalaran. Maybe we can work together!
english.completion: $C! I was hoping you'd come back.$b$bHere, take a sample of some of the recipes and dishes I've been working on.

text.title: 大方的副厨师长
text.objectives: 在达拉然与诺米见面。
text.description: $n？大师，是你吗？$b$b你不认得我了吗？我是诺米呀！我们曾经在潘达利亚一起烹饪，记得吗？更准确地说，是你烹饪，我学习。我那时候还只是个小崽子。$b$b哇，见到你真高兴！$b$b我要回达拉然的厨房了。来找我吧！也许我们可以合作一下！

english.title: The Prodigal Sous Chef
english.objectives: Meet Nomi in Dalaran.
english.description: $n? Master, is that you?$b$bDon't you recognize me? It's me, Nomi! Remember, we cooked together in Pandaria? More accurately, you cooked and I learned. I was not much more than a cub back then.$b$bBoy, am I glad to see you!$b$bI'm headed back to the Dalaran kitchens. Come find me! Maybe we can work together!

text.title: 精选食谱单
text.objectives: 学习6份军团再临烹饪食谱。
text.description: 我尝试过去外面冒险，但那不适合我。烹饪才是我的热情所在：火炉的热浪，培根滋滋作响的声音……没有什么比得上。$b$b让我来帮你，$n大师。如果你给我一些食谱，我就可以在达拉然为你进行改良。$b$b我们会成为一个优秀的团队。你觉得呢？
text.completion: You are truly amazing, Master $n.$b$bNow, let's get to work, shall we?

english.title: A Good Recipe List
english.objectives: Learn 6 Legion cooking recipes.
english.description: I've tried adventuring, and it isn't for me. Cooking is my one true passion: the heat of the stove, the sizzle of bacon... nothing beats it.$b$bLet me help you, Master $n. If you can bring me some recipes, I can work on improving them, here in Dalaran.$b$bWe'll make a great team. What do you say?
english.completion: You are truly amazing, Master $n.$b$bNow, let's get to work, shall we?

text.title: 实验厨房开张
text.objectives: 取得5条诺米的银鲭鱼，然后交给诺米进行研究。
text.description: 我会烹饪，但是我对打猎、钓鱼之类的事很不在行。$b$b不过，如果你把食材交给我的话，我就可以用它们来帮你研究新的食谱。$b$b我们可以先从我收集到的鱼开始。你在厨房后面的桶里就可以找到它们了。

english.title: Opening the Test Kitchen
english.objectives: Obtain 5 of Nomi's Silver Mackerel, then bring them to Nomi to research.
english.description: I can cook, but I can't really hunt... or even fish, for that matter.$b$bIf you bring me ingredients, however, I will use them to research new recipes for you.$b$bWe can start with the few fish I managed to scrounge up. You'll find them in the barrel in the back of the kitchen.

text.title: 理想工具
text.objectives: 在暗影大厅与马林·诺格弗格谈一谈。
text.description: 你使用的武器是艾泽拉斯数一数二的，不过我们必须未雨绸缪。敌军正在不断壮大，你会因为自己的武器而成为他们的眼中钉。$B$B到旁边的无冕宝库和马林·诺格弗格谈谈，他最近完成了一项工程，你会感兴趣的。

english.title: Right Tools for the Job
english.objectives: Speak to Marin Noggenfogger in the Hall of Shadows.
english.description: The blades you wield are among the most powerful in all of Azeroth, but we must always remain two steps ahead of the enemy. Even now their armies grow in strength, and those weapons will make you a prime target for their assassins.$B$BSpeak with Marin Noggenfogger in the Uncrowned Vault next door. He recently completed a project which you will find most intriguing.

text.title: 注入力量
text.objectives: 说服马林·诺格弗格让你使用无冕者锻炉，以强化你的神器。
text.description: 力量？没错！你找对人了！$B$B我们从南海的一座无名岛屿上，搞到了一种罕见的毒素。我们有充足的货源。$B$B我让手下造了一个可以将毒素注入武器的装置，不过我们还没有完全掌握毒素的功效，所以只能注入较少的剂量。$B$B我们把它锁在了那边的管制区里。你可以随意使用，影行者$n……当然，你需要花点钱！

english.title: Injection of Power
english.objectives: Convince Marin Noggenfogger to allow you to use the Crucible of the Uncrowned, then use it to empower your artifact.
english.description: Power, eh? You bet! I got just the thing!$B$BWe've managed to get our hands on a rare venom from an uncharted island deep in the south seas. We captured as much of it as we could.$B$BI had my boys build a device that can inject the venom into weapons, but just in small quantities for now until we've got a better handle on its effects.$B$BAnywho, we got it locked up in a secure area just over there. You're free to use it, Shadow $n... for a price, of course!

text.title: 有事相求
text.objectives: 与多嘴的尼基谈一谈。
text.description: 听着，我才不会当你的人生导师……那是要收费的……不过我愿意给你一点建议。$b$b只要能找到倒霉鬼帮你做事，就千万不要自己动手。$B$B这里有一个公共，呃……叫做“公告板”的东西，就在旅店外面。我的好朋友尼基可以用那玩意帮你搞到任何东西。$B$B你应该去见见她。

english.title: Delegation
english.objectives: Speak to Nikki the Gossip.
english.description: Look, I won't tell ya how to live your life... not for free, anyways... but I will pass along one bit of advice.$b$bDon't do an ounce of work if you can find some sucker to do it for you.$B$BThere's a communal, uh... "bulletin board," let's call it, right outside the tavern. My buddy Nikki can help you get just about anything usin' that board.$B$BYou should hit her up.

text.title: 瞬间致命
text.objectives: 选择你在破碎群岛的首个攻击目标。
text.description: 听说你打算前往破碎群岛。这是真的吗？$B$B那里的消息传出来以后，我们就开始仔细查阅所有书籍、秘典和文献。我们整理了一份相当全面的报告！你最好先看一下。$B$B这个公告板是无冕者的一个奇妙工具，你在这里的时候可以用它悬赏某个国王的首级或是灌魔的布料。不管想到什么，只要写在上面，你的手下就会帮你处理。

english.title: Lethal Efficiency
english.objectives: Select your first assault point on the Broken Isles.
english.description: Word is you're headin' down to the Broken Isles. That true?$B$BSoon as news got out about the place, we combed through every book, tome, and paper we could get our hands on. We put together quite the report! You should take a look.$B$BWhile you're here, this board is where the magic of the Uncrowned happens. You can put a bounty on a king's head, offer a reward for felsilk cloth... just jot down your latest whim and your agents will take care of it.

text.title: King Forgalash's Burden
text.objectives: Retrieve Forgalash's Prow from King Forgalash in Forgalash's Den.
text.description: That sea witch spoke the truth.$B$BI witnessed the Tidemistress confer with King Forgalash on several occasions.$B$BKill Forgalash and bring the prow from his shoulder to Fjolrik as proof of his demise.$B$BI will meet afterwards in the center of Jandvik. I need to warm myself by its fires.

english.title: King Forgalash's Burden
english.objectives: Retrieve Forgalash's Prow from King Forgalash in Forgalash's Den.
english.description: That sea witch spoke the truth.$B$BI witnessed the Tidemistress confer with King Forgalash on several occasions.$B$BKill Forgalash and bring the prow from his shoulder to Fjolrik as proof of his demise.$B$BI will meet afterwards in the center of Jandvik. I need to warm myself by its fires.

text.title: 粉碎萨吉塔
text.objectives: 在萨吉塔废墟消灭12个萨吉塔纳迦。
text.description: 萨吉塔的数量或许是减少了，但是潮汐主母的身边全是厉害的纳迦。$B$B是时候给萨吉塔最后一击了。$B$B如果我们现在可以打败他们，那我们或许可以彻底清除他们的威胁，拯救贾德维克。

english.title: Shatter the Sashj'tar
english.objectives: Kill 12 Sashj'tar naga in the Sashj'tar Ruins.
english.description: The Sashj'tar forces may have dwindled, but the Tidemistress has surrounded herself with her fiercest naga.$B$BThis is the time to strike a final crushing blow against the Sashj'tar.$B$BIf we can defeat them now, we may finally break the back of this menace and save Jandvik.

text.title: 部落的武器
text.objectives: 在奥格瑞玛的伊利达雷营地向艾尔西·达莱报到。
text.description: 看来我低估了你最重要的价值。$b$b我们需要你的同胞来面对接下来的战争。我将要猎杀这些恶魔直到艾泽拉斯的尽头，而你的同胞将成为我射向他们的利箭。$b$b回去告诉你那些现在身处奥格瑞玛的伊利达雷同胞，做好准备为部落效忠吧。$b$b但不要忘记，你的同胞曾经侍奉过那个背叛者。要是你们胆敢背叛我，那么我的复仇将永无止境，你们将无处可逃。

english.title: A Weapon of the Horde
english.objectives: Report to Elthyn Da'rai at the Illidari camp in Orgrimmar.
english.description: It would seem I underestimated your initial value.$b$bWe will have need of your kind in the coming war. I plan to hunt these demons to the ends of Azeroth, and your kind will be the arrow I shall loose upon them.$b$bTell your Illidari within Orgrimmar to make ready to serve the Horde.$b$bBut make no mistake, your kind once served the Betrayer. Betray me, and there is no world you can run to that will save you from my vengeance.

text.title: 皇帝的礼物
text.objectives: 从永春台取回神龙，迷雾之杖。去找泰克泰克以飞往永春台。
text.description: 啊，神龙，末代皇帝所持有的传奇法杖。如果燃烧军团取得这把武器，他们会释放出难以言喻的恐惧，席卷整片大陆。必须阻止他们！$b$b要尽快赶到永春台的话，你应该搭个便车，直接前往大陆。猢狲风筝大师，泰克泰克就躲在寺庙的西边。快去找他，别耽误了。

english.title: The Emperor's Gift
english.objectives: Retrieve Sheilun, Staff of the Mists, from the Terrace of Eternal Spring. See Tak-Tak to fly directly to the Terrace.
english.description: Ah, Sheilun, the legendary staff wielded by our last emperor. If the Legion were to acquire this weapon, they could unleash untold horrors across the whole of the continent. They must be stopped!$b$bIf you want to get to the Terrace as fast as possible, you should hitch a ride directly to the mainland. Tak-Tak, a hozen kite-master, is skulking around west of the temple. Speak to him without delay.

objectiveDetails.description: 跟泰克泰克一起飞回家

text.title: Hunter to Hunter
text.objectives: Returno the Hunter's Reach shop in Dalaran and speak to Emmarel Shadewarden.
text.description: I sense the threads of fate entwined about you. Your destiny is tied to that of the ancient night elf who started you on this journey.$b$bI can send you back to the city in the sky. From there, you must begin the task of gathering allies against the ravenous darkness.$b$bFight well, $n. May Talonclaw serve you well.

english.title: Hunter to Hunter
english.objectives: Returno the Hunter's Reach shop in Dalaran and speak to Emmarel Shadewarden.
english.description: I sense the threads of fate entwined about you. Your destiny is tied to that of the ancient night elf who started you on this journey.$b$bI can send you back to the city in the sky. From there, you must begin the task of gathering allies against the ravenous darkness.$b$bFight well, $n. May Talonclaw serve you well.

text.title: 猎人对猎人
text.objectives: 前往达拉然的猎人用品店与伊墨瑞尔·影卫谈一谈。
text.description: 现在你得到了泰坦之击，你应该进一步了解让我们踏上这段旅程的暗夜精灵。$b$b她或许也回到了猎人用品店，也就是你遇到她的地方。不管这个伊墨瑞尔·影卫是谁，我敢用胡子打赌，她在对抗燃烧军团的战争中有一席之地。$b$b再次感谢你带来这么多乐趣，$n。如果你需要我的话，只要召唤我就可以了！

english.title: Hunter to Hunter
english.objectives: Go to the Hunter's Reach shop in Dalaran and speak to Emmarel Shadewarden.
english.description: Now that Titanstrike is yours, ye should learn more about the night elf who set us on this journey.$b$bShe might well be back at the Hunter's Reach shop where you met her. Whoever this Emmarel Shadewarden is, I'd bet me beard she has some part to play in the war against the Legion!$b$bThanks again fer the fun, $n. If ye ever have need of me, just call!

text.title: 狂乱的鱼
text.objectives: 跟着纳特·帕格前往薄暮岛礁，然后处理该区域所有的鱼。
text.description: $N！$b$b<气喘吁吁>$b$b你一定得看看！鱼，到处……到处都是鱼！$b$b就在瓦尔莎拉的海岸上，有什么东西让它们陷入了狂乱。$b$b我这辈子都没见过这么疯狂的钓鱼活动！$b$b我在下面有艘船。拿上你的鱼竿，我会带你到那里去！

english.title: Fish Frenzy
english.objectives: Follow Nat Pagle to the Gloaming Reef, then dispatch all of the fish in the area.
english.description: $N!$b$b<pant, pant>$b$bYou've got to see it! The fish, they're... they're everywhere!$b$bOff the coast of Val'sharah, something's whipping them up into a frenzy.$b$bI've never seen better fishing in my life!$b$bI've got a boat down below. Grab your pole and I'll take you there!

objectiveDetails.description: 在达拉然与纳特·帕格交谈
Obtain a crystal from Shardmaster Ufrogg

text.title: 神器需神工
text.objectives: 在虚空之光神殿与贝蒂尔德·深砧谈一谈。
text.description: 你的武器非常强大，但是我们千万不能松懈。我“请”来了一位精通锻造和附魔的矮人专家。$b$b你应该找贝蒂尔德谈谈，看看她能不能为你的武器灌魔，进一步挖掘它的潜能。

english.title: Artifacts Need Artificers
english.objectives: Speak with Betild Deepanvil in Netherlight Temple.
english.description: Your weapon is indeed powerful, but we shouldn't rest on our laurels. I've managed to procure one of the dwarves' foremost experts on artifice and enchanting.$b$bI'd like you to speak with Betild and see if she can't infuse the weapon with even greater potency.

text.title: 强化神器
text.objectives: 使用光影祭坛。
text.description: 既然你坚决要用那个东西来对付艾泽拉斯的每一个恶魔，我们就来看看能不能激发它的潜力。我借助萨拉的力量改造了这个德莱尼祭坛，你可以在这里集中……呃，我们跳过这个部分，好吗？$b$b把那东西插进去，然后转动一下，可以吗？

english.title: Empowering Your Artifact
english.objectives: Use the Altar of Light and Shadow.
english.description: Since ye're bound an' determined ta crack that thing against every demon on Azeroth, let's see if we can't squeeze what we can out of it. With Saa'ra's power I've reworked this 'ere draenei altar into somethin' ye can use to focus... eh, let's skip that part, shall we?$b$bJust stick the thing in there and give it a whirl!

objectiveDetails.description: 使用光影祭坛强化你的神器

text.title: 艾泽拉斯总动员
text.objectives: 使用指挥地图为你的组织选出首个行动地点。
text.description: 我来带你看看指挥地图。这是一扇结合了德莱尼技术和纳鲁魔法的窗口，可以让我们观察破碎群岛！你可以在这里安排策略，派遣部下执行任务，以及选择我们的首个行动地点。$b$b你先看一下，再告诉我接下来的计划！

english.title: Actions on Azeroth
english.objectives: Use the Command Map to select your order's first operational area.
english.description: Let me show you the Command Map. Some draenei construction and naaru magic we have a window into the Broken Isles! Here you can devise strategy, send your agents on missions, and choose our first area to operate in.$b$bTake a look and let me know where we are going!

text.title: One Last Breath
text.objectives: Drink the Nightfallen Alchemist's Strange Draught in Azuregale Bay.
text.description: <The parchment is soaked in seawater. A note is hastily scribbled on it.>$B$BTo whomever finds this note first,$B$BBefore I was cast from Suramar, I was a master alchemist. In my time, I have concocted many potions and elixirs for the benefit of the Nightborne.$B$BAll of this was forgotten when the Legion came.$B$BBefore I succumb to the hunger, I wanted to create one last draught to celebrate my love of sea.$B$BDrink it and explore the vast deep in my honor.

english.title: One Last Breath
english.objectives: Drink the Nightfallen Alchemist's Strange Draught in Azuregale Bay.
english.description: <The parchment is soaked in seawater. A note is hastily scribbled on it.>$B$BTo whomever finds this note first,$B$BBefore I was cast from Suramar, I was a master alchemist. In my time, I have concocted many potions and elixirs for the benefit of the Nightborne.$B$BAll of this was forgotten when the Legion came.$B$BBefore I succumb to the hunger, I wanted to create one last draught to celebrate my love of sea.$B$BDrink it and explore the vast deep in my honor.

text.title: 电力网
text.objectives: 在魔网节点：泰安诺为月之封印、星之封印、兽之封印和精灵封印充能。
text.description: 这座站台年久失修。线路已经损坏，我们需要给中央房间里的封印充能才能修复。$B$B每个封印都需要高能电流和低能电流。将两条电流指向同一个封印，然后将其启动。$B$B至于我，我在一旁监督。毕竟请你帮忙。

english.title: Power Grid
english.objectives: Charge the Moon Seal, Star Seal, Beast Seal and Elven Seal in Ley Station: Tel'Anor.
english.description: This station has fallen into disrepair. The circuit is broken, and to mend it we must recharge the seals in the central chamber.$B$BBoth a high potency current and low potency current are needed for each seal. Direct the currents to point at the same seal, then engage the seal.$B$BMe? I shall supervise. You are the help, after all.

text.title: 回收魔印
text.objectives: 收集7个月之守卫徽记。
text.description:
光滑的方形徽记非常沉重，从外表完全看不出来。

你把它握在手中，掌心传来一股剧烈的刺痛感。这件物品汇聚着纯粹的能量。

如此强大的物品，不能轻易落入夜之子手里。

english.title: Sigil Reclamation
english.objectives: Collect 7 Moon Guard Sigils.
english.description:
The smooth square sigil weighs a fair amount more than its appearance would suggest. 

Handling it results in an intense tingling sensation in your palm- this is an object of focused, pure power. 

Such an advantage should not be so easily surrendered to the Nightborne.

text.title: For the People
text.objectives: Locate an Arcwine Fountain to fill your Empty Arcwine Skin, then offer Arcwine to Mana-Starved Nightborne.
text.description:
We have a problem, friend.

Across the canal is a district not well known for affluence. Since the demons' arrival, it has been locked down. I have heard the cries of those who have been deprived of sustenance.

Take this wineskin. Find an Arcwine fountain and take your fill.

Find those who are suffering and offer them a drink. It is the best we can do in the present circumstances.

You must not be seen doing this, $n. It will end badly.

english.title: For the People
english.objectives: Locate an Arcwine Fountain to fill your Empty Arcwine Skin, then offer Arcwine to Mana-Starved Nightborne.
english.description:
We have a problem, friend.

Across the canal is a district not well known for affluence. Since the demons' arrival, it has been locked down. I have heard the cries of those who have been deprived of sustenance.

Take this wineskin. Find an Arcwine fountain and take your fill.

Find those who are suffering and offer them a drink. It is the best we can do in the present circumstances.

You must not be seen doing this, $n. It will end badly.

objectiveDetails.description: Fill Arcwine Skin from Arcwine Fountain

text.title: 阻止觅法者
text.objectives: 关闭3扇觅法者传送门。
text.description:
夜之子已经向这里进军。雪上加霜的是，他们还带来了更多援军。

我看到他们开启了通往苏拉玛的大型传送门。

他们通过这些传送门调来了构造体。我的魔法几乎对这些构造体无效，这成为了一个阻碍，让我无法与其他人会合。

找到传送门，并尽可能关闭它们。这应该可以为我们争取一点时间。

english.title: Stop the Spell Seekers
english.objectives: Close 3 Spell Seeker Portals.
english.description:
The Nightborne are here in force. As if that were not worrying enough, they now bring reinforcements.

I have seen them opening large portals to Suramar.

Through these portals they have called in their constructs. They are immune to much of my magic and so represent something of a stumbling block to rejoining the others.

Find the portals and close as many as you can. That should buy us some time.

text.title: 返回马顿
text.objectives: 进入伊利达雷传送门，登上马顿的邪能之槌号。
text.description: 传送门完全运作起来了，$n。噢，我的激动之情简直溢于言表！$B$B告诉杰斯和其他人，我们非常期待大家的到来。我们有太多事情要做，可时间已经所剩无几。$B$B你也会和我们一起登船吧？

english.title: Return to Mardum
english.objectives: Enter the Illidari Gateway to board the Fel Hammer in Mardum.
english.description: The gateway is fully functional, $n. Ooh, I am positively tingling with excitement!$B$BDo let Jace and the others know that we eagerly await your arrival. There's so much to do and ever so little time.$B$BYou will be joining us aboard, won't you?

text.title: 直击水域
text.objectives: 在蓝风海湾消灭拉兹基拉、马尔特希斯和凯尔塔里斯。
text.description: 萨吉塔逃不出你的手掌心了，$n。$B$B他们绝对想不到你会直捣黄龙，攻击他们的海底大本营。趁着这个大好机会，消灭他们的指挥官。$B$B你杀掉他们以后就到贾德维克来找我。

english.title: Testing the Waters
english.objectives: Slay Raz'jira, Malt'his, and Kel'tariss in Azuregale Bay.
english.description: There is no place that the Sashj'tar can hide from you now, $n.$B$BThey will not be expecting a direct attack in their waters. This is a perfect opportunity to cut down their commanders.$B$BMeet me in Jandvik after you have slaughtered them.

text.title: 邪风的请求
text.objectives: 在达拉然的紫罗兰之门与梅瑞尔·邪风见面。
text.description:
你可能不认识我，但是我需要你的帮助，$n。

到紫罗兰之门找我，我会解释一切。

快点，恐怕我们的时间不多。

english.title: Felstorm's Plea
english.objectives: Meet Meryl Felstorm in the Violet Gate in Dalaran.
english.description:
You may not know me, but I need your help, $n.

Meet me in the Violet Gate and I'll explain everything. 

Make haste. I fear we have little time.

text.title: 恐惧魔王的战利品
text.objectives: 在紫罗兰监狱打败卡萨纳提尔。
text.description: 卡萨纳提尔逃脱了我的控制，不过我知道他下一步的打算。$b$b他在找一个叫做守护者熔炉的古老圣物。数个世纪以来，提瑞斯法议会一直通过它为守护者灌注法力。熔炉的位置极为隐秘，只有议会成员才知道。$b$b现在，那个恐惧魔王知道了这个秘密。$b$b我们必须前往紫罗兰监狱。希望我们还来得及。

english.title: The Dreadlord's Prize
english.objectives: Defeat Kathra'natir in Violet Hold.
english.description: Kathra'natir escaped my grasp, but I know what his next step will be.$b$bHe seeks an ancient relic called the Forge of the Guardian, used for centuries by the Council of Tirisfal to infuse their power into the Guardian. The forge was hidden away, its location known only to the Council themselves.$b$bNow the dreadlord has this knowledge.$b$bWe must go to the Violet Hold. I only hope we are not too late.

text.title: 无限力量
text.objectives: 启动邪能之槌号，召集你的伊利达雷部队。
text.description: 虽然我们的部队在你离开以后一直坚守着这座要塞，但是我们无法使用它的绝大部分资源——只有具备燃烧军团领主印记的人，才能完全启动邪能之槌。$B$B幸运的是，你的武器正好拥有那种印记。用它们来启动邪能之槌——让你的部队见识你无穷的力量！

english.title: Unbridled Power
english.objectives: Activate the Fel Hammer and rally your Illidari forces.
english.description: Although our forces have dutifully held this citadel since your departure, we have been unable to access most of its resources - the Fel Hammer can only be fully activated by those bearing the mark of a Legion lord.$B$BThankfully, your blades carry that very mark. Use them to activate the Fel Hammer - show your forces your limitless power!

text.title: 蜜酒大师
text.objectives: 在风暴峡湾与艾吉拉谈一谈。
text.description: 风暴蜜酒是由传说中的维库酿酒大师梅尔芭所创。这是她在风暴峡湾北部海岸的蜜酒庄所在位置。$B$B如果可以说服她跟我们分享自己的秘方，我们就能取得压制敌人的巨大优势。$B$B大宗师，你擅长说服别人吗？

english.title: The Mead Master
english.objectives: Speak to Aegira in Stormheim.
english.description: The Storm Brew is created by a legendary vrykul brewmaster named Melba. Here is the location of her meadery along the northern Stormheim coast.$B$BIf we can convince her to share her secret recipe with us, we will gain a significant advantage over the enemy.$B$BGrandmaster, how are your skills of persuasion?

text.title: 盗来的秘方
text.objectives: 品尝酸败的风暴蜜酒、低度风暴蜜酒和炽烈的风暴蜜酒，然后消灭莫尔金以取得风暴蜜酒配方。
text.description: 风暴蜜酒配方现在在蔑潮部族的首席酿酒师莫尔金的手里。$B$B单凭我一己之力还不足以攻下他的堡垒，不过只要有你的帮助，我们应该可以为我死去的师傅报仇。掰开莫尔金冰冷、僵硬的手指，拿回配方，这是我最大的心愿。$B$B等我们到了那里，一定要尝尝他的风暴蜜酒。我倒想看看他的酿酒技术有我师傅的几成。

english.title: Stolen Knowledge
english.objectives: Taste the Sour Storm Brew, Weak Storm Brew, Blazing Storm Brew, and kill Morjirn for the Storm Brew Recipe.
english.description: Morjirn, the head brewer of the Tideskorn clan, has the Storm Brew recipe.$B$BI have never been strong enough to assault his fortress alone, but together with you, I think we can claim retribution for my fallen master. I would like nothing better than to pry the recipe from Morjirn's cold, dead fingers.$B$BWhile we are there, we will sample his Storm Brew. I'd like to see if his brewing skills are even near my master's.

text.title: 英灵殿：酿酒大师
text.objectives: 在英灵殿与梅尔芭谈一谈。
text.description: 我在梅尔芭的风暴蜜酒配方上有了新的突破。$B$B我们需要用到一口奥丁的特制大锅。$B$B这口锅就在英灵殿里面。$B$B要进入这个尊崇的地方，唯一的办法就是获得风暴之神的恩宠。$B$B你必须设法进入战士大厅。要完成这个任务，你可能需要盟友的帮助，$n。

english.title: Halls of Valor: The Brewmaster
english.objectives: Speak to Melba in the Halls of Valor.
english.description: I've made a new breakthrough with Melba's Storm Brew recipe.$B$BWe need the use of a special cauldron, one owned by Odyn himself.$B$BThis cauldron is located in none other than the Halls of Valor.$B$BThere is only one way to enter this exalted place, and that is through the storm god's favor.$B$BYou must find a way to enter the hall of warriors. You may require allies for this endeavor, $n.

text.title: Sashj'tar Allies DISBALED
text.objectives: Speak with Toryl in Jandvik.
text.description: Commander Malt'his was conferring with a sea giant?$B$BWe are prepared to battle the naga, but if they have yoked the strength of the sea giants, we will have to double our efforts to save Jandvik.$B$BYou must tell Toryl about this grave news right away.

english.title: Sashj'tar Allies DISBALED
english.objectives: Speak with Toryl in Jandvik.
english.description: Commander Malt'his was conferring with a sea giant?$B$BWe are prepared to battle the naga, but if they have yoked the strength of the sea giants, we will have to double our efforts to save Jandvik.$B$BYou must tell Toryl about this grave news right away.

text.title: 灌注力量
text.objectives: 使用祭坛为你的神器灌注新的力量。
text.description: 你拥有的武器可以对燃烧军团发起强力的攻击……但是恶魔残酷无情，随着你的战术不断进化，你的武器也必须持续成长。$b$b你面前的祭坛萦绕着古老的魔法，并且充满了历代猎人的技巧和奉献精神。$b$b把你的神器放上去，随着时间的流逝，你将会唤醒武器的所有潜能。

english.title: Infused with Power
english.objectives: Use the altar to imbue your artifact weapon with a new power.
english.description: The weapon you hold will strike a potent blow against the Legion... but the demons are relentless. Just as your battle tactics grow and evolve, so must your weapon.$b$bThe altar before you courses with ancient magic, and is alive with the skill and dedication of the hunters who have used it through the ages.$b$bPlace your artifact upon it, and over time you will awaken the full potential of your weapon.

objectiveDetails.description: 为你的神器灌注新的力量

text.title: 绝望的请求
text.objectives: 在克拉苏斯平台与萨鲁法尔大王见面。
text.description: $n，萨鲁法尔在破碎海滩惨败后仿佛变了个人。虽然他领导有方，而且还消灭了大量敌人，不过我们的失败对他造成了巨大的影响。$b$b恐怕他执意要返回破碎海滩。你能和他谈谈吗？

english.title: A Desperate Plea
english.objectives: Meet with High Overlord Saurfang at Krasus' Landing.
english.description: $n, Saurfang has not been the same since our loss at the Broken Shore. Though he led well and slew many, he has taken our defeat hard.$b$bI fear he is determined to return to the Broken Shore. Will you speak to him?

text.title: 永恒狩猎祭坛
text.objectives: 在神射手营地里与祭坛守护者别恩谈一谈。
text.description: 你已经把来自艾泽拉斯各地的猎人集结在一起，该把注意力转到对抗燃烧军团的战斗上了。$b$b永恒狩猎祭坛就在神射手营地里。它是一个魔力充沛的上古圣物，我相信，它可以为你的武器注入更强大的力量。$b$b进入营地，与祭坛守护者别恩谈一谈，他会教你如何使用祭坛。

english.title: Altar of the Eternal Hunt
english.objectives: Speak to Altar Keeper Biehn inside the Trueshot Lodge.
english.description: Now that you've rallied hunters from across Azeroth together, it's time to turn your attention to the battle against the Burning Legion.$b$bWithin the Trueshot Lodge is the Altar of the Eternal Hunt. It is an ancient relic alive with old magic, and I believe it can be used to infuse your weapon with even greater might.$b$bGo inside the lodge and speak to Altar Keeper Biehn, who can instruct you in its use.

text.title: 痛失所爱
text.objectives: 在星歌避难所与泰兰德·语风谈一谈。
text.description: 玛法里奥，我的爱人……$b$b我在幻象中看到了他，愤怒而哀伤，而现在，我的意志已经无法再触及到他。$b$b$R，我知道我们没有理由信任对方，但我不会拒绝你的帮助。$b$b如果你珍视这个世界的尊严，就跟我来。

english.title: Love Lost
english.objectives: Speak with Tyrande Whisperwind at Starsong Refuge.
english.description: Malfurion, my love...$b$bIn vision I saw him, enraged and then distressed, and now lost beyond my mind's reach.$b$b$R, I know we have little reason to trust one another, but I will not turn away your help.$b$bIf you value the sanctity of this world, you will come with me.

text.title: 失落的爱人
text.objectives: 在星歌避难所与泰兰德·语风谈一谈。
text.description: 玛法里奥，我的爱人……$b$b我在一个幻象中看到了他，他非常愤怒和痛苦。而现在我的意识已经感应不到他的存在。$b$b虽然他十分强大，但是降临在这片土地上的恐怖可以吞噬一切。$b$b我必须找到他，而你必须帮助我！$b$b$r，集中精神跟我走！
text.completion: I pray it is not too late, friend.

english.title: Love Lost
english.objectives: Speak to Tyrande Whisperwind at Starsong Refuge.
english.description: Malfurion, my love...$b$bIn vision I saw him, enraged and then distressed, and now lost beyond my mind's reach.$b$bHe is strong, but the horrors that have befallen this land are all-consuming.$b$bI must find him, and you must help me!$b$bGather your wits, $r, and follow me.
english.completion: I pray it is not too late, friend.

text.title: 英灵殿：奥丁的大锅
text.objectives: 在英灵殿获取奥丁的大锅，然后通过奥丁的试练。
text.description: 你在风暴峡湾的表现十分英勇。谢谢你为我报仇，还帮了我的学徒艾吉拉。我想不出继承我知识的更好人选。$B$B我会跟你分享我的风暴蜜酒的秘密。蜜酒的真正力量来自于奥丁的大锅，它就在前面的大厅里。$B$B我允许你借用。祝你未来的旅途一切顺利，$n。

english.title: Halls of Valor: Odyn's Cauldron
english.objectives: Collect Odyn's Cauldron from the Halls of Valor, then pass Odyn's trial.
english.description: Your actions in Stormheim were courageous. I thank you for avenging me, and for helping my apprentice, Aegira. I can think of none better to inherit my knowledge.$B$BWith you, I will share the secret to my Storm Brew. The true strength of the brew comes from Odyn's Cauldron, which can be found in the great hall just ahead.$B$BYou have my blessing to borrow it. Good luck in your journey ahead, $n.

text.title: 无限力量
text.objectives: 启动邪能之槌号，召集你的伊利达雷部队。
text.description: 虽然我们的部队在你离开以后一直坚守着这座要塞，但是我们无法使用它的绝大部分资源——只有具备燃烧军团领主印记的人，才能完全启动邪能之槌。$B$B幸运的是，你的武器正好拥有那种印记。用它们来启动邪能之槌号——让你的部队见识你无穷的力量！

english.title: Unbridled Power
english.objectives: Activate the Fel Hammer and rally your Illidari forces.
english.description: Although our forces have dutifully held this citadel since your departure, we have been unable to access most of its resources - the Fel Hammer can only be fully activated by those bearing the mark of a Legion lord.$B$BThankfully, your blades carry that very mark. Use them to activate the Fel Hammer - show your forces your limitless power!

text.title: 真正的战利品
text.objectives: 让战争领主加尔顿带你去看部队的战利品。
text.description: 邪能之槌可以成为恶魔猎手的完美基地，不过藏在它深处的东西才是我们这场胜利真正的战利品。$B$B战争领主加尔顿和他的灰舌部队已经对它严加看守，你应该让他带你去看看。

english.title: Spoils of Victory
english.objectives: Have Battlelord Gaardoun show you what your forces obtained.
english.description: The Fel Hammer will be a fine home for our kind, but it is what we found within its depths that is the true prize of our conquest.$B$BBattlelord Gaardoun and his Ashtongue have it closely guarded - you should have him show you.

objectiveDetails.description: 与战争领主加尔顿交谈

text.title: 纳斯雷兹姆的诅咒熔炉
text.objectives: 使用纳斯雷兹姆的诅咒熔炉强化你的神器。
text.description: 即便在此刻，燃烧军团的黑暗主宰也在不断制造新的恐惧，希望借此摧毁我们——特别是你。$B$B你也必须提升自己的实力。$B$B纳斯雷兹姆的诅咒熔炉是我们拿下邪能之槌所获得的最宝贵的战利品，它就在前面的房间里。你可以用它来进一步强化你的武器，维持我们的战略优势。

english.title: Cursed Forge of the Nathrezim
english.objectives: Use the Cursed Forge of the Nathrezim to empower your artifact.
english.description: Even as we speak, the Legion's dark masters fashion new horrors in hopes that they might destroy us - especially you.$B$BYou must increase your own power as well.$B$BThe Cursed Forge of the Nathrezim, our greatest treasure from taking the Fel Hammer, waits in the chamber ahead. You can use it to further empower your blades and maintain our edge over the enemy.

text.title: 亲自监视
text.objectives: 使用强化虚空坩埚观察艾泽拉斯上的燃烧军团势力。
text.description: $n，在你面前的是你的虚空坩埚，它的威力比我们之前制作的任何一个都要强得多。$B$B我们在马顿消灭了数百个恶魔，他们的灵魂让我们有足够的能量直接监视艾泽拉斯的燃烧军团势力。$B$B到目前为止，我们看到的情况……非常令人不安。你可以透过坩埚，亲自看看。

english.title: The Hunter's Gaze
english.objectives: Use the Empowered Nether Crucible to gaze upon the Burning Legion's forces in Azeroth.
english.description: $n, before you lies your nether crucible - more powerful than any we've crafted before.$B$BThe souls of the hundreds of slain demons in Mardum have provided us with enough power to directly observe the Legion on Azeroth.$B$BWhat we have uncovered so far has been... unsettling. Gaze into the pool and see for yourself.

text.title: 时间宝贵
text.objectives: 与凯恩·日怒谈一谈。
text.description: 如你所见，时间已经所剩无几——燃烧军团已经开始蚕食我们的世界。$B$B凯恩集结了我们最优秀的战略家，他们正在我们上方的星图附近讨论攻击计划——你的领导对他们有巨大的帮助。

english.title: Time is of the Essence
english.objectives: Speak to Kayn Sunfury.
english.description: As you can see, there is little time to spare - the Legion's armies already encroach on our world.$B$BKayn has gathered our best tacticians around the star map above us to discuss our plan of attack - your leadership would be invaluable to their efforts.

text.title: 同仇敌忾
text.objectives: 选择你在破碎群岛的首个攻击目标。
text.description: 我们必须不惜一切代价封印萨格拉斯之墓，否则恶魔将会源源不绝地涌入我们的世界。$B$B在那之前，我们必须尽可能地阻止燃烧军团站稳脚跟，以免他们进一步扩张。$B$B这座要塞本来是燃烧军团入侵其他世界的桥头堡，我们可以利用它的导航系统来规划我们的进攻。$B$B没有人比你更适合领导我们的攻击行动，我觉得你也会认同我的看法。

english.title: Direct Our Wrath
english.objectives: Select your first assault point on the Broken Isles.
english.description: We must seal the Tomb of Sargeras at all costs or the flow of demons will never cease.$B$BUntil then, we must do what we can on the ground to alleviate their foothold before it grows further.$B$BThis citadel was created to spearhead Legion invasions on other worlds - we can use its navigation systems to plan our assault.$B$BI think you would agree that none would be better suited to lead our charge than you.

text.title: 真正的战利品
text.objectives: 让战争领主加尔顿带你去看部队的战利品。
text.description: 我们在攻打堡垒的时候得到了一样特别的东西，我觉得它应该对你非常有用。$B$B加尔顿的人正在下面严加看守，我建议你让他为你展示。

english.title: Spoils of Victory
english.objectives: Have Battlelord Gaardoun show you what your forces obtained.
english.description: In conquering this citadel we obtained something that I think would be of great use to you.$B$BGaardoun's men have it well-guarded just below - I suggest you have him show you.

objectiveDetails.description: 与战争领主加尔顿交谈
Grab a prototype from Razik's weapon rack
用拉兹克的原型枪猎杀动物
从拉兹克的武器架上拿一把原型枪
Grab a prototype from Razik's weapon rack

text.title: 法师的武器
text.objectives: 使用艾泽拉斯神器附录选择要追求的神器。
text.description:
毋庸置疑。

提瑞斯秘法会勇士所持有的古代神器是组织的力量基础。你的第一个任务就是取回一件这种神器。

这座图书馆的主要附录罗列了提瑞斯法议会所知的每一件神器。里面应该有一些值得参考的选择。

我交给你来选择要追求哪一件神器。

english.title: A Mage's Weapon
english.objectives: Use the Appendix of Azerothian Artifacts to choose an artifact to pursue.
english.description:
It is decided, then.

The foundation of the Tirisgarde's strength lies in the ancient artifacts wielded by its champions. Your first task will be to retrieve one such artifact.

The master appendix of this library lists every artifact known to the Council of Tirisfal. There should be a few choices in there worth looking into.

I will leave it to you to choose which to pursue.

text.title: 和平世界
text.objectives: 完成10个世界任务。
text.description: 有消息说，军团正在破碎群岛步步挺进。$B$B他们四处袭击我们，如果我们不坚守阵线，他们就会把战线拉到全艾泽拉斯。$B$B$n，你的援手在这个危急关头至关重要。向那些在前线抵御恶魔进攻的人伸出援手吧。我们不能就此功亏一篑。

english.title: A Peaceful World
english.objectives: Complete 10 World Quests.
english.description: Word has reached us that the Legion is advancing on the Broken Isles.$B$BThey beset us from all sides, and if we do not stand strong, they will spill over into the rest of Azeroth.$B$B$n, we need your help more than ever. Lend your strength to those defending at the front. We cannot fail here.

text.title: 风暴蜜酒
text.objectives: 搭乘泰克泰克的风筝前往笑风山，帮助陈·风暴烈酒和艾吉拉酿造风暴蜜酒，并且击败燃烧军团的部队。
text.description: 大宗师，燃烧军团正在攻击迷踪岛！$B$B我们派出了防御者登上笑风山，但是他们撑不了多久。$B$B我们唯一的希望就是酿出风暴蜜酒。陈和艾吉拉已经前往风语厅了，但他们也遭到了猛烈的攻击。$B$B快去找泰克泰克，乘他的风筝去援助他们！

english.title: Storm Brew
english.objectives: Take Tak-Tak's kite to the Ridge of Laughing Winds, help Chen Stormstout & Aegira make the Storm Brew, and defeat the Burning Legion's forces.
english.description: Grandmaster, the Legion is attacking the Wandering Isle!$B$BWe sent defenders up to the Ridge of Laughing Winds, but they can't hold for long.$B$BOur only chance is to finish making the Storm Brew. Chen and Aegira have already gone up to the Chamber of Whispers, but they are under heavy attack as well.$B$BSpeak to Tak Tak and take a kite up to join them at once!

text.title: 利爪雏鹰
text.objectives: 跟艾维娜交谈以获得她的祝福，然后通过收集翡翠之球完成她的挑战。
text.description:
你好，小家伙。你想要像我的孩子们一样在云端翱翔吗？

<艾维娜嘎嘎笑着，声音就像乌鸦一样。>

很好，接受我的祝福，让我们看看你的翅膀有多强健。

english.title: Hatchlings of the Talon
english.objectives: Talk to Aviana to receive her blessing, then complete her challenge by collecting Emerald Globes.
english.description:
Greetings, hatchling. Do you wish to soar amongst the clouds as my children do?

<Aviana chuckles - a clicking, crow-like noise.>

Very well, receive my blessing and we shall see how developed your wings are.

text.title: 时间宝贵
text.objectives: 与受难者奥图里斯谈一谈。
text.description: 如你所见，时间已经所剩无几——燃烧军团已经开始蚕食我们的世界。$B$B奥图里斯集结了我们最优秀的战略家，他们正在我们上方的星图附近讨论攻击计划——你的领导对他们有巨大的帮助。

english.title: Time is of the Essence
english.objectives: Speak to Altruis the Sufferer.
english.description: As you can see, there is little time to spare - the Legion's armies already encroach on our world.$B$BAltruis has gathered our best tacticians around the star map above us to discuss our plan of attack - your leadership would be invaluable to their efforts.

text.title: 沃格斯碎片
text.objectives: 收集沃格斯碎片。
text.description: 根据虫语者仆从的说法，有一个传送门可以带你前往燃烧军团的指挥舰。但是，没有钥匙的话就无法使用那个传送门。$b$b第一个钥匙碎片就在一个叫做沃格斯的埃雷杜因手里。他就在魔法回廊末端的邪能裂口里面。$b$b消灭沃格斯，然后把钥匙碎片放到传送门旁边的正确位置。
text.giverWindow: 沃格斯手里有碎光之地的钥匙之一。我们必须从他手里抢过来。

english.title: Shard of Vorgos
english.objectives: Collect the Shard of Vorgos.
english.description: According to the wyrmtongue servant, there is a portal that will take you into the Burning Legion command ship. However, the portal is locked to those without the keys.$b$bThe first key shard is held by an Ered'ruin known as Vorgos. He resides within the Fel Breach, which is at the end of the Arcway.$b$bSlay Vorgos and place the key shard into its position next to the portal.
english.giverWindow: Vorgos possesses one of the keys to the Lightbreaker. We must take it from him.

text.title: 考扎克碎片
text.objectives: 收集考扎克碎片。
text.description: 在邪魂堡垒指挥行动的恶魔是一个名叫阿佐兰的艾瑞达。要接近他的话，我们需要打开一道通往燃烧军团指挥舰的传送门。$b$b阿佐兰的手下有一个叫做拷问者考扎克的恶魔狱卒。$b$b他手里有用来启动指挥舰传送门的钥匙碎片之一。你可以在邪魂堡垒底层的日蚀大厅监狱区找到他。$b$b消灭考扎克，然后把他的钥匙碎片放到传送门旁边。
text.giverWindow: 找到拷问者考扎克，并从他手里夺走军团战舰传送门的钥匙碎片。

english.title: Shard of Kozak
english.objectives: Collect the Shard of Kozak.
english.description: The demon leading the operation in Felsoul Hold is an eredar named Azoran. In order to get to him, we will need to open a portal to the Burning Legion command ship.$b$bAzoran has a demon jailer in his service known as Kozak the Afflictor.$b$bKozak the Afflictor holds one of the key shards necessary to open a portal to the ship. He can be found in the prison quarters known as the Halls of the Eclipse in the lower portion of Felsoul Hold.$b$bSlay Kozak and place his key shard next to the portal.
english.giverWindow: Find Kozak the Afflictor and claim his key to the Legion ship.

text.title: 同仇敌忾
text.objectives: 选择你在破碎群岛的首个攻击目标。
text.description: 萨格拉斯之墓是燃烧军团涌入我们世界的主要门户——必须摧毁它。$B$B这不是一件容易的事，在有能力摧毁它之前，我们必须尽可能地阻止恶魔入侵。$B$B这座要塞本来是燃烧军团入侵其他世界的桥头堡，我们可以利用它的导航系统来规划我们的进攻。$B$B当然，对他们的据点发起首次攻击的这份荣耀属于你，我们会尽快加入你的行动。

english.title: Direct Our Wrath
english.objectives: Select your first assault point on the Broken Isles.
english.description: The Tomb of Sargeras is the Legion's primary entrance into our world - it must be destroyed.$B$BNo easy task, but until we have the means to do so we must do what we can to stop their invasion.$B$BThe Legion used this citadel to spearhead invasions on other worlds - we can use its navigation systems to plan our own assault against them.$B$BYou, of course, must take the honor of first breaking ground on their territory, but we will soon follow.

text.title: 王者之剑
text.objectives: 找到斯多姆卡，灭战者，然后解决扎卡兹。
text.description:
索拉丁是人类历史上第一位国王，他的英勇壮举不胜枚举。然而在他执政末期的一次因私出巡时，他偶然发现了我兄弟提尔的墓穴……杀死提尔的怪物也被困在里面。他无意间唤醒了那头怪兽，为了阻止它逃脱，索拉丁牺牲了。

正是索拉丁的佩剑，斯多姆卡封住了那头怪兽。取回那把武器，并完成提尔和索拉丁的遗志。消灭腐化的扎卡兹 。

english.title: The Sword of Kings
english.objectives: Find Strom'kar, the Warbreaker and deal with Zakajz.
english.description:
The first king of the humans, Thoradin, performed many acts of heroism and valor. While on a personal quest near the end of his reign, he stumbled upon the tomb of my brother Tyr... and the grave-prison of the monstrosity he died fighting. Thoradin unintentionally awoke the beast and gave his life to keep it from escaping.

It is Thoradin's sword, Strom'kar, that has kept the monster at bay. Retrieve it and finish what Tyr and Thoradin started. Kill Zakajz the Corrupted.

objectiveDetails.description: 使用奥丁的传送门返回苍穹要塞
前往提瑞斯法林地的提尔之墓
（可选）使用传送门前往达拉然巨坑
（可选）与艾瑞莉娅交谈以前往达拉然

text.title: 野性的呼唤
text.objectives: 找到岑塔布拉和纳拉雷克斯，并带他们到仪式地点。
text.description: 要打败燃烧军团，我们就需要迅速行动，攻其不备。$b$b我们发现了一条梦境之路，它可以带我们穿过翡翠梦境。梦境中的短短路程，可以让我们跨越艾泽拉斯的广袤地域，甚至进入德鲁伊的古老家园，瓦尔莎拉。$b$b玛法里奥正在准备进行开启梦境之路的仪式。我需要你把岑塔布拉和纳拉雷克斯叫去他的身边。$b$b唯有齐心协力，我们才有成功的希望。

english.title: Call of the Wilds
english.objectives: Locate Zen'tabra and Naralex, and direct them to the ritual site.
english.description: Beating the Legion requires us to strike quickly and unexpectedly.$b$bWe have discovered a Dreamway by which we can travel through the Emerald Dream itself. Though only a short walk through the Dream, it will allow us to cross vast distances on Azeroth and even access the ancient home of all druids, Val'sharah.$b$bMalfurion is preparing the ritual to open the Dreamway. I need you to summon Zen'tabra and Naralex to his side.$b$bOnly by combining our efforts can we hope to succeed.

enders.name: 大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾

objectiveDetails.description: 找到纳拉雷克斯，并与他交谈
找到纳拉雷克斯的营地

text.title: 毒的教训
text.objectives: 采集$1oa朵暗影花。
text.description: 那边的水果？那是我劳动成果的劣质仿造品。$b$b不过那个该死的达格利尔竟然博得了宫廷贵人们的欢心，让我们落得这般田地！$b$b达格利尔剽窃我的成果，我们必须好好教训他一顿，不过我们必须格外谨慎。$b$b护盾的外面生长着一种紫色的暗影花。帮我采一些回来，我们要让他为自己的无耻付出代价！

english.title: Bad Apples
english.objectives: Gather $1oa Shadowbloom.
english.description: That fruit over there? That's a pale imitation to what I can grow.$b$bBut that accursed Daglir somehow manages to gain the favor of the courts, so we must dine on mediocrity!$b$bWe must teach Daglir a lesson for stealing my crop, but we must be discreet.$b$bOutside the shield grows a purple flower called Shadowbloom. Fetch some for me and we'll make sure that he pays dearly for his insolence!

text.title: 死亡降临
text.objectives: 消灭50个夜之子。
text.description: 机会难得，快骑上这头角鹰兽吧。是时候让夜之子后悔放你一条生路了。

english.title: Rain Death Upon Them
english.objectives: Slay 50 Nightborne.
english.description: Aboard the hippogryph you now possess a unique opportunity. It is time for the Nightborne to regret letting you live.

text.title: 等待复仇
text.objectives: 骑乘角鹰兽。
text.description:
不稳定的法术焦镜在你手里发出了能量的嗡鸣。要多加小心！

只有在拿着这件物品的时候，角鹰兽才甘愿供你骑乘。

english.title: Waiting for Revenge
english.objectives: Mount a Hippogryph.
english.description:
The Volatile Spell Focus hums with energy as you hold it. Handle with care! 

Only with this item in your possession will the Hippogryphs allow themselves to be mounted.

text.title: 等待复仇
text.objectives: 骑乘角鹰兽。
text.description: 角鹰兽好奇地看着你，并查看你的双手。

english.title: Waiting for Revenge
english.objectives: Mount the Hippogryph.
english.description: The Hippogryph eyes you curiously, searching your hands.

text.title: 死亡降临
text.objectives: 消灭50个夜之子。
text.description: 你面前的角鹰兽为你带来了一个特别的机会。是时候让夜之子后悔放你一条生路了。

english.title: Rain Death Upon Them
english.objectives: Slay 50 Nightborne.
english.description: The hippogryph before you presents a unique opportunity. It is time for the Nightborne to regret letting you live.

text.title: 伟大的阿卡扎曼扎拉克
text.objectives: 把一大袋金币放进阿卡扎曼扎拉克的小费桶里 。
text.description:
有一个叫做阿卡扎曼扎拉克的地精，他是传送技术和传送门方面的大师。不过，因为他基本都用这门技术来坑蒙拐骗，所以他的才能并没有得到过多的关注。

你可以称他为街头艺人。

我们很走运，他正在达拉然的街头忙活，从愚昧的群众兜里骗取钱财。

把这袋金币拿去，看你能不能说服他转行。

english.title: The Great Akazamzarak
english.objectives: Place the Sizeable Pouch of Gold in Akazamzarak's tip bucket.
english.description:
There is a goblin who is a master of portals and teleportation by the name of Akazamzarak. His talents have gone mostly unnoticed, however, since he mostly uses them for chicanery.

He is, what you would call, a street performer.

Fortunately for us, he is performing in the streets of Dalaran, grifting coins from the unenlightened masses.

Take this bag of gold. See if you can convince him to change vocations.

enders.name: 伟大的阿卡扎曼扎拉克

objectiveDetails.description: （可选）使用传送门前往达拉然

text.title: 旅行的唯一方式
text.objectives: 回守护者圣殿找梅瑞尔·邪风。
text.description:
传送门？传送技术？我当然可以帮你！我是说，不然你以为我是怎么把兔子拉出来的……

……呃，我刚才什么也没说。

不管怎样，我可以帮你转移你的法师，前提是你出得起价钱。我甚至还能传授那些战斗法师一两招。你收到过会爆炸的兔子吗？那一点也不可爱！

先让我弄一扇传送门，好让我们到达你所说的这个大厅。

english.title: The Only Way to Travel
english.objectives: Return to Meryl Felstorm in the Hall of the Guardian.
english.description:
Portals? Teleportation? You bet I can help you out with that! I mean, how do you think I pull the rabbit out of...

...um, you didn't hear that.

Anyway, I can help you move your mages around, if the price is right. Heck I can even teach those combat mages a thing or two. Ever been on the receiving end of an exploding bunny? It ain't pretty!

For starters, let me whip up a portal to take us to this hall you're talking about.

text.title: 勇士归来
text.objectives: 传送回守护者圣殿找梅瑞尔·邪风。
text.description:
我可以感受到你手里的神器的力量。它将在你对抗燃烧军团的战斗中助你一臂之力，不过我们有能力进一步挖掘它的潜能。

你必须返回守护者圣殿。你可以用我之前教你的咒语来穿过那些符文。

english.title: The Champion's Return
english.objectives: Teleport to the Hall of the Guardian and return to Meryl Felstorm.
english.description:
I can sense the power of the artifact you hold. It will do well against the Legion as it is, but we have the ability to unlock its power even further. 

You must return to the Hall of the Guardian. You can use the incantation I taught you before to pass through the runes.

text.title: 7.0 Artifacts - Shaman - Puzzle Room - Treasure - DGK

english.title: 7.0 Artifacts - Shaman - Puzzle Room - Treasure - DGK

text.title: 猎杀行动
text.objectives: 从苏拉玛的瓦雷迪斯·邪魂手里取得欺诈者的双刃。
text.description: 这次猎杀行动由你带队，$n——会有一支小队来配合你的行动，确保消灭瓦雷迪斯。$B$B你必须尽量秘密潜入他的堡垒，在燃烧军团的地盘呆的时间越短越好。$B$B你做好出发的准备之后，就到克拉苏斯平台跟我会合。

english.title: The Hunt
english.objectives: Obtain the Twinblades of the Deceiver from Varedis Felsoul in Suramar.
english.description: You must lead this hunt, $n - a small force will join you to ensure Varedis meets his end.$B$BYou must try to make it into Varedis' hold undetected; the less time you spend in Legion territory the better.$B$BMeet at Krasus' Landing when you are prepared to leave.

text.title: 事务安排
text.objectives: 在紫罗兰监狱外面与受难者奥图里斯见面。
text.description: 你还记得瓦雷迪斯吗？他曾是我们在黑暗神殿的首席训练师，但是早在围攻时就已经死去。$B$B……至少我们以前是这么以为的。$B$B考瓦斯看到这个叛徒出现在燃烧军团的队伍里面，而且他手里的战刃还灌注了一种前所未见的力量。$B$B肯瑞托在紫罗兰监狱里关着一个艾瑞达首领，他应该知道瓦雷迪斯的行动基地在哪里。典狱官答应会考虑让我们探视那个恶魔。$B$B<奥图里斯露出得意的笑容。>$B$B是时候扮演友好的外交官了。

english.title: Making Arrangements
english.objectives: Meet Altruis the Sufferer outside the Violet Hold.
english.description: Do you remember Varedis? He was once our lead trainer at the Black Temple, but fell early in the siege.$B$B...or so we thought.$B$BKor'vas spotted the traitor amongst the Legion wielding glaives imbued with power unlike anything she'd ever seen.$B$BThe Kirin Tor have an eredar lord interred in the Violet Hold that will know where Varedis' base of operations is. The hold's warden has agreed to consider granting us access to him.$B$B<Altruis smirks.>$B$BTime to play the friendly diplomat.

text.title: 不择手段
text.objectives: 进入紫罗兰监狱，拷问毁灭者塔尔达斯以找出叛徒瓦雷迪斯的位置。
text.description: 我们必须从监狱里面的艾瑞达那里问出瓦雷迪斯的下落。这位“和蔼的”典狱官和他的手下是妨碍我们的唯一障碍。$B$B如有必要，我们会连他们一起处理掉——要不择手段。

english.title: By Any Means
english.objectives: Gain entrance to the Violet Hold and interrogate Taldath the Destroyer to find out the location of the traitor Varedis.
english.description: We need to find out Varedis' location from the eredar inside this prison - the kind warden and his men here are all that stand in our way.$B$BWe'll take them on together if need be - whatever it takes.

text.title: 工匠的标志
text.objectives: 取得勒斯平的玺戒。
text.description: 你！你有空吗？$b$b我要你到大步道找我朋友取回一枚玺戒。我没法叫我的笨蛋学徒去，因为他还没完成我交代的一桩小事。$b$b我正在等的一位客人随时会来，我必须在那之前拿到戒指。你可以帮我吗，朋友？

english.title: An Artisan's Mark
english.objectives: Obtain Lespin's Signet Ring.
english.description: You there! Do you have a moment?$b$bI need you to meet with my friend in the Promenade and retrieve a signet ring. I would send my oaf of an apprentice, but he is not finished with the simple task I gave him.$b$bI am expecting a guest at any moment and I simply must have it before he arrives. Can you help me, friend?

text.title: 秘法会的重生
text.objectives: 找梅瑞尔·邪风接受你的新头衔。
text.description:
提瑞斯秘法会已经重建。该是认真执行任务的时候了。

组织需要领导者。我或许算得上是一个经验丰富的法师，但是我并不擅长谋划。不管从你以前的功绩还是现在的表现来看，你的能力都可圈可点。

$n，你愿意接受这个挑战吗？

english.title: The Tirisgarde Reborn
english.objectives: Receive your new title from Meryl Felstorm.
english.description:
The Tirisgarde is reformed.  It is time we begin our mission in earnest.

The order will need leaders, and though I may be an experienced mage,  I am no strategist. You have proven yourself capable, in both your past exploits and present. 

Will you take on this challenge, $n?

enders.name: 伟大的阿卡扎曼扎拉克

text.title: 潜力解锁
text.objectives: 使用守护者熔炉为你的神器解锁第一个专长。
text.description:
远古时代，守护者熔炉被用来把提瑞斯法议会的力量引入一位法师的体内，从而塑造守护者。但是它的用处不止如此。

它也是奥术能量的容器，可以用来操控并强化这个世界的神器。

它的力量可以让我们在对抗恐惧魔王和燃烧军团的时候占据上风。我要你成为第一个使用这种力量的人。

english.title: Unlocked Potential
english.objectives: Use the Forge of the Guardian to unlock the first trait for your artifact.
english.description:
In ancient times, the Forge of the Guardian was used to channel the power of the Council of Tirisfal into one mage, creating a Guardian. But this is not its only use.

It also serves as a font of arcane energy which can be used to manipulate and empower the artifacts of this world. 

This power will allow us to gain the upper hand against the dreadlord and the Burning Legion, and I ask you to be the first to tap into it.

text.title: Fall of the King
text.objectives: Place the Jandvik Banner on the Sea Giant King's island to draw him out and defeat him.
text.description: All that remains is the Sea Giant King.$B$BPlace our banner upon his beach and draw him out of the sea. Once he has revealed himself, use the trident to wound him.$B$BThere is a derelict boat that washed up on the shore. Use that to quickly get to the king's island.$B$BGird your loins, $n. This fight will not be easy.

english.title: Fall of the King
english.objectives: Place the Jandvik Banner on the Sea Giant King's island to draw him out and defeat him.
english.description: All that remains is the Sea Giant King.$B$BPlace our banner upon his beach and draw him out of the sea. Once he has revealed himself, use the trident to wound him.$B$BThere is a derelict boat that washed up on the shore. Use that to quickly get to the king's island.$B$BGird your loins, $n. This fight will not be easy.

text.title: 供给沙尔艾兰
text.objectives: 和奥术师瓦尔托伊一起在沙尔艾兰检查魔网能量情况。
text.description: 有了安诺拉的魔网能量供给，这个房间将会开始重新觉醒。$B$B这将是一个漫长的过程，需要复杂的运作并且不能受到任何打扰，所以我们必须为此做好掩护，以免敌人发现。$B$B此外，关于法力能量流的强度方面还有一个问题。如果能量流太弱，就无法维持运作；如果能量流太强，我们就会被蒸发。$B$B还需要做许多准备工作。现在，我们就来检查供给情况。

english.title: Feeding Shal'Aran
english.objectives: Examine the Leyline Feed in Shal'Aran with Arcanist Valtrois.
english.description: With leyline energy feeding in from Anora, this chamber can begin to awaken.$B$BIt will be a slow process, and we must take care to mask this activity from our enemies, a process which itself requires enormous effort and focus.$B$BFurthermore, there is the conundrum of actually consuming the mana in this form. A stream too weak is not enough to provide sustenance - too powerful and it would vaporize us.$B$BThere is much work to be done yet. For now, let us examine the feed.

text.title: 钥匙就在某个地方……
text.objectives: 找到强化牢笼钥匙。
text.description: 看到你真是太好了！$b$b这个牢笼没法用暴力打开，只能用钥匙！$b$b得了，我知道你在想什么，“燃烧军团怎么可能抓到像老安古斯这么厉害的矮人。”$b$b别瞎想了，我是故意被抓到的。我来这里是为了营救一个挚友，被抓进来是唯一的办法！$b$b钥匙本来在我口袋里的……但是肯定是掉出去了。$b$b它就在，嗯……这里的某个地方。$b$b刚才被一头地狱猎犬给吃掉了……

english.title: The Key Is Around Here Somewhere...
english.objectives: Find the Reinforced Cage Key.
english.description: Well aren't ye a sight fer sore eyes!$b$bIt's no use tryin' to bust open this cage, this one needs a key!$b$bNow, I know what yer thinkin', "How is it possible that the Burnin' Legion could capture a dwarf as mighty as ol' Angus here."$b$bYe can rest easy knowin' I let myself be captured. I'm here to rescue a dear friend o' mine, an' gettin' captured was the only way!$b$bI had the key in me pocket... but it musta' fell out.$b$bIt's  errm... around here somewhere.$b$bA felhunter ate it a wee while back...

text.title: 搜救行动！
text.objectives: 找到班布利·莫里森。
text.description: 我们必须尽快找到班布利！$b$b我和老班布利从第三次大战开始就是战友了。燃烧军团打来以后，我们想都没想就赶到了破碎群岛。$b$b战斗是我们擅长的事！$b$b班布利之前在战场上深入敌后，结果被俘虏了。现在我们必须把他救出来！$b$b我上次看到恶魔们把他关在离这不远的一个牢笼里……我们走吧！

english.title: Search and Rescue!
english.objectives: Find Brambley Morrison.
english.description: We've got to find Brambley before it's too late!$b$bOl' Brambley an' I have been fightin' side by side since the Third War. When the Burnin' Legion invaded, we didn't think twice about coming to the Broken Isles.$b$bFightin' is what we do best!$b$bDuring the battle ol' Brambley got caught too deep an' got himself captured. Now we've got to rescue him!$b$bLast I saw, the demons were keeping him in a prison cell not far from here... let's go!

text.title: 大咒术师的责任
text.objectives: 使用侦察地图，选择你的首个行动区域。
text.description:
我不知道你怎么想，但我已经准备好大干一场了。这个地方是很不错，就是有点闷。

我会试试看能不能找到更多法师加入你的组织。你过去看看那边的地图吧，你可以拿它来策划你的第一步计划。

english.title: A Conjuror's Duty
english.objectives: Use the Scouting Map to choose your first zone.
english.description:
I don't know about you but I'm ready to get this show on the road. This place is nice and all, but it's a bit stuffy.

I'll see what I can do to get some more mages in this group of yours. You go ahead and check the map over there. It'll help you plan your first moves.

enders.name: 伟大的阿卡扎曼扎拉克

text.title: 我们的Grmlgrlr的Mglrgrs
text.description: Mlrg……mglrml……$b$bGmlrgmlr mglrml gmlrg！Mlrgrlgr！$b$b<Mrgrglilgrl指着一条由蜘蛛网铺成、通往废墟外面的小径。>

english.title: Mglrgrs Of Our Grmlgrlr
english.description: Mlrg...mglrmlr...$b$bGmlrgmlr mglrml gmlrg! Mlrgrlgr!$b$b<Mrgrglilgrl points at the trail of spiderwebs leading out of the ruin.>

text.title: 高雅设计
text.objectives: 说服安娜丝黛夫人把宝石切割大师的图鉴集交给你。
text.description: 外行商人只会抱怨供需法则，而商业大师会创造自己的供需商机。$b$b你取回了我要求的两样东西，做得不错。不过跟接下来的比起来，它们简直不值一提。$b$b你的目标是安娜丝黛夫人，她有我的宝贝：一份精美绝伦的宝石切割图鉴。$b$b你要不择手段从她那里取回来。要当心，她擅于操控人心，而且会用各种谎言来蒙骗你。
text.end: 说服安娜丝黛夫人把宝石切割大师的图鉴集交给你。

english.title: Elegant Design
english.objectives: Convince Lady Anastae to give you the Gemcutter's Tome.
english.description: Amateur merchants complain about supply and demand. Masters create their own.$b$bYou have done well retrieving the last two pieces I requested, but they are baubles compared to this.$b$bYour target is the Lady Anastae, and she has something very valuable of mine: A design for a masterwork gem cut. $b$bGo and get it from her by any means necessary, but take care. She is a master manipulator and will tell you all manner of lies.
english.end: Convince Lady Anastae to give you the Gemcutter's Tome.

text.title: 发放爱心
text.objectives: 为受苦的平民提供魔力酒。
text.description:
关于我们的城市，你需要知道许多东西。

其中最重要的就是魔力酒。那是我们吸收暗夜井能量的载体。没有魔力酒，我们就会枯竭，然后死亡。

皇宫的走狗们决定限量配给魔力酒，认为这样就可以控制我们。他们想让我们保持安静，不越雷池。

我要你去酒馆附近找找那些需要喝酒的人。你可能会在那里看到许多人，但受到这种限量配给的折磨最为严重的人，你一眼就能看出来。

拿上这个酒瓶。帮他们恢复生机。纾解他们的苦痛。

english.title: Dispensing Compassion
english.objectives: Offer Arcwine to suffering citizens.
english.description:
There is much you need to learn about our city.

First and foremost, Arcwine. It is the vehicle by which we imbibe the Nightwell's energies. Without it, we wither and die.

Palace lackeys have seen fit to ration it, thinking this will control us. Keep us quiet, complacent.

I would like you to look for those in need near the tavern. You will find many, but those most desperately afflicted by this rationing will be obvious.

Take this flask. Revive them. Tend to their suffering.

text.title: 实用结界
text.objectives: 在琥珀谷激活$1oa个奥术结界。
text.description:
<采用夜之子精致设计的小巧装置发出奥术能量的细碎爆裂声。

凯尔丹纳斯的笔记提到过隔离枯法者的结界。看来他找到了某种施法方式，不会引起枯法者对魔法的饥渴。

这些或许可以在你寻找失踪的奥术师时派上用场。>

english.title: A Re-Warding Effort
english.objectives: Activate $1oa Arcane Wards in Ambervale.
english.description:
<This small device of elegant nightborne design crackles gently with arcane power.

Kel'danath's notes mention wards that keep the withered at bay. It seems he found some form of spellcasting that does not tempt their ravenous appetite for magic.

These may prove useful in your search for the missing arcanist.>

text.title: 黑暗骑士
text.objectives: 在卡拉赞墓穴打败黑暗骑士并取得乌萨勒斯。
text.description:
河流边上有一扇下水道格栅，它可以通向卡拉赞的地下墓穴。我以前从没留意过它，不过那里可能就是幽灵指出来的地方。

想一想，黑暗骑士可能一直都在我们眼皮子底下！走吧，我们去看看里面会有什么。

english.title: The Dark Riders
english.objectives: Defeat the Dark Riders in the Karazhan Catacombs and claim Ulthalesh.
english.description:
There's a sewer grate along the edge of the river leading to catacombs underneath Karazhan. I've never paid it much attention, but it could be where the spirits are directing us.

To think, the Dark Riders may have been under our noses this entire time! Come, let us see where this leads.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成黑暗骑士场景战役

text.title: 获取力量
text.objectives: 回去找达拉然下水道的卡里杜斯。
text.description:
我们的目标已经达成，术士，是时候说再见了。然而要是以后再也不见，那我会很高兴的。

走吧，回去找你的黑暗主人。我们到此为止吧。

english.title: The Power Possessed
english.objectives: Return to Calydus in The Underbelly in Dalaran.
english.description:
Our goals have been met, warlock, and it is time we part ways.  I think I will be glad to see the last of you.

Go on, return to your dark masters. We are done here.

text.title: Corrupted Studies
text.objectives: Survey digsites in Stormheim and bring Brann back $1oa War of the Ancients Fragments.
text.description: Stormheim is steeped with artifacts from tha War of the Ancients. Demon artifacts ta be exact.$b$bI think these artifacts can clue us into some knowledge about their leader, Sargeras. I've already found some fragments to a titan disc, but need ta find the rest of 'em.$b$bI need ya ta dig around Stormheim and see if ye can find any more fragments so we can reassemble the disc.

english.title: Corrupted Studies
english.objectives: Survey digsites in Stormheim and bring Brann back $1oa War of the Ancients Fragments.
english.description: Stormheim is steeped with artifacts from tha War of the Ancients. Demon artifacts ta be exact.$b$bI think these artifacts can clue us into some knowledge about their leader, Sargeras. I've already found some fragments to a titan disc, but need ta find the rest of 'em.$b$bI need ya ta dig around Stormheim and see if ye can find any more fragments so we can reassemble the disc.

text.title: Fragments of the Fjords
text.objectives: Meet with Brann Bronzebeard in Stormheim.
text.description: $n, have you seen my ledger around here? I seemed to have misplaced it when I was stowing some canopic jars.$b$bOh, nevermind. Brann Bronzebeard has sent for you though. He's in Stormheim continuing his research.$b$bMake your way out to him and let him know I'm still waiting on those flayed-skin chronicles he found.

english.title: Fragments of the Fjords
english.objectives: Meet with Brann Bronzebeard in Stormheim.
english.description: $n, have you seen my ledger around here? I seemed to have misplaced it when I was stowing some canopic jars.$b$bOh, nevermind. Brann Bronzebeard has sent for you though. He's in Stormheim continuing his research.$b$bMake your way out to him and let him know I'm still waiting on those flayed-skin chronicles he found.

text.title: 排除法
text.objectives: 在风暴峡湾进行挖掘，直到找出泰坦圆盘的碎片。
text.description: 有太多地方都可能挖出碎片，所以要找到其他埋藏着泰坦圆盘碎片的正确地点非常不容易。$b$b不过我已经想好了计划。我需要你用排除法找出圆盘可能埋藏的地方，这样我们就可以在风暴峡湾缩小挖掘的范围。$b$b你负责一部分区域，我负责其他的区域。你有任何发现的话，就回这里碰头。

english.title: Process of Elimination
english.objectives: Dig around Stormheim until you find a piece of the Titan Disc.
english.description: With so many places ta dig up fragments, it's become quite a pain figuring out where ta look for more of the titan disc.$b$bI have a plan though. I need ye ta eliminate potential areas where the disc could exist so we can narrow down where in Stormheim it might exist.$b$bYou take part of the area an' I'll take the other part. Meet back here if ye find anythin'.

text.title: 土归土
text.objectives: 为露妮丽找到一个鲜红的岩石核心，一个鲜红的大地核心和一个鲜红的熔岩核心。集齐三个核心后返回沙塔斯向她复命。
text.description: 大地可以产生力量，这样的力量可以被灌注到强大的武器中。$b$b你的表情告诉我，你想要了解如何制造这样的武器。$b$b在这颗濒死的星球上，依然有生物具有这样的力量。把它们的核心带来给我，我会用你想要的知识来交换。

english.title: Earth to Earth
english.objectives: Recover a Cardinal Stone Core, a Cardinal Earth Core, and a Cardinal Lava Core for Lunelli. Bring them back to her in Shattrath when you have all three.
english.description: From the earth comes strength, and such strength can be imbued into weapons of power.$b$bYou have the look of one who seeks to know how to create such weapons.$b$bThere are creatures that still inhabit this dying planet who bear such strength. Bring me their cores and I shall trade you the knowledge you seek.

text.title: 一团乱麻
text.objectives: 在阿苏纳与布莱恩·铜须见面。
text.description: 噢，你好，$n。我跟你说，自从我接手这个店铺以来，除了头痛还是头痛。我不管找什么东西都总是找不到。$b$b不过我这会儿倒是想起来了，布莱恩·铜须在找你。他正在阿苏纳寻找其他的什么碎片。$b$b噢，那些锡镴水杯又去哪了……

english.title: Out of the Frying Pan
english.objectives: Meet with Brann in Azsuna.
english.description: Oh hello, $n. I tell you, ever since I was given this shop, it's been nothing but a headache. I can't seem to ever find what I'm looking for.$b$bWhich reminds me, Brann Bronzebeard has sent for you. He's in Azsuna tracking down more pieces of whatever it is he's searching for.$b$bNow where'd those pewter drinking cups go...

text.title: And Into the Fel Fire
text.objectives: Survey digsites in Azsuna and find $1oa missing Parts of the Infernal Device and bring them back to Brann.
text.description: I found something, $n. Well, a couple of things actually.$b$bFirst I found an ancient text talking about a demon who harnessed the power of the titan disc I've been searching for.$b$bThen I found a device which supposedly is used to summon 'im! Only, it's missin' some pieces from what I can make out.$b$bI'm sure if we survey around Azsuna some more, those missin' pieces are sure ta turn up.

english.title: And Into the Fel Fire
english.objectives: Survey digsites in Azsuna and find $1oa missing Parts of the Infernal Device and bring them back to Brann.
english.description: I found something, $n. Well, a couple of things actually.$b$bFirst I found an ancient text talking about a demon who harnessed the power of the titan disc I've been searching for.$b$bThen I found a device which supposedly is used to summon 'im! Only, it's missin' some pieces from what I can make out.$b$bI'm sure if we survey around Azsuna some more, those missin' pieces are sure ta turn up.

text.title: The Apocalypse Bringer
text.objectives: Talk to Brann when you're ready to activate the device.
text.description: Right, well, I managed to piece the device back together.$b$bI guess I'll jes' turn it on when you're ready and we'll see what happens, yea?

english.title: The Apocalypse Bringer
english.objectives: Talk to Brann when you're ready to activate the device.
english.description: Right, well, I managed to piece the device back together.$b$bI guess I'll jes' turn it on when you're ready and we'll see what happens, yea?

text.title: 更近一步
text.objectives: 在苏拉玛与布莱恩见面。
text.description: $n！我刚听说，那个痴迷于泰坦研究的疯狂矮人布莱恩·铜须，决定到苏拉玛去寻找他极其重视的圆盘。$b$b以目前的情况，也只有疯子才会到那个地方去挖东西。$b$b我很确定他会需要你的帮助。

english.title: One Step Closer
english.objectives: Meet with Brann in Suramar.
english.description: $n! I just heard that Brann Bronzebeard - that crazy, titan-obsessed dwarf - has decided to go hunting for his precious disc in Suramar.$b$bTalk about the last place you'd want to go digging around, given the current events.$b$bI'm sure he could use your help.

text.title: 破译恶魔谜题
text.objectives: 获得$1oa件修复的遗物，并找到$2oa块密室钥匙碎片，然后把它们交给布莱恩。
text.description: 我找到一件东西，似乎是一把残缺的钥匙。我很肯定，如果能找到它缺失的部分，我就可以把它复原。$B$B接着，我们需要弄清楚它可以打开什么东西。我想，我大概知道该怎么做。$b$b我一直在研究我发现的神器，它们似乎都指向一间密室。$b$b我需要更多神器做进一步的研究。

english.title: Deciphering Demonology
english.objectives: Crate artifacts into $1oa Restored Artifacts and find $2oa Chamber Key Fragments and bring them to Brann.
english.description: I found a piece of what appears to be a key to something. I'm certain I can restore it if we can find the other bits.$b$bAfter that, we need to figure out what it's a key to. An' I think I know how to do that.$b$bI've been studying some of the artifacts I've found, and they seem to be pointing to a hidden chamber. I jes' need some more artifacts to study.

text.title: 黑暗秘密
text.objectives: 在密室入口与布莱恩碰头。进去之后，跟紧布莱恩，以防万一。
text.description: 我拼好了钥匙，而且已经准备好去打开密室了。$b$b等你方便的时候就到那里跟我碰头，我们一起去看看里面到底有什么！

english.title: Dark Secrets
english.objectives: Meet Brann at the entrance to the secret chamber. Once inside, stay close to Brann in case anything happens.
english.description: I fixed the key and am ready to open the chamber.$b$bMeet me there when you have a chance and we'll discover what waits inside together!

text.title: 邪恶的碎片
text.objectives: 把勘测设备箱带到瓦尔莎拉交给布莱恩。
text.description: 布莱恩·铜须要我拿更多的勘测设备给他，不过我实在没空。$b$b$n，你愿意好心帮个忙，把这箱东西给他送过去吗？我会感激不尽的。

english.title: Fel Fragments
english.objectives: Deliver the crate of surveying equipment to Brann in Val'sharah.
english.description: Brann Bronzebeard has requested that I send him more surveying equipment, but I just don't have the time.$b$bWould you be a dear and take this crate to him, $n? I'd truly appreciate it.

text.title: The Purple Hills of Mac'Aree
text.objectives: Find the remaining pages of The Purple Hills of Mac'Aree and assemble them into the final book. Return the book to Brann when you have finished.
text.description: Now that we're re-supplied, we can get back ta work.$b$bI found something here that I think ye'll be interested in. It's a page of a book talking about the world of Argus. But before the demons destroyed it.$b$bAnyway, it's been me experience that if ye find one of something, there's sure ta be more of it around.$b$bKeep lookin' around Val'sharah for more of these pages and bring what ye find back ta me. And take the page I found with ya so ye know what yer lookin' fer.

english.title: The Purple Hills of Mac'Aree
english.objectives: Find the remaining pages of The Purple Hills of Mac'Aree and assemble them into the final book. Return the book to Brann when you have finished.
english.description: Now that we're re-supplied, we can get back ta work.$b$bI found something here that I think ye'll be interested in. It's a page of a book talking about the world of Argus. But before the demons destroyed it.$b$bAnyway, it's been me experience that if ye find one of something, there's sure ta be more of it around.$b$bKeep lookin' around Val'sharah for more of these pages and bring what ye find back ta me. And take the page I found with ya so ye know what yer lookin' fer.

text.title: Darkheart Thicket: Through the Fog
text.objectives: Obtain the Final Chapter of The Purple Hills of Mac'Aree.
text.description: I can't believe that after all that searchin' ye did, it's still missing a chapter!$b$bI'm willin' ta bet that those satyrs got a hand on it and took it somewhere. Probably somewhere dark where no one could find it.$b$bI've heard rumors of a place, the Darkheart Thicket they call it, where the strongest of the satyrs are.$b$bIf I had ta guess, I'd say ye need to go there and look around fer it.

english.title: Darkheart Thicket: Through the Fog
english.objectives: Obtain the Final Chapter of The Purple Hills of Mac'Aree.
english.description: I can't believe that after all that searchin' ye did, it's still missing a chapter!$b$bI'm willin' ta bet that those satyrs got a hand on it and took it somewhere. Probably somewhere dark where no one could find it.$b$bI've heard rumors of a place, the Darkheart Thicket they call it, where the strongest of the satyrs are.$b$bIf I had ta guess, I'd say ye need to go there and look around fer it.

text.title: 修复圣物
text.objectives: 旁观布莱恩重组泰坦圆盘。
text.description: 很好，很好！现在我们找到了所有的碎片，是时候重组圆盘了！

english.title: The Relic Renewed
english.objectives: Observe Brann as he puts the Titan Disc back together.
english.description: Very good, very good! Now that we have all the pieces, it's time to put this disc back together!

text.title: The Reliquary Calls
text.objectives: Meet with Tae'thelan Bloodwatcher in Azsuna.
text.description: Tae'thelan of the Reliquary has asked me to send anyone who may be able to help them in Azsuna.$b$bSeeing as how you happened into my shop purely by coincidence, I thought you'd be willing to go, $n.$b$bBack to work for me though. So much to do and so little help.$b$b<Dariness lets out a sigh.>

english.title: The Reliquary Calls
english.objectives: Meet with Tae'thelan Bloodwatcher in Azsuna.
english.description: Tae'thelan of the Reliquary has asked me to send anyone who may be able to help them in Azsuna.$b$bSeeing as how you happened into my shop purely by coincidence, I thought you'd be willing to go, $n.$b$bBack to work for me though. So much to do and so little help.$b$b<Dariness lets out a sigh.>

text.title: 先祖的回声
text.objectives: 完成$1oa项上层精灵考古工程。
text.description: 这片土地有许多秘密和上古时代的神器。$b$b据我所知，附近就有一件拥有强大力量的神器。我只需要缩小搜索的范围。$b$b我要你挖掘更多的神器，并且尽可能地了解更多的信息。等你觉得自己研究得差不多了，就回来跟我分享你的情报。

english.title: Echoes of My Ancestors
english.objectives: Complete $1oa Highborne Archaeology Projects.
english.description: This land holds many secrets and many artifacts of ancient times.$b$bFrom what I've been able to discern there's an artifact of great power close to here. I just need to narrow down its location.$b$bI'd like you to dig up more artifacts and learn what you can. When you feel you've done enough research, come back to me and share your knowledge.

text.title: A Beacon of Hope
text.objectives: Go to the location Tae'thelan marked on your map and survey the area until you find the artifact.
text.description: I've marked the location of the artifact on your map. It's in a rather hostile location, so I'd like you to go there and find it.$b$bWhen you've recovered it, bring it back to me so I can discern its power.

english.title: A Beacon of Hope
english.objectives: Go to the location Tae'thelan marked on your map and survey the area until you find the artifact.
english.description: I've marked the location of the artifact on your map. It's in a rather hostile location, so I'd like you to go there and find it.$b$bWhen you've recovered it, bring it back to me so I can discern its power.

text.title: Worth Its Weight
text.objectives: Meet with Tae'thelan in Suramar.
text.description: $n, if you were a crate of black trilobites, where do you think I would have put you?$b$b<Dariness begins looking around the shop.>$b$bOh, that reminds me. Tae'thelan has requested your presence. He's onto something in Suramar and needs your help.

english.title: Worth Its Weight
english.objectives: Meet with Tae'thelan in Suramar.
english.description: $n, if you were a crate of black trilobites, where do you think I would have put you?$b$b<Dariness begins looking around the shop.>$b$bOh, that reminds me. Tae'thelan has requested your presence. He's onto something in Suramar and needs your help.

text.title: Fit for an Elven Queen
text.objectives: Fight your way through Suramar into the chamber that holds the crown. Inspect the crown and report your findings back to Tae'thelan.
