text.description: The nightborne have dropped their shield allowing us to penetrate their city and learn their secrets.$b$bOne such secret I've discovered is a crown of immeasurable power.$b$bI'd like you to find this crown and report back to me on what it does.

english.title: Fit for an Elven Queen
english.objectives: Fight your way through Suramar into the chamber that holds the crown. Inspect the crown and report your findings back to Tae'thelan.
english.description: The nightborne have dropped their shield allowing us to penetrate their city and learn their secrets.$b$bOne such secret I've discovered is a crown of immeasurable power.$b$bI'd like you to find this crown and report back to me on what it does.

text.title: 废墟寻宝
text.objectives: 在苏拉玛的各个地方进行勘测，直到你找到$1oa件遗失的皇冠珠宝。
text.description: 那么，我们的下一步行动应该很明白了。寻找珠宝。$b$b它们肯定就在苏拉玛的某个地方，我们最好立刻开始搜寻。$b$b我会从这里协调调查行动，你和我的助手们进行实地工作。

english.title: Sifting Through the Rubble
english.objectives: Survey different areas around Suramar until you find the $1oa missing Jewels of the Crown.
english.description: Then I believe it's clear what we must do next. Find the jewels.$b$bThey're bound to be here somewhere in Suramar, so we better start looking.$b$bI'll coordinate the search from here, while you and my assistants look for the jewels.

text.title: 地精考古
text.objectives: 在瓦尔莎拉与泰瑟兰见面。
text.description: 我不确定你对这件事有没有兴趣。神圣遗物学会已经雇佣了地精协助他们在这片地区挖掘古物。$b$b我要你去一探究竟，调查这个传闻的真实性，而且我也想知道他们有什么收获。

english.title: Goblin Archaeology
english.objectives: Meet with Tae'thelan in Val'sharah.
english.description: I'm not sure if you're in on this, but the Reliquary has commissioned the goblins to help them with uncovering artifacts in this land.$b$bI'd like you to go and see if there's any validity to this rumor... and I'd also be interested to know the results.

text.title: Explosive Results
text.objectives: Use the goblin explosives to free $1oa Artifact Fragments from their geological prisons.
text.description: As you may or may not have heard, I've been working with the goblins on using a new way of uncovering our artifacts.$b$bAnd if you know anything about goblins, you know that I'm talking about explosives.$b$bWe've only run a few tests here at my camp, but I would appreciate your help in testing this method out in the field.$b$bI've marked a location on your map that has some particularly difficult digs.

english.title: Explosive Results
english.objectives: Use the goblin explosives to free $1oa Artifact Fragments from their geological prisons.
english.description: As you may or may not have heard, I've been working with the goblins on using a new way of uncovering our artifacts.$b$bAnd if you know anything about goblins, you know that I'm talking about explosives.$b$bWe've only run a few tests here at my camp, but I would appreciate your help in testing this method out in the field.$b$bI've marked a location on your map that has some particularly difficult digs.

text.title: What Once Was Lost
text.objectives: Go to the location marked on the map and recover the artifact in question. Use the dynamite to uncover the artifact.
text.description: That reminds me, I found a map to a chamber that may or may not hold something of value.$b$bIt doesn't seem to have any power associated with it, which is why I'm handing it over to you.$b$bHere, take some more explosives. They may help speed of the process of finding it.

english.title: What Once Was Lost
english.objectives: Go to the location marked on the map and recover the artifact in question. Use the dynamite to uncover the artifact.
english.description: That reminds me, I found a map to a chamber that may or may not hold something of value.$b$bIt doesn't seem to have any power associated with it, which is why I'm handing it over to you.$b$bHere, take some more explosives. They may help speed of the process of finding it.

text.title: 难以言喻的力量
text.objectives: 在苏拉玛与泰瑟兰·血望者见面。
text.description: $n，我收到高阶考察者的一条紧急信息，他要你去找他。$b$b他终于找到了某种非常非常强大的东西，所以希望你帮他取回来。$b$b在那里的时候要格外当心，$n。只要一提到拥有能量的古物，泰瑟兰可能会变得有点狂热。

english.title: Unspeakable Power
english.objectives: Meet with Tae'thelan Bloodwatcher in Suramar.
english.description: $n, I received an urgent message from the High Examiner requesting your presence.$b$bHe's finally found something powerful-- VERY powerful--and he wants your help in recovering it.$b$bBe careful down there, $n. Tae'thelan can be a tad fanatical when it comes to artifacts that hold any sort of energy.

text.title: 掘地三尺
text.objectives: 在苏拉玛进行勘测，找到$1oa个破烂的上层精灵卷轴。
text.description: 我是对的，这里的夜之子确实拥有力量强大的东西。我发现了一篇古代文献，里面提到一件叫做斯卡拉克斯宝珠的物品。$b$b根据我对上古之战的研究，斯卡拉克斯是个恶魔领主，曾经来到苏拉玛，并且把一件强大的神器送给了精灵，从而换取他们对燃烧军团的忠心。$b$b我还没有找到它的确切位置，不过我们只要掘地三尺，就肯定能找到答案。

english.title: Narrowing Down
english.objectives: Survey Suramar and uncover $1oa Tattered Highborne Scrolls.
english.description: I was right about the nightborne here having objects of great power. I found an ancient text referring to such an object called the Orb of Sciallax.$b$bFrom what I recall in studying the War of the Ancients, Sciallax was a demon lord who came to Suramar and offered the elves at the time a powerful artifact in return for their servitude to the Legion.$b$bI haven't discovered the exact location yet as to the whereabouts, but perhaps some digging can yield us an answer.

text.title: Uncovering the Orb of Sciallax
text.objectives: Meet Tae'thelan Bloodwatcher at the entrance to the chamber where the Orb of Sciallax is held. Once inside, set the charges on the casing and recover the artifact.
text.description: We'll need to hurry before the nightborne realize what we're after.$b$bI'm bringing the goblins along in case we run into any obstacles along the way.$b$bI've marked the location of the entrance to the chamber the Orb resides in on your map.$b$bMeet me there as soon as you're ready and we'll claim this artifact for our own.

english.title: Uncovering the Orb of Sciallax
english.objectives: Meet Tae'thelan Bloodwatcher at the entrance to the chamber where the Orb of Sciallax is held. Once inside, set the charges on the casing and recover the artifact.
english.description: We'll need to hurry before the nightborne realize what we're after.$b$bI'm bringing the goblins along in case we run into any obstacles along the way.$b$bI've marked the location of the entrance to the chamber the Orb resides in on your map.$b$bMeet me there as soon as you're ready and we'll claim this artifact for our own.

text.title: 学术研究
text.objectives: 在阿苏纳与泰瑟兰见面。
text.description: $n，很高兴见到你。目前为止，你觉得我的商店怎么样？只有一个人在经营，算是不错了吧？$b$b对了，高阶考察者泰瑟兰正在阿苏纳挖掘古物，他要我通知你去找他。$b$b根据我对他的了解，他大概以为自己又找到一件惊为天人的古物了吧。

english.title: Academic Exploration
english.objectives: Meet with Tae'thelan in Azsuna.
english.description: $n, good to see you. What do you think of my shop so far? Not too bad for just one person, huh?$b$bBy the way, High Examiner Tae'thalan has been digging around Azsuna, and asked that I send you to see him.$b$bKnowing him, he probably thinks he's found yet another world-shatteringly powerful artifact.

text.title: 尝试出真知
text.objectives: 找到其余的$1oa块阿苏纳钥匙模具组件，然后把它们交给泰瑟兰。
text.description: 多年的经验告诉我，老办法总是好办法，而且不是没有原因的。我现在受够了替代的挖掘方法，只想一心一意使用正确的手段。$b$b对了，我相信我又找到了一件强大的神器，我愿意不惜一切代价真正拥有它。$b$b我找到的东西看起来像是一个钥匙模具的零件。我现在只需要找到它的其余零件。

english.title: Tried and True
english.objectives: Find the remaining $1oa Azsunian Key Mold Pieces and return them to Tae'thelan.
english.description: I have realized through experience that the old methods are usually the best and for good reason. I'm done with alternate means of digging for now, and wish to focus on the right way to do things.$b$bThat being said, I believe I've found a new powerful artifact and I'll do literally anything to have it.$b$bI've uncovered a fragment that appears to be a mold for a key. I now simply need the other pieces.

text.title: The Keys to Success
text.objectives: Bring the mold to Alard Schmied in Dalaran and have him help you forge a new set of keys. Return to Tae'thelan when you have the finished set.
text.description: I'd like you to take the mold to the blacksmith in Dalaran. Alard, I believe his name is.$b$bHave him help you forge a new set of keys.$b$bI found some writing on the back of the mold that may hold the answer to what these keys unlock. I'll stay here and try to translate the text.

english.title: The Keys to Success
english.objectives: Bring the mold to Alard Schmied in Dalaran and have him help you forge a new set of keys. Return to Tae'thelan when you have the finished set.
english.description: I'd like you to take the mold to the blacksmith in Dalaran. Alard, I believe his name is.$b$bHave him help you forge a new set of keys.$b$bI found some writing on the back of the mold that may hold the answer to what these keys unlock. I'll stay here and try to translate the text.

objectiveDetails.description: Cool the mold in Alard's Quenching Trough
Fill the mold on Alard's Workbench
Melt the metal at Alard's Forge
Bring the mold to Alard Schmied

text.title: History of Highmountain
text.objectives: Meet with Lessah in Highmountain.
text.description: Let's see, one... two... three... oh, hello $n. Sorry I didn't see you come in.$b$bThings have been hectic around here. I could really use an assistant.$b$bI do have something for you though, a fellow archaeologist named Lessah has been asking for someone to help her in Highmountain.$b$bI thought you'd be the perfect person for the job.

english.title: History of Highmountain
english.objectives: Meet with Lessah in Highmountain.
english.description: Let's see, one... two... three... oh, hello $n. Sorry I didn't see you come in.$b$bThings have been hectic around here. I could really use an assistant.$b$bI do have something for you though, a fellow archaeologist named Lessah has been asking for someone to help her in Highmountain.$b$bI thought you'd be the perfect person for the job.

text.title: Surveying Student
text.objectives: Complete 20 successful surveys with Luron present.
text.description: The reason I sent for someone was that I've been having trouble keeping up with my research and training my assistant.$b$bI was hoping you might be able to show him the ropes again. Get him reacquainted with surveying.$b$bJust speak with him when you're ready to go.

english.title: Surveying Student
english.objectives: Complete 20 successful surveys with Luron present.
english.description: The reason I sent for someone was that I've been having trouble keeping up with my research and training my assistant.$b$bI was hoping you might be able to show him the ropes again. Get him reacquainted with surveying.$b$bJust speak with him when you're ready to go.

text.title: Neltharion's Lair: Misdirected
text.objectives: Go to Neltharion's Lair and recover the Ancient Highmountain Artifact.
text.description: I've been looking into the history of Huln Highmountain, a legendary warrior from the War of the Ancients whom this very land is named after.$b$bAllegedly some of his personal effects were carried here after his death and have been lost in time.$b$bAfter some digging around I believe I have discovered the location of one of his artifacts to be in a place called Neltharion's Lair.$b$bI'm no fighter, $n, but you are. Will you go and recover this artifact for me?

english.title: Neltharion's Lair: Misdirected
english.objectives: Go to Neltharion's Lair and recover the Ancient Highmountain Artifact.
english.description: I've been looking into the history of Huln Highmountain, a legendary warrior from the War of the Ancients whom this very land is named after.$b$bAllegedly some of his personal effects were carried here after his death and have been lost in time.$b$bAfter some digging around I believe I have discovered the location of one of his artifacts to be in a place called Neltharion's Lair.$b$bI'm no fighter, $n, but you are. Will you go and recover this artifact for me?

text.title: 新的线索
text.objectives: 在至高岭与莱莎见面。
text.description: $n，莱莎要你到至高岭去找她。$b$b她似乎发现了一条线索，跟胡恩·高岭曾经穿戴的一件古代装备有关。$b$b你有空就去找她吧。

english.title: A New Lead
english.objectives: Meet with Lessah in Highmountain.
english.description: $n, Lessah in Highmountain has been asking for you.$b$bApparently she's caught a lead on some ancient piece of armor that Huln Highmountain used to wear.$b$bWhen you can, make your way out to her.

text.title: 水晶之眼
text.objectives: 在至高岭与两块不同的共鸣石进行交流。每块石头需要三块至高岭仪式石才能激活。
text.description: 我对这些洞穴进行深入探索之后发现了许多古老的文字。$b$b最有意思的是，这些文字刻在卓格巴尔居住地的共鸣水晶上面。不幸的是，他们和本地的牛头人之间有矛盾，这成为了我研究的障碍。$b$b后来我想到，卓格巴尔的麻烦你应该可以解决。$b$b我要你继续进行我的研究，尽你所能寻找关于胡恩的线索。

english.title: Crystal Eyes
english.objectives: Interact with the two different resonating stones in Highmountain. Each stone requires 3 Highmountain Ritual-Stones to activate.
english.description: I've delved into the caves here and have discovered many ancient writings.$b$bThe most interesting I've found are resonating crystals, where the drogbar have resided. Unfortunately, they aren't on very good terms with the tauren here and this has hindered my research.$b$bI thought, should there be any trouble with the drogbar, that you'd be able to handle them.$b$bI'd like you to continue my research and discover what you can about Huln.

text.title: 卓格巴尔骗术
text.objectives: 取得古代项链并交给莱莎。
text.description: 根据我的研究以及你提供的信息，我已经找出了项链的位置。$b$b它在一个卓格巴尔洞穴的深处，我觉得他们可不会轻易交给你，$n。$b$b我要你不惜一切代价取得那条项链。

english.title: Drogbar Deception
english.objectives: Recover the ancient necklace and bring it back to Lessah.
english.description: According to my research and the information you gave me, I've isolated the location of the necklace.$b$bIt's deep in a drogbar cave, and I'm willing to bet they're not just going to hand it over to you, $n.$b$bI need you to recover that necklace at any cost.

text.title: The Right Path
text.objectives: Meet with Lessah in Highmountain.
text.description: This new shop is shaping up quite nicely, I think. Still, there's so much left to organize.$b$b$n, Lessah has requested your presence in Highmountain. Something about a moose?$b$bI'm not sure to what she's speaking of, but as soon as you have a chance, please go see her.

english.title: The Right Path
english.objectives: Meet with Lessah in Highmountain.
english.description: This new shop is shaping up quite nicely, I think. Still, there's so much left to organize.$b$b$n, Lessah has requested your presence in Highmountain. Something about a moose?$b$bI'm not sure to what she's speaking of, but as soon as you have a chance, please go see her.

text.title: Laying to Rest
text.objectives: Find $1oa Bone Fragments of Eche'ro and return them to Lessah in Highmountain. Then observe the burial ceremony Lessah performs.
text.description: If I was able to find a bone fragment in what appeared to be a random location, then that means Eche'ro's bones must be scattered around Highmountain.$b$bWe must find his remains and give him the proper burial he deserved.$b$bOh, I'm sorry, in case you weren't aware, Eche'ro was Huln Highmountain's mount and companion.$b$bHe deserves to be honored as Huln once was.

english.title: Laying to Rest
english.objectives: Find $1oa Bone Fragments of Eche'ro and return them to Lessah in Highmountain. Then observe the burial ceremony Lessah performs.
english.description: If I was able to find a bone fragment in what appeared to be a random location, then that means Eche'ro's bones must be scattered around Highmountain.$b$bWe must find his remains and give him the proper burial he deserved.$b$bOh, I'm sorry, in case you weren't aware, Eche'ro was Huln Highmountain's mount and companion.$b$bHe deserves to be honored as Huln once was.

text.title: 救助小猫
text.objectives: “带领”7只迷路的羽鬃小猫回家。
text.description:
在你帮助迷路的鹰头小猫时，我到处看了看情况。

这些好奇的生物似乎常常会脱离父母的看护。其中的一些被路对面的一头游荡的双头怪困住了。

他好像……会……吃掉它们。

我们如果把尤隆的孩子送回家，就可以得到他的祝福。

english.title: You've Got to Be Kitten Me Right Meow
english.objectives: "Herd" 7 Lost Feathermane Kittens back home.
english.description:
While you were dealing with the stray Owlkitten, I took a look around.

It seems these curious creatures have a habit of escaping their parents' watchful eyes - some are trapped across the road by a wandering Ettin. 

He appears to have been... ahem... eating them.

We can earn Yowlon's blessing by bringing his children home.

text.title: 未知的遗物
text.objectives: 收集班布利·莫里森的遗物。
text.description: 班布利……我还是不敢相信。$b$b我不能把他留在这里……在这个地方……像现在这个样子。$b$b帮我找到他的遗物，这样我就可以把他的遗物带回家，他属于那里。$b$b我们要为他举行一场体面的葬礼……这是他应得的！

english.title: Parts Unknown
english.objectives: Collect Brambley Morrison's remains.
english.description: Brambley... I still canna' believe it.$b$bI canna' leave the lad here... not in this place... not like this.$b$bHelp me find the rest of him, so I can take his remains back home where he belongs.$b$bWe'll give him a proper burial... it's what he deserves!

text.title: 诱捕者的教训
text.objectives: 消灭6个夜之子诱捕者。
text.description: 诱捕者为数众多，你只消灭了其中的一个。$b$b夜之子制服了本地的生物，用来进行某种娱乐性的展览。我认为他们这两方面都应该受到打击。$b$b消灭这些诱捕者，$r。让他们学会尊重自己的猎物。

english.title: They Become The Hunted
english.objectives: Slay 6 Nightborne Trappers.
english.description: The trapper you slew was but one of many.$b$bThe Nightborne are subjugating the local creatures, creating a sort of pleasurable exhibit. I think we can strike them in two places at once.$b$bDescend upon these trappers, $r. Let us teach them a lesson in respecting their prey.

text.title: 优胜劣汰
text.objectives: 在动物园释放$1oa个展览生物。
text.description: 你从诱捕者身上找到的颈圈虽然简单，却十分有效。夜之子就是通过把颈圈套到动物身上，从而让它们平静下来，认他们做主人。$b$b莉莉娅用你找到的陷阱逆转了法术。$b$b颈圈里面的魔法现在可以用来解除其他颈圈的效果。$b$b给夜之子一个教训，让他们知道生命总会自己找到出路。
text.end: 在动物园释放$1oa个展览生物。

english.title: Survival of the Fittest
english.objectives: Free $1oa exhibits from the Menagerie.
english.description: The collar you took from the trapper is simple, but effective. Affixing the collar to a target will make them complacent and obedient to their Nightborne masters. Lilryia was able to reverse the spell using the traps you found.$b$bThe magics in the collar can now be used to cancel out the other collars.$b$bHow about giving the Nightborne a reminder that nature always finds a way?

text.title: 诺莫瑞根的未来
text.objectives: 在新工匠镇与穆菲努斯·铬酒见面。
text.description: 每帮助一个幸存者逃出饱受污染的诺莫瑞根，对我们来说都是一场胜利。诺莫瑞根未来的希望就寄托在像你这样的$C身上。因此，我们的领袖大工匠梅卡托克组建了一支培训团队，帮助你们学习本职业的技能。$B$B穆菲努斯·铬酒将会帮助你进行训练并适应地表生活。他正在路对面的哨所等你呢。

english.title: The Future of Gnomeregan
english.objectives: Meet with Muffinus Chromebrew in New Tinkertown.
english.description: It's a victory for us every time we're able to help another survivor escape from the contaminated halls of Gnomeregan. $Cs like you will play an important part in the future of Gnomeregan. To that end, our leader, High Tinker Mekkatorque, has assembled a team of trainers to help you learn your arts.$B$BMuffinus Chromebrew will help oversee your training and adjustment to life on the surface. He's waiting for you on the stands across the road.

text.title: 晋见大工匠
text.objectives: 向新工匠镇的大工匠梅卡托克做自我介绍。
text.description: 我不知道你是否还记得梅卡托克。内温跟我说，诺莫瑞根的幸存者普遍患有失忆症。$B$B梅卡托克，更正式地说，大工匠梅卡托克，是所有侏儒的领袖。他有个习惯，就是要亲自接见每一位幸存者。你应该去见见他。他就在镇中心的帐篷里，跟他的军事参谋们在一起。
text.completed: 向新工匠镇的大工匠梅卡托克做自我介绍。

english.title: Meet the High Tinker
english.objectives: Introduce yourself to High Tinker Mekkatorque in New Tinkertown.
english.description: I don't know if you'll remember Mekkatorque or not. Nevin tells me that memory loss is pretty common for a Gnomeregan survivor.$B$BMekkatorque, or more properly, the High Tinker Mekkatorque is the leader of all the gnomes. He has made a habit of meeting with every rescued survivor personally. You should introduce yourself to him. He'll be with his war council beneath the tent in the center of town.
english.completed: Introduce yourself to High Tinker Mekkatorque in New Tinkertown.

text.title: 前往阿苏纳
text.objectives: 与大法师卡德加交谈以飞往阿苏纳。
text.description:
$n，我们必须设法重新封印萨格拉斯之墓。

我发现了一件古老圣物的线索，或许是阻止燃烧军团的关键。

我们从古代精灵之岛阿苏纳开始搜寻吧。很久以前，那里是苏拉玛的上层精灵精进魔法力量之地，但现在只剩下一片受到诅咒的废墟。

伊利达雷恶魔猎手已经在岛上设立了一个营地。在那片土地上，我们只认识他们，所以我们就先到那里去。

准备好起飞了吗？
text.completion:
As I suspected, the Illidari are holding the line against the Burning Legion, but just barely.

We must come to their aid, $n.

english.title: Down to Azsuna
english.objectives: Speak with Archmage Khadgar to fly down to Azsuna.
english.description:
$n, we must find a way to reseal the Tomb of Sargeras.

I have uncovered information concerning an ancient relic, which might be the key to stopping the Legion.

Our search begins on the ancient elven island of Azsuna. Long ago, it was where the Highborne elves of Suramar perfected their mightiest of magics. Now it is a cursed ruin.

The Illidari demon hunters have established a camp on the island. As they are the only people we know in the area, that is where we will begin.

Ready to take wing?
english.completion:
As I suspected, the Illidari are holding the line against the Burning Legion, but just barely.

We must come to their aid, $n.

text.title: 返回马顿。
text.objectives: 进入伊利达雷传送门，登上马顿的邪能之槌号。
text.description: 传送门完全运作起来了，$n。噢，我的激动之情简直溢于言表！$B$B告诉杰斯和其他人，我们非常期待大家的到来。我们有太多事情要做，可时间已经所剩无几。$B$B你也会登船和我们一起吧？

english.title: Return to Mardum
english.objectives: Enter the Illidari Gateway to board the Fel Hammer in Mardum.
english.description: The gateway is fully functional, $n. Ooh, I am positively tingling with excitement!$B$BDo let Jace and the others know that we eagerly await your arrival. There's so much to do and ever so little time.$B$BYou will be joining us aboard, won't you?

text.title: 进入深渊！
text.objectives: 护送安古斯到邪魂堡垒中的邪喉洞穴。
text.description: 邪喉洞穴？！时间紧迫，$n！$b$b我无法告诉你燃烧军团会怎么处置班布利，但一定不会有什么好事！$b$b快点！我们必须在燃烧军团对他为所欲为之前找到他！
text.end: 护送安古斯到邪魂堡垒中的邪喉洞穴。

english.title: Into The Pit!
english.objectives: Escort Angus to Felmaw Cavern in Felsoul Hold.
english.description: The felstalker pits?!$b$bThere's no time to waste, $n!$b$b I canna' tell ye what the Burnin' Legion has planned for ol' Brambley, but it canna' be good!$b$bHurry! We've got to find him before the Burnin' Legion has their way with him!
english.end: Escort Angus to Felmaw Cavern in Felsoul Hold.

objectiveDetails.description: 护送安古斯前往邪喉洞穴

text.title: 进化诱捕
text.objectives: 帮莉莉娅收集$1oa个奥术陷阱。
text.description: 夜之子做什么事都要借助魔法，连设置陷阱也不例外。$b$b夜眼见过他们的做法，他们用魔法陷阱来诱捕猎物，跟我们用的完全不同。$b$b把他们的陷阱带来给我，我要好好研究研究。

english.title: Trapping Evolved
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Arcane Traps for Lilryia.
english.description: The Nightborne are using magic for everything, even trapping.$b$bNighteyes saw them at work, laying down magical snares to capture prey rather than the kind our people use. $b$bBring me their traps so that I may study their make.

text.title: 顶级捕食者
text.objectives: 找到并消灭维持苏伊什驯服状态的夜之子。
text.description: 我有一个好消息和一个坏消息，$r。$b$b坏消息是，他们通过某种手段捕获并且驯服了一头魔暴龙。$b$B好消息是，它身上好像没有颈圈，而且十分温顺。我觉得它应该是把那里的某个夜之子当成自己的主人了。找到并消灭那个兽群领袖，我们要让他们自食其果。
text.end: 找到并消灭维持苏伊什驯服状态的夜之子。

english.title: Apex Predator
english.objectives: Find and slay the Nightborne keeping Su'esh obedient.
english.description: I have good news and bad news, $r.$b$bThe bad news is that they somehow managed to capture and train a Devilsaur.$b$BThe good news is that it doesn't seem to have a collar and is tame. I imagine it must think that one of the Nightborne in there is its master. Find the pack leader and take him out, and we will set quite a beast upon them.
english.end: Find and slay the Nightborne keeping Su'esh obedient.

text.title: Snowblind Mesa Phased Terrain Tracking Quest

english.title: Snowblind Mesa Phased Terrain Tracking Quest

objectiveDetails.description: Talk to Vereesa and leave Niskara
Travel through the portal to Niskara
Watch for the portal to open

text.title: 播种
text.objectives: 在梦境林地的松软泥土中播下纪元之种。
text.description: 你这把上古神兵十分强大，不过它还拥有更多的潜力。$b$b拿上这颗种子，世界形成之初的一整片茂密森林如今就剩下它了。在林地的西边播种，让它生根发芽。$b$b与它的魔力调合以后，种子本身以及你的武器都会得到强化。

english.title: Sowing The Seed
english.objectives: Plant the Seed of Ages in the Soft Soil within The Dreamgrove.
english.description: Your weapon is ancient and powerful but it holds the potential to be so much more.$b$bTake this seed, it is all that remains of a forest that grew tall when the world was young. Plant it within the grove to the west and allow it to take root.$b$bWith its power both it and your weapon will be far more than they are alone.

text.title: 美酒策略
text.objectives: 帮奇雷收集蟾蜍胃囊。
text.description: 有一样配料可以让我的水果无比诱人。$b$b许多人已经忘记法力鲑鱼酒的美味。那浓烈的芳香，醇厚的口感……$b$b北边的河流附近有一些蟾蜍，它们的胃囊可以浓缩这种添加物。帮我收集一些胃囊，我们就能获得足够的配料。

english.title: Blast of Spice Fish
english.objectives: Collect Toad Gizzards for Keelay.
english.description: I have an ingredient that will make my fruit irresistible.$b$bNot many remember the delicacy of manatrout liquor. Its pungent aroma, the unctuous mouthfeel...$b$bThe toads near the northern river concentrate this additive in their gizzards. Fetch some stomachs for me, and we will have plenty.

text.title: 突袭守望高塔：科达娜峰
毒水果
text.objectives: 在3个水果篮里下毒。
text.description: 是时候出手了。$b$b暗影花十分……有助消化。放一些到达格利尔的水果碗里，然后就等着看好戏吧。$b$b与此同时，我会用我的法力鲑鱼酒巩固我在城里的首席水果商的地位。

english.title: Fruit of the Doom
english.objectives: Poison 3 Bowls of Fruit.
english.description: Now is the time to strike.$b$bShadowbloom has... potent digestive qualities. Go sprinkle some on Daglir's fruit bowls and watch the show.$b$bMeanwhile, I will use the manatrout liquor to cement my position as the premier fruit vendor in the city.

objectiveDetails.description: Get Rocket Boots from Pazzo Gimbletorque

text.title: Tracking Quest: The Monkey King Obtained

english.title: Tracking Quest: The Monkey King Obtained

text.title: 真假难辨
text.objectives: 取回$1oa盏魔法路灯。
text.description: 现在护盾已经解除，我一直在想着城外的旧定居点。$b$b你知不知道我为何帮忙在城里的奥术路灯上制作金银丝饰品吗？十分简单，是我第一次……$b$b算了，不说这个了。怀旧只会阻挠前进的步伐。制作路灯的材料用在我的新作品上更有价值。$b$b那些可恶的鹰身人应该抢了一些回去装饰它们的鸟巢了。找到的话就带回来。

english.title: All That Glitters
english.objectives: Retrieve $1oa Arcane Glowlamps.
english.description: Now that the shield is down, the older settlements outside the city have been on my mind.$b$bDid you know that I helped create the filigree on the arcane lamps that are used throughout the city? A simple task, one of my first...$b$bNo matter. Nostalgia is the enemy of progress. The lamps are made of material better used in my new works.$b$bThose wretched harpies probably have several decorating their nests. Bring back any you find.

text.title: 曼格拉斯
text.objectives: 打败曼格拉斯。
text.description: 你面前那恶魔般的野兽一定就是吃掉老班布利的罪魁祸首……$b$b你看看它，肚子胀鼓鼓地趟在那里！我一刻也不能忍了，$n！我们必须杀掉那个邪恶的生物，为班布利报仇！$b$b我们已经走到这一步，$c。$b$b你会跟我一起行动吗？！

english.title: Mangelrath
english.objectives: Defeat Mangelrath.
english.description: The demonic beast that stands before ye, must be the one that devoured ol' Brambley...$b$bJust look at it, lying there with a full belly! I canna abide it any longer, $n! We must slay the foul creature and avenge Brambley!$b$bWe've come this far already, $c.$b$bAre ye with me?!

text.title: 强取豪夺
text.objectives: 为勒斯平取得8件鹰身人项链。
text.description: 护盾解除以后，时尚界掀起了新的风潮。$b$b羽毛、骨头以及一些其他的原始材料突然又流行起来。谁能想到他们居然厌倦了我的杰作呢。$b$b到城外去，从南部山崖的鹰身人身上收集项链。把我的印记刻上去，应该能小赚一笔。
text.end: 为勒斯平取得8件鹰身人项链。

english.title: Pry It From Their Cold, Feral Claws
english.objectives: Retrieve 8 Harpy Necklaces for Lespin.
english.description: The shield being lowered presents a unique opportunity for new styles.$b$bFeathers, bone and other primitive materials are suddenly fashionable again. Who would have thought they could grow tired of my masterpieces?$b$bVenture out of the city and collect necklaces from the harpies on the southern cliffs. Etching my mark into them should net me a tidy profit.

text.title: 加入议会
text.objectives: 陪同大德鲁伊巨蹄并和玛法里奥·怒风对话。
text.description: 现在，你的力量无比强大！毫无疑问，你是最出色的德鲁伊，$n。$b$b我感觉到玛法里奥已经抵达，他一定想知道你的事迹。请先随我来。

english.title: Ascending The Circle
english.objectives: Accompany Archdruid Greathoof and then speak with Malfurion Stormrage.
english.description: Now, you are more powerful than ever! Truly, you are a druid without equal, $n.$b$bI sense that Malfurion has arrived. He will certainly want to know of your accomplishments, but first, please walk with me a moment.

text.title: 元素的召唤
text.objectives: 与萨尔谈一谈，并选择你要追求的神器。
text.description: 努波顿是对的。常规手段对燃烧军团没有用——这是破碎海滩之战的教训。我们必须踏遍这个世界，寻找可以对付燃烧军团的武器！$b$b毁灭之锤下落不明，我们必须找到它。雷加尔和埃鲁纳克也有几个别的主意。不管我们定下什么目标，我们都必须迅速行动。$b$b想了解有哪些选择方案的话，你可以问我，不过最终的决定权还是在你手上！

english.title: The Elements Call...
english.objectives: Speak with Thrall and choose the Artifact you wish to pursue.
english.description: Nobundo is right. Conventional tactics will not work against the Legion - the Broken Shore taught us that. We must scour the world for weapons to use against the Legion!$b$bThe Doomhammer is missing and must be recovered. Rehgar and Erunak have some other ideas, as well. Whatever our course, we must act immediately.$b$bSpeak with me to go over your options, but the final decision is yours!

text.title: Lost Mail
text.objectives: Deliver the Lost Mail to Madam Goya in Dalaran Underbelly.
text.description:
TO: MADAM GOYA, DALARAN UNDERBELLY

URGENT!

TIME-SENSITIVE! 

DELIVER IMMEDIATELY!

english.title: Lost Mail
english.objectives: Deliver the Lost Mail to Madam Goya in Dalaran Underbelly.
english.description:
TO: MADAM GOYA, DALARAN UNDERBELLY

URGENT!

TIME-SENSITIVE! 

DELIVER IMMEDIATELY!

text.title: 战斗：熊猫人佳肴——孙行·铁掌

objectiveDetails.description: 烹饪孙行·铁掌最喜欢的菜肴

text.title: 战斗：熊猫人佳肴——托格·慢火

objectiveDetails.description: 做出托格·慢火喜欢的菜肴

text.title: 战斗：熊猫人佳肴——埃林·提亚斯

objectiveDetails.description: 做出埃林·提亚斯喜欢的菜肴

text.title: 把握时机
text.objectives: 骑乘蓝风扁足龟，在蓝风海湾用密封的火药桶消灭50个萨吉塔纳迦。
text.description: $n，你能感受到吗？海水翻滚，萨吉塔正在步步逼近。$B$B你必须立刻出击……$B$B别管我……想办法用那些桶……炮轰纳迦……$B$B保卫……贾德维克……

english.title: Timing Is Everything
english.objectives: Ride an Azuregale Paddlefoot and kill 50 Sashj'tar naga using the Sealed Powder Kegs in Azuregale Bay.
english.description: Can you feel it, $n? The waters churn with approaching Sashj'tar.$B$BYou must strike now...$B$BLeave me... Find a way to bombard the naga... with the kegs...$B$BProtect... Jandvik...

text.title: 干燥火药
text.objectives: 在蓝风海湾的沉船附近收集5个密封的火药桶。
text.description: $n……没想到会在这里遇到你。$B$B萨吉塔正在……集结，准备攻打贾德维克。我有个主意……用这些旧火药桶消灭他们。$B$B这些纳迦比我想象的还要强大。$B$B<弗里克咳出了一口鲜血。>$B$B我们没有多少时间……做准备。

english.title: Dry Powder
english.objectives: Collect 5 Sealed Powder Kegs from the shipwrecks in Azuregale Bay.
english.description: $n... I did not expect to see you down here.$B$BThe Sashj'tar are... rallying against Jandvik. I had a plan to... decimate them using these old powder kegs.$B$BThe naga proved more formidable to these old bones than I thought.$B$B<Fjolrik coughs out some blood.>$B$BWe haven't much time... to prepare.

text.title: Lost Mail
text.objectives: Deliver the Lost Mail to Madam Goya in Dalaran Underbelly.
text.description:
TO: MADAM GOYA, DALARAN UNDERBELLY

URGENT!

TIME-SENSITIVE! 

DELIVER IMMEDIATELY!

english.title: Lost Mail
english.objectives: Deliver the Lost Mail to Madam Goya in Dalaran Underbelly.
english.description:
TO: MADAM GOYA, DALARAN UNDERBELLY

URGENT!

TIME-SENSITIVE! 

DELIVER IMMEDIATELY!

text.title: 猎人的召唤
text.objectives: 调查三把神器的线索。
text.description: 我知道我们素未谋面，不过你很快就可以了解我的组织。现在，我们得谈正事。$b$b燃烧军团再度降临艾泽拉斯，这次的入侵规模史无前例，我们需要新的武器才能对付他们。$b$b我在达拉然会见了三位人士，他们有关于三件上古神器的线索，这些武器对今后的战斗至关重要。只有具备过人技巧的猎人才能获取这些武器。$b$b跟他们谈谈，然后决定先帮助哪一位。

english.title: The Hunter's Call
english.objectives: Investigate leads on three artifact weapons.
english.description: I realize we have never met, but you will learn of my order soon enough. For now, pleasantries must wait.$b$bThe Legion has returned to Azeroth stronger than ever, and we need new weapons to fight them.$b$bI have met three individuals here in Dalaran who have leads on ancient artifacts which could prove vital in the battle to come. Acquiring these weapons demands the skills of a master hunter.$b$bSpeak to each of them and decide whom you will aid first.

text.title: 突袭守望高塔：守夜人营地

objectiveDetails.description: 消灭吉尔尼斯旅的队长
消灭吉尔尼斯旅的狼人

text.title: 必要准备
text.objectives: 装满一杯月亮井之水，并获得传说中的叶须的祝福。
text.description: 加尼尔……被……$B$B<米露恩一边抽泣一边擦了擦眼睛。>$B$B腐化了！梦魇从梦境深处升起。一切发生得太快……$B$B我赶在梦境彻底沦陷之前，设法将法杖秘密带到这里。它暂时没有动静……但恐怕我们没有多少时间。$B$B你必须做好准备，净化梦境给加尼尔造成的腐化。前往林地的北部边界，从神圣的月亮井中取来井水，并获得古树的祝福。$B$B赶快，现在是分秒必争！

english.title: Necessary Preparations
english.objectives: Fill a cup with moonwell water and obtain Leafbeard the Storied's blessing.
english.description: G'Hanir is... is...$B$B<Mylune wipes her eyes, sniffling.>$B$BCorrupted! The Nightmare has risen from the depths of the dream. It all happened so fast...$B$BI was able to secret the staff here through the dream before it fell fully. It rests for now... but I fear we don't have much time.$B$BYou must prepare to retrieve G'Hanir from the Dream. Draw water from the sacred moonwell on the northern edge of the grove and obtain an ancient's blessing.$B$BQuickly - every moment is precious!

text.title: Suramar Noble District Heroic Reward Quest

english.title: Suramar Noble District Heroic Reward Quest

text.title: 深海来敌
text.objectives: 在蓝风海湾消灭6名萨吉塔监工和6名海沟清道夫。
text.description: 潮汐主母……正在用壮硕的纳迦……和海巨人来扩充她的部队。$B$B贾德维克承受不了……他们的合力攻击。$B$B消灭他们……别让他们踏上我们的海岸……

english.title: Sunken Foes
english.objectives: Kill 6 Sashj'tar Overseers and 6 Trenchwalker Scavengers in Azuregale Bay.
english.description: The Tidemistress... is filling her ranks with hulking naga... and sea giants.$B$BJandvik cannot withstand... their combined might.$B$BSlaughter them... before they reach its shores...

text.title: 事与愿违
text.objectives: 在蓝风海湾为6名被控制的维库人移除蠕动的碎心魔。
text.description: 我被纳迦押下来的时候，看到许多维库族人在海床上采矿。有一些鱿鱼……吸附在他们脸上。$B$B不管那是什么，它们肯定在控制我的族人，逼迫他们为纳迦做事。$B$B我虽然不知道你移除鱿鱼之后会发生什么，不过我宁愿我的维库族人死掉，也不想他们被纳迦所奴役。$B$B你完成这件事之后，就到贾德维克来找我。

english.title: Against Their Will
english.objectives: Remove Writhing Willbreakers from 6 Possessed Vrykul in Azuregale Bay.
english.description: When the naga brought me down here, I saw many of my vrykul mining the sea floor. They had... squids... attached to their faces.$B$BWhatever those things are, they must be controlling my kin and forcing them to work for the naga.$B$BI do not know what will happen if you remove the squids, but I would rather my vrykul die than be slaves to the naga.$B$BSee me in Jandvik when the deed is done.

objectiveDetails.description: 关闭不稳定的军团传送门

text.title: 进入沉眠
text.objectives: 进入翡翠梦境，净化加尼尔。
text.description: 你将在这张床上沉眠，从而进入梦境。$B$B觉得舒适的时候，就喝下你带来的月亮井水。接下来我会指引你。$B$B现在，动作要快——每分每秒，加尼尔都在黑暗中陷得越来越深。

english.title: In Deep Slumber
english.objectives: Enter the Emerald Dream and retrieve G'Hanir.
english.description: This bed will be yours for the deep slumber that will usher you into the Dream.$B$BOnce you are comfortable, drink of the moonwater you brought. I will guide you from there.$B$BQuickly, now - with every passing moment G'Hanir slips further into darkness.

objectiveDetails.description: 腐化的加尼尔，母亲之树

text.title: 进入沉睡
text.objectives: 在泰安度兽穴找到纳拉雷克斯。
text.description: 我恐怕无法帮你进入翡翠梦境——我们树妖只能让自己的肉体在现实和梦境位面之间穿梭。$B$B不过没关系，纳拉雷克斯表示他愿意帮忙！$B$B前往泰安度兽穴的最底层。纳拉雷克斯已经在那里展开了准备工作。

english.title: Join the Dreamer
english.objectives: Find Naralex deep within the Tel'Andu Barrow Den.
english.description: I'm afraid I can't really help you actually enter the Emerald Dream - we dryads merely shift our bodies between the planes.$B$BThat's ok, though - Naralex has offered to help!$B$BGo to the very bottom of the Tel'Andu Barrow Den. Naralex is already there setting things up for you.

text.title: 疯狂小猫
text.objectives: 整理营地。
text.description:
你好，陌生人。

<梅鲁娜向你鞠躬。>

不久之前，我们从瓦尔莎拉抵达此处，希望能够在这里定居。我们的旅程并不轻松，我们所有人都疲惫不堪。

如你所见，这些鹰头猫把我们的营地弄得一团糟。可否请你略施援手，帮我们清理一下？

然后，你也许能帮我们建造一口月亮井！

english.title: Feline Frantic
english.objectives: Organize the camp.
english.description:
Greetings, stranger.

<Mayruna bows to you.>

We arrived from Val'Sharah a short time ago with hopes of settling here. Our journey was not easy and we are weary.

These owlcats have made a mess of our camp, as you can surely see. Would you be so kind as to assist us with cleaning up?

Then perhaps you can help us establish a new moonwell!

text.title: 回家的路
text.objectives: 将迷路的羽鬃小猫驱赶过桥，送它回到自己的家中。
text.description:
建造月亮井的第一步，是获得本地野生动物的祝福。

它们的善意让我们能够和平共处，而这种能量可以让月亮井欣欣向荣。再加上艾露恩之光，一口月亮井可以净化周围的环境好多年。

开工之前，我们必须找到愿意给予祝福的生物。我们可以从这些鹰头猫开始入手。

你打扫营地的时候它们跑开了，但我看到有一只在桥前徘徊。

你试试能否找到它生活的地方！

english.title: Homeward Bounding
english.objectives: Chase the Lost Feathermane Kitten across the bridge and return it to its family.
english.description:
The first step to establishing a moonwell is to gain the blessings of the local wildlife. 

It is their good will that enables us to  peacefully coexist, and a moonwell thrives on such energies. Combined with Elune's light, a moonwell can purify its surroundings for years.

To begin, we must find creatures willing to give their blessing. We can start with these owl-cat creatures.

They ran while you cleaned, but I saw one lingering just before the bridge. 

See if you can find where it lives!

objectiveDetails.description: 跟着迷路的鹰头小猫回家
赶着迷路的鹰头小猫过桥

text.title: 大脚的麻烦
text.objectives: 把奇异的双头怪皮交给马德兰尼尔·林心。
text.description:
双头怪的外皮上有许多浅浅的抓痕以及啃咬的痕迹。看来这头怪物一直在迫害本地的鹰头猫。

马德兰尼尔·林心应该会感兴趣。

english.title: Trouble Has Huge Feet
english.objectives: Take the Grotesque Ettin Leather to Mardranel Forestheart.
english.description:
The Ettin's hide bears many shallow scratch marks and bite scars. It seems he had been terrorizing the local Owlcats for quite some time.

Mardranel Forestheart would be interested in this.

text.title: 失散的同伴
text.objectives: 找到凯伦多斯·铁林。
text.description:
我们在撤离瓦尔莎拉的时候，在边界和萨特发生了冲突，一些同伴因此被冲散了。

我们当中还有一个人没有抵达这里——米萨多斯的兄弟，凯伦多斯。如果可以的话，我希望你能帮我找到他。

通往瓦尔莎拉的大桥前面有一片林地，到那里去找找看。

english.title: Missing Along the Way
english.objectives: Locate Kalendros Irongrove.
english.description:
As we retreated from Val'Sharah, our company was briefly separated by a conflict with some satyrs at the border.

One of our own did not make it here- Mythandros' brother, Kalendros. I would like you to try and find him if you could.

Search the woods just before the bridge back into Val'Sharah.

text.title: 绝不屈服
text.objectives: 用萨特的角摧毁3个暗魔图腾。
text.description:
我不能，也不愿接受这里发生的事情。即便我的身体不听使唤，我也要阻止这一切。

<他看着你。>你要阻止这一切。

这是被腐化的世界之树莎拉达希尔的根须。不知怎么搞的，它竟在这从未靠近过的地方破土而出，然后暗魔萨特就开始试图污染苏拉玛。

阻止他们。消灭萨特，用他们的犄角砸毁他们的图腾。

只有这样我们才有希望逆转局势。

english.title: Not Here, Not Now, Not Ever
english.objectives: Use Satyr Horns to destroy 3 Darkfiend Totems.
english.description:
I cannot, will not, accept what is happening here. My body resists me, but I will stop this.

<He looks at you.> You will stop this.

Here is a root of the corrupted World Tree Shaladrassil. It has somehow found its way out of the ground to this untouched place and already the Darkfiend satyrs are hard at work corrupting Suramar.

Stop them. Kill the satyrs, take their horns, drive their points through the totems.

Only then can we have any hope of reversing this.

text.title: 古董珠宝：吹嘘者的胸针
text.objectives: 从纳特西斯·冰刃那里取得勒斯平的胸针。
text.description: 业余商人担心劣质产品会让他们丢脸，而真正的大师则担心劣等客人会让他们颜面无光。$b$b纳特西斯·冰刃做出了诸多僭越自己地位的行为，城里的精英们对他越来越不屑一顾。$b$b我曾把一枚胸针卖给这个人，他用来别在披风上。我一向很小心，只会跟地位在我之上的人做生意。$b$b我的作品从不会失去光泽，但是我的名誉却非常容易受损。$b$b在他降低我的格调之前，把我的作品拿回来。
text.end: 从纳特西斯·冰刃那里取得勒斯平的胸针。

english.title: Estate Jewelry: A Braggart's Brooch
english.objectives: Retrieve Lespin's Brooch from Naltethis Springblade.
english.description: Amateur merchants worry about losing face from bad products. Masters worry about losing face from bad customers.$b$bNaltethis Springblade has grown too bold for his station, and as such has lost much standing in the eyes of the city's elite.$b$bI sold this man a brooch, a clasp he wears on his cape. I am careful to only sell to those above my station.$b$bMy pieces never tarnish, but my name and reputation are much more fragile. Relieve him of my property before he lowers me further.
english.end: Retrieve Lespin's Brooch from Naltethis Springblade.

text.title: 古董珠宝：高级钳饰
text.objectives: 从莫纳斯那里找到并取回勒斯平的“作品”。
text.description: 业余商人总是回味过去的作品，而真正的大师则明白有舍有得的真谛。$b$b很久以前，我……很自负，因为急于求成而接受了一份大胆的生意。$b$b找到他，把……它……带回来。等你看到它，就能理解我所说的一切。$b$b他就住在这座庭院南边的别墅附近。
text.end: 从莫纳斯那里找到并取回勒斯平的“作品”。

english.title: Estate Jewelry: Haute Claw-ture
english.objectives: Find and retrieve Lespin's 'art' from Mornath.
english.description: An amateur merchant looks back on their previous work as a learning experience. A master knows that some things are better left forgotten.$b$bI was... vain, centuries ago. Desperate to prove myself, I took on a bold commission.$b$bFind him and bring... it... back. You will know what I am talking about when you see it.$b$bHe resides near the villa south of this courtyard.
english.end: Find and retrieve Lespin's 'art' from Mornath.

text.title: 唯一的选择
text.objectives: 焚烧莎拉达希尔根须。
text.description:
拿上火把，$n。

只要被梦魇占据，我们就无法逆转腐化。我们能做的只有摧毁被它污染的一切。

焚烧根须。只有这样我们才能在苏拉玛安眠。

english.title: The Only Choice We Can Make
english.objectives: Incinerate the Shaladrassil Root.
english.description:
Take this torch, $n. 

We cannot reverse the Nightmare corruption once it has taken hold. All we can hope to do is destroy its manifestations.

Incinerate the root. Only then can we rest easy in Suramar.

text.title: 利爪领袖
text.objectives: 找到莉娅·石爪。
text.description: 伟大的森林守护者，乌索克在一万年前为这个世界献出了自己的生命。守护者死后，他的双爪被藏了起来，防止恶人用它们的力量来作恶。$b$b莉娅·石爪和她的利爪德鲁伊尊崇乌索克，贡献自己的力量来践行他的道义。如果有人知道利爪的位置，那肯定非莉娅莫属。$b$b她和她的利爪德鲁伊就住在北边的泰安度兽穴里。

english.title: Mistress of the Claw
english.objectives: Find Lea Stonepaw.
english.description: The great forest guardian, Ursoc, gave his life for this world ten thousand years ago. After the guardian's death his claws were hidden away, safe from any who would use their power for evil.$b$bLea Stonepaw and her Druids of the Claw consider Ursoc their paragon and dedicate their lives to following in his example. If anyone would know where the claws reside, it would be Lea.$b$bShe and her Druids of the Claw reside in the Tel'Andu Barrow Den just to the north.

text.title: 回到铁林营地
text.objectives: 在铁林营地寻找米萨多斯。
text.description:
我们已经获得了这片共生之地上的三种生物的祝福。

再加上艾露恩的祝福，月亮井将在未来许多年里守护这片土地。

在休息营地与米萨多斯碰头。我确信他很乐意让你加入仪式。

english.title: Return to Irongrove Retreat
english.objectives: Seek Mythandros at Irongrove Retreat.
english.description:
We have three blessings from the creatures we share this land with.

Combined with a blessing from Elune, the moonwell will watch over this land for years to come.

Meet Mythandros at the retreat. I am sure he would like to include you in the ritual.

text.title: 古老的赤蹄
text.objectives: 找到米萨多斯和古老的赤蹄。
text.description:
你在河对面忙着帮助鹰头猫的时候，米萨多斯和索伦德拉已经深入东边探险。

我相信，米萨多斯找到了又一种能够给予我们祝福的生物。

东北方的河湾处，有一个隐蔽的林地。你可以在那里找到我们的新盟友，一头叫做赤蹄的古老雄鹿。

english.title: Redhoof the Ancient
english.objectives: Locate Mythandros and Redhoof the Ancient.
english.description:
While you were busy assisting the Owlcats across the river, Mythandros and Solendra ventured further to the east.

I believe Mythandros may have found the next creature that may offer us its blessing.

There is a secluded glade along the river's bend to the Northeast. There you may find our new ally, an elderly stag named Redhoof.

text.title: 播种希望
text.objectives: 在肥沃的土壤里播下5颗苍翠草种。
text.description:
和大多数食草动物一样，我们的牡鹿朋友会食用任何绿色的植物。

不过，我注意到它们偏爱这种苍翠的草料，常常会特意去寻找。我相信，如果我们可以让森林里长出更多这种营养丰富的牡鹿食物，就可以赢得他们的亲睐。

我会把种子给你，你只需要找到合适的土壤并播下种子。我们的魔法会完成后面的事情。

english.title: Fertilizing the Future
english.objectives: Plant 5 Lush Grass Seeds in piles of Rich Soil.
english.description:
Like most herbivores, our antlered friends will eat anything green enough to chew. 

However I have noticed that they seek these patches of dark grass, given their preference. I believe we can begin to earn their favor if we aid the forest in producing more of this most nutritious of stag food.

I will provide you with the seeds- all you must do is locate suitable growing soil and plant them. Our magic will do the rest.

text.title: 黑角与黯牙
text.objectives: 击杀8头苏拉玛啸狼以及黯牙。
text.description:
$n，不要误会。身为德鲁伊，我知道何谓自然平衡。

肉食生物必须猎食其他生物以维生，而扰乱这种平衡会带来严重的后果。

所以我才会行走于这片土地，进行各种……计算。

只要消灭少数啸狼和一头头狼，就可以控制狼群数量，让黑角鹿在不破坏生态链的情况下适当繁衍。

english.title: Prongs and Fangs
english.objectives: Slay 8 Suramar Snarlers and Gloomfang.
english.description:
Now, $n, do not mistake me- I am a druid. I understand that nature has a balance.

Predators must feed, and others will be hunted. I also understand that tampering with such balance has consequences.

That is why I have taken upon myself to walk this land and perform some... ah... calculations.

Slay only a small number of the wolves you find, and one alpha. That should reduce their number enough to allow the Sablehorn to thrive without disrupting the flow of things here.

text.title: 最后的祝福
text.objectives: 和索伦德拉·羽绒谈一谈。
text.description:
我的朋友索伦德拉·羽绒前去探索本地夜刃豹的栖息地了。

我们已经拥有羽鬃和黑角的祝福，该是寻求夜刃豹祝福的时候了。她就在这片林地的北边。

english.title: The Final Blessing
english.objectives: Speak to Solendra Featherdown.
english.description:
My friend Solendra Featherdown went to explore the habitat of the native Nightsabers. 

Now that we have the blessings of the Feathermane and the Sablehorn it is time to seek the blessing of the Nightsabers. She is just on the other side of this glade, to the North.

text.title: 天敌
text.objectives: 消灭8只魔鳞蜥蜴。
text.description:
自我们抵达这里以来，我就一直生活中这片土地上。这些蜥蜴从东边的山涧里涌出来，霸占了夜刃豹的家园。

我觉得如果要获得夜刃豹的祝福，就应该把它们的栖息地清理干净，好让它们回家。

消灭那些夺走他人地盘的蜥蜴，$r。

english.title: Natural Adversaries
english.objectives: Slay 8 Manascale Basilisks.
english.description:
I have walked this land in the time since our arrival. Here, basilisks have emerged from the ravines to the east. They encroach upon the home of the Nightsabers.

To earn their blessing, I believe we should clear the way for their return.

Slay the basilisks that have taken more than their fair share of the land, $r.

text.title: 食魔者
text.objectives: 消灭蜥蜴之王，食魔者。
text.description:
这里有一只蜥蜴，它吞下了太多夜刃豹的肉，饱到几乎从不离开自己的洞穴。

我们要好好利用这一点。

找到这只叫做食魔者的蜥蜴，给那些霸占别人地盘的蜥蜴来个杀一儆百。

english.title: Managazer
english.objectives: Slay Managazer, the Basilisk Lord.
english.description:
There is one basilisk here who has gorged himself so thoroughly on Nightsaber flesh that he seldom leaves his cave.

We will use this to our advantage.

Seek out the basilisk Managazer and use his death as an example to the others who have strayed from their home.

text.title: 拯救月语
text.objectives: 用索伦德拉的礼物拯救5头石化的夜刃豹。
text.description:
身为德鲁伊，我知道何谓弱肉强食。肉食生物必须吃肉维生。

但这……

<索伦德拉愤怒地指向附近的一头石化夜刃豹。>

这真是一场悲剧。救救它们，$r。接受我的祝福，让它们从不该承受的苦难中得到解脱。

english.title: Moonwhisper Rescue
english.objectives: Free 5 Petrified Nightsabers using Solendra's Gift.
english.description:
As a druid I understand that predation happens. Creatures that eat meat must acquire meat.

But this...

<Solendra gestures angrily toward a nearby petrified nightsaber.>

This is just sad. Free them, $r. Take my blessing and free them from this needless torment.

text.title: 四色祝福包
text.objectives: 用仪式材料包为惰性之水灌能，然后观察月亮井的变化。
text.description:
你做得非常好，$r。

最后还需要把所有的祝福合在仪式材料包里，然后为月亮井灌能。完成之后，梅鲁娜会加入一些净化的月亮井水。从今往后，只要我们还在此居住，这片土地将永远受到保护。

这是难得一见的时刻，我的朋友。你将亲眼见证这个很少在陌生人面前举行的神圣仪式。

这份光荣的任务就交给你了，只要把仪式材料包放入圣水中就好，我们会完成剩下的事情。

english.title: Eminent Grow-main
english.objectives: Imbue the inert waters with the ritual bundle, then witness the well's creation.
english.description:
You have done very well, $r. 

All that is left is to combine their blessings into the ritual bundle and imbue the Moonwell. Once that is done, Mayruna will add a little water from a purified Moonwell and this land will be protected so long as we inhabit it.

This is a momentous occasion, my friend. You bear witness to a sacred rite not often performed in the company of strangers.

I will let you do the honors- simply place the ritual bundle into the sacred waters and we will do the rest.

text.title: 离水鱿鱼
text.objectives: 在萨吉塔废墟摧毁5个碎心魔孵化器。
text.description: 托尔里跟我说过那些控制族人的鱿鱼生物。$B$B我从没在贾德维克周围见过那样的东西。那些一定是纳迦从他们的巢穴里带来的。$B$B我不想再有任何族人遭受纳迦的控制。$B$B找到那些鱿鱼的老巢并消灭它们。

english.title: Squid Out of Water
english.objectives: Destroy 5 Willbreaker Incubators in the Sashj'tar Ruins.
english.description: Toryl told me about those squid creatures that are controlling my brothers.$B$BI have never seen anything like them before around Jandvik. The naga must have brought them from wherever they came.$B$BI do not want any more of my kin to suffer the fate of being controlled by the naga.$B$BFind out where those squids come from and stop them.

text.title: 艾泽拉斯需要你
text.objectives: 选择你在破碎群岛的首个攻击目标。
text.description: 萨满会听从你的号令，协助对付燃烧军团。你可以从这里指导我们的行动。$b$b到南边去见顾问塞维尔，并找到侦察地图，用它来指挥你的追随者。我们也会在侦察地图上标出破碎群岛一些急需关注的地点。$b$b艾泽拉斯需要你，先知！查看侦察地图，选出我们的首个攻击地点。

english.title: Azeroth Needs You
english.objectives: Select your first assault point on the Broken Isles.
english.description: We shaman under your command will aid your efforts against the Legion. You may direct our actions from here.$b$bSeek out Advisor Sevel just to the south and locate the scouting map from which you can direct your followers. We will also indicate on the scouting map various hot-spots around the Broken Isles that require your attention.$b$bAzeroth needs you, Farseer! Visit the scouting map and choose our first point of attack.

text.title: 去见信使
text.objectives: 与克拉苏斯平台的信使兰斯伯谈一谈。
text.description: 萨斯多拉绝对是一把强大的长弓！这把武器由永歌森林的母亲之树——萨斯阿拉的树枝雕琢而成，并且灌注了太阳之井的魔力。在阿曼尼巨魔入侵时，我曾与它的第一位持有者塔拉纳斯·风行者并肩作战。$b$b啊，这些故事以后再说。$b$b信使兰斯伯正在准备出发。你可以在克拉苏斯平台找到他。

english.title: Rendezvous with the Courier
english.objectives: Speak to Courier Larkspur at Krasus' Landing.
english.description: Thas'dorah is a mighty bow indeed! The weapon was carved from a limb of Thas'alah, the mother tree of Eversong, and infused with the magic of the Sunwell. I fought alongside its first wielder, Talanas Windrunner, during an Amani troll incursion.$b$bAh, but such tales can wait for another time.$b$bCourier Larkspear was making preparations to depart. You can meet him at Krasus' Landing.

text.title: 兽性的探索
text.objectives: 在达拉然的克拉苏斯平台与格瑞夫谈一谈。
text.description: 我很清楚泰坦之击的威力。隐秘通途曾经和维库督军沃伦德作战，粉碎了他征服破碎群岛的计划。我们试图夺走他的步枪，但他却把步枪带进了坟墓。$b$b如果可以打开沃伦德的墓穴，那把神器就能为我们带来极大的优势。$b$b我相信格瑞夫正在为出发做准备。你可以在克拉苏斯平台找到他。

english.title: A Beastly Expedition
english.objectives: Speak to Grif Wildheart at Krasus' Landing in Dalaran.
english.description: I know the power of Titanstrike well. The Unseen Path battled the vrykul warlord Volund as he campaigned to conquer the Broken Isles. We sought to wrest the rifle from him, but he took it to his grave.$b$bIf Volund's tomb can at last be opened, the artifact would be a great boon to our cause.$b$bI believe Grif Wildheart is making preparations to depart. You can meet him at Krasus' Landing.

text.title: 狩猎准备
text.objectives: 在达拉然的克拉苏斯平台与阿帕塔·高岭谈一谈。
text.description: 雄鹰之爪绝对是一把强大的战矛！我第一次注意到它，是在至高岭牛头人带领我们组织的成员登上鹰爪峰，建立神射手营地的时候。$b$b这段故事留着以后再说。$b$b阿帕塔一直在达拉然收集探险所需的补给品。我想她应该准备好要出发了。$b$b去克拉苏斯平台找她。她一定急着启程。

english.title: Preparation for the Hunt
english.objectives: Speak to Apata Highmountain at Krasus' Landing in Dalaran.
english.description: Talonclaw is a mighty spear indeed! I first set eyes upon it when the Highmountain tauren led the members of my order up to Talon Peak to found the Trueshot Lodge.$b$bBut such tales must wait for another time.$b$bApata has been in Dalaran gathering supplies for her expedition. I imagine she's ready to depart by now.$b$bSeek her out at Krasus' Landing. I know she will be eager to begin.

text.title: 失窃的雷霆
text.objectives: 跟随格瑞夫前往盾憩岛，找到泰坦之击。
text.description: 督军沃伦德之墓位于盾憩岛的某处，而泰坦之击就在墓穴里面。那座潮湿的岛屿满是泥泞污地，漂浮在幽暗的海面上。$B$B听起来不错，是吗？$B$B我在跟一个名叫普斯塔佳的维库向导合作，她会帮助我们破除封印墓穴的结界。$B$B我知道你在想什么……维库人是个麻烦。不过她还没跟我玩过什么花样。$B$B休伊会把我们带到海滩去。普斯塔佳说不定已经找到墓穴的位置了！

english.title: Stolen Thunder
english.objectives: Accompany Grif Wildheart to Shield's Rest Island and track down Titanstrike.
english.description: Titanstrike is in the tomb of Warlord Volund somewhere on the isle of Shield's Rest. It's a dank, sloppy mess adrift in a sea of gloom.$B$BSounds lovely, eh?$B$BI've been workin' with a vrykul guide named Prustaga. She'll help us break the wards keepin' the tomb sealed.$B$BI know what you're thinkin'... vrykul are trouble. But she hasn't taken a swing at me just yet.$B$BHuey'll take us down to the shore. Prustaga's probably found the tomb by now!

objectiveDetails.description: 和格瑞夫一起飞往盾憩岛

text.title: 邪魂传送器开始运转！
text.objectives: 向道标里注入远古魔力。
text.description: <传送道标不在运转，但完好无损。用一些远古魔力应该能让它重新运转。>
text.end: 为安娜丝黛夫人取得5张魔刃豹皮。

english.title: Felsoul Teleporter Online!
english.objectives: Infuse the Beacon with Ancient Mana.
english.description: <The telemancy beacon is deactivated, but intact. Some Ancient Mana should get it back up and running.>
english.end: Obtain 5 Mana Saber Hides for Lady Anastae.

text.title: 寻找布里塔格
text.objectives: 在蓝风海湾找到布里塔格。
text.description: <凯尔几乎说不出话来。>$B$B那个纳迦女巫……把我的许多族人……送到了海巨人手里。$B$B布里塔格是……我见到的最后一个活人。$B$B快去找他。

english.title: Finding Brytag
english.objectives: Locate Brytag in Azuregale Bay.
english.description: <Kell barely manages to speak.>$B$BThat naga witch... has given many of my kin... to the sea giants.$B$BBrytag was... the last one I saw alive.$B$BFind him quickly.

text.title: 侦察步道
text.objectives: 找到大步道的斥候。
text.description: 要对抗这些误入歧途的同胞，我们就得尽量了解他们。$b$b我们派出了一位斥候潜入大步道收集情报。哨兵们也派出了他们自己的斥候，但愿她足够聪明，不要还没来得及回报消息就丢了性命。$b$b他们已经去了很久，我们恐怕得做好最坏的打算了。$b$b去找到他们，看看我们究竟遇到了什么困难。

english.title: Taking a Promenade
english.objectives: Locate the scouts in the Promenade.
english.description: We must learn much about our long-lost kin if we are to fight them.$b$bWe dispatched one of our scouts to infiltrate the Promenade and gather intelligence. The Sentinels sent their own scout as well, hopefully she is smart enough to not get herself killed before reporting in.$b$bThey have not returned in some time, and we must suspect the worst.$b$bFind them and we shall see what we are up against.
english.end: Locate the scouts in the Promenade.

text.title: 海卫士
text.objectives: 在蓝风海湾杀死海卫士拉古什。
text.description: 海卫士和潮汐主母做了笔交易。她把我们像畜生一样卖给他。$B$B我鄙视那个海巨人！要不是因为我被困在这个气泡里，我肯定要用自己的双手掐死他。$B$B如果你在我离开这里之前，遇上了那个海巨人，就让他知道自己不该跟纳迦做交易！

english.title: The Seawarden
english.objectives: Kill Seawarden Largush in Azuregale Bay.
english.description: The Seawarden made a deal with the Tidemistress. She handed us over to him like cattle.$B$BI despise that sea giant! If I were not trapped in this bubble, I would choke the life out of him with my own two hands.$B$BIf you cross his path before I get out of here, make him regret ever making a deal with the naga!

text.title: 紫喉遗产
text.description: 保卫悬崖！

english.title: Crawliac's Legacy
english.description: [ph] Defend the bluffs!

text.title: 罗克要瘦身
text.objectives: 在宠物战斗中击败罗克。

english.title: Rocko Needs a Shave
english.objectives: Defeat Rocko in a pet battle.

text.title: 圣光之怒
text.objectives: 在达拉然的紫罗兰城堡与卡雷见面。
text.description:
圣光之怒……大胆的选择。不过如果你有自信可以控制它的力量，它将给我们带来巨大的帮助。

要拿到它并非易事。它落入了肯瑞托手中，不过他们对那种难以驾驭的力量颇有顾虑，所以把它交给了蓝龙军团保管，不想让它再次落入凡人之手。只有蓝龙知道法杖的下落，以及取得它的办法。

蓝龙卡雷是我们最大的希望。他现在是达拉然的六人议会的成员。去那里找他，寻求你要的答案。

english.title: The Light's Wrath
english.objectives: Meet Kalec at the Violet Citadel in Dalaran.
english.description:
Light's Wrath... a bold choice. Though if you believe you can control its energies, it could prove vital to our cause.

Retrieving it won't be easy. It was last held by the Kirin Tor, who, fearing its unbridled power, handed it to the blue dragonflight to secure away from the hands of men. Only they would know exactly where it was taken, or how to retrieve it.

The dragon Kalec may be our best chance. He now resides upon the Council of Six in Dalaran. Seek him, and your answers, there.

text.title: 新的威胁
text.objectives: 在碧蓝巨龙圣地寻找与魔枢现状有关的线索。
text.description:
如果你想前往魔枢，一定要多加小心。考达拉最近怪事频频，你最好在出发之前弄清楚情况。

我上次到龙骨荒野时，曾在碧蓝巨龙圣地感受到异常的能量。在魔枢之战中，玛里苟斯的计划与那个地方密不可分，你或许可以在那里找到跟魔枢现状有关的线索。

我无法随你同行，不过你可以用这块水晶跟我联系。祝你好运。

english.title: A New Threat
english.objectives: Search the Azure Dragonshrine for clues regarding the current state of the Nexus.
english.description:
If you seek the Nexus, I would warn not to rush headlong. There are strange happenings in Coldarra, and it would be best to gather some information before proceeding.

During my last visit to the Dragonblight, I sensed unusual energies from the Azure Dragonshrine. Since this place was very closely tied to Malygos' plans during the Nexus Wars, whatever is present there may explain the current state of the Nexus.

I cannot accompany you, but this crystal can be used to communicate with me. Good luck.

objectiveDetails.description: 使用达拉然的传送门前往龙眠神殿（可选）

text.title: 被遗忘的敌人
text.objectives: 在碧蓝巨龙圣地启动虚灵通讯装置。
text.description:
这部装置仍然散发着能量的嗡鸣。它应该是在不久前被弃置的。

旁边的开关似乎可以启动它。

english.title: A Forgotten Enemy
english.objectives: Activate the Ethereal Communication Device at the Azure Dragonshrine.
english.description:
The device still hums with power. It must have been abandoned not long ago.

The nearby switch appears to activate it.

text.title: 巨龙之眼
text.objectives: 在考达拉的关键地点进行侦察。
text.description:
你最好立刻前往北风苔原的考达拉，$n。到那以后，我建议你对一些关键地点进行侦察，然后向我汇报情况。

我很了解那片地区，应该可以给你行动建议。

快去吧！

english.title: Eyes of the Dragon
english.objectives: Scout out the key locations in Coldarra.
english.description:
You should travel at once to Coldarra in Borean Tundra, $n. There, I would recommend you scout out a few key locations and report back to me. 

I know the area well, and should be able to tell you how to proceed.

Make haste!

text.title: 驾驭圣火
text.objectives: 征服圣光之怒，或者从魔枢地基周围的神圣能量裂隙中吸收能量，从而用不稳定的神圣能量强化自己。
text.description:
圣光之怒的能量从被弱化的魔枢宝库中喷涌而出。我们或许可以利用这股纯粹的混乱能量。

如果我们能把能量灌入湍流之针，应该可以造成……毁灭性的效果。

english.title: Harnessing the Holy Fire
english.objectives: Empower yourself with Unstable Holy Energy by defeating Wraths of the Light or siphoning from Breaches of Holy Energy around the foundation of the Nexus.
english.description:
The energy from Light's Wrath lashes out from within the weakened Nexus Vault.  We may be able to use this raw, chaotic energy to our advantage.

If we can harness this energy and feed it into the Surge Needles, it should cause a rather... destructive reaction.

objectiveDetails.description: 被不稳定的神圣能量所强化

text.title: 审判降临
text.objectives: 使用累积的不稳定的神圣能量摧毁考达拉的湍流之针。
text.description:
你已经具备足以摧毁湍流之针的力量。

在湍流之针破土而出的位置会汇集庞大的虚空能量。将圣光之怒的能量灌入汇集点，这样就可以使其过载从而摧毁上方的湍流之针。

事不宜迟。复仇军可不会坐视你破坏他们的计划。

english.title: Unleashing Judgment
english.objectives: Use your built up Unstable Holy Energy to destroy the Surge Needles in Coldarra.
english.description:
You have the power you need to destroy the Surge Needles. 

At the location of the breaches where the Surge Needles pierce the ground, there will be a large concentration of void energy. Focus the power of Light's Wrath into these points of focused void, and the reaction should cause an overload, destroying the Surge Needle above.

You must act quickly. The Ethereum likely won't sit idly by as you lay waste to their machinations.

text.title: 魔枢宝库
text.objectives: 击败节点亲王拜拉尔并取得圣光之怒。
text.description:
既然复仇军抓住了艾索雷苟斯，那么他们比我想象的还要强大。

虽然我跟艾索雷苟斯说不上和睦，但我们终究血脉相连。既然你想消灭复仇军，取得圣光之怒，我请求你趁此机会把我兄弟从他们手里救出来。

湍流之针被摧毁以后，护盾已经消失。魔枢在等待着你，$n。

english.title: The Nexus Vault
english.objectives: Defeat Nexus-Prince Bilaal and claim Light's Wrath.
english.description:
If the Ethereum managed to capture Azuregos, then they are more powerful than I imagined. 

We have not always seen eye to eye, Azuregos and I, but he is still my kin. Since you seek to put an end to the ethereals and claim Light's Wrath, I would ask that you also free my brother from their grip.

With the Surge Needles destroyed, the shield has dissipated. The Nexus awaits, $n.

text.title: 时间的馈赠
text.objectives: 与阿隆索斯·法奥谈一谈。
text.description:
你今天为蓝龙做出了巨大的贡献，$n，也让我得以安心。

现在你拿到了圣光之怒，我只希望你实现你原本的目标，全力对抗燃烧军团。

就我所知，阿隆索斯·法奥正在等你回去。一路顺风，朋友。

english.title: A Gift of Time
english.objectives: Speak with Alonsus Faol.
english.description:
You have done a great thing for the blue dragons today, $n, as well as for my own peace of mind.

Now, armed with Light's Wrath, I only ask that you fulfill your original goal, and take the fight to the Legion.

I believe Alonsus Faol awaits your return. Safe travels, friend.

Snail Fight!
text.objectives: Defeat Grixis Tinypop in a pet battle.

english.title: Snail Fight!
english.objectives: Defeat Grixis Tinypop in a pet battle.

text.title: 净化母亲之树
text.objectives: 通过梦境之路前往海加尔山，然后用诺达希尔下方的圣水净化加尼尔。
text.description: 我们必须不惜一切代价拯救母亲之树。$B$B我有一个办法。$B$B海加尔山巅的世界之树诺达希尔就是由加尼尔的橡子生长而成。我们可以用它根茎周围的圣水来清除腐化。$B$B如果我们从梦境之路前往海加尔山，应该能有足够的时间赶在加尼尔完全堕落之前完成净化仪式。

english.title: Cleansing the Mother Tree
english.objectives: Use the Dreamway to travel to Mount Hyjal, then cleanse G'Hanir in the sacred waters beneath Nordrassil.
english.description: We must save the Mother Tree at all costs.$B$BI believe I know a way.$B$BThe world tree Nordrassil, atop Mount Hyjal, was born from an acorn of G'Hanir. We can use the sacred waters surrounding its roots to purify the corruption.$B$BIf we take the Dreamway to Mount Hyjal's summit we should have enough time to complete the cleansing ritual before G'Hanir falls completely to the darkness.

text.title: 再次相聚
text.objectives: 在诸灵之环与莱莎·护蕾见面。
text.description: 你在梦境里找到了莱莎，是吗，大导师$n？在你沉眠的时候，我听到你念出了她的名字。$B$B感谢艾露恩，她一切平安。$B$B你必须找到她——我现在也能感受到她，就在上面的诸灵之环里。$B$B如果有人可以帮我们净化加尼尔，那只可能是莱莎了。

english.title: Reconvene
english.objectives: Meet with Lyessa Bloomwatcher at the Circle of Spirits.
english.description: You found Lyessa in the Dream, didn't you, Shan'do $n? I heard you mutter her name in your slumber.$B$BThank Elune she is well.$B$BYou must seek her out - I can sense her presence even now at the Circle of Spirits above.$B$BIf ever there were one who could help us cleanse G'Hanir, it is Lyessa.

text.title: 铭撰于石
text.objectives: 取回凯尔丹纳斯的法术石。
text.description:
<你把笔记卷起放进了背包。

根据最后一篇日志记载，凯尔丹纳斯做实验时用了一个叫“法术石”的东西。

法术石肯定就在附近，说不定奥术师本人也在。>

english.title: Written in Stone
english.objectives: Retrieve the Spellstone of Kel'danath.
english.description:
<You bundle the notes and store them away in your pack.

According to his final journal entry, Kel'danath used something called a "spellstone" in his experiments.

The spellstone, if not the arcanist himself, must be nearby.>

text.title: 16号实验体
text.objectives: 把泰林交给塔莉萨。
text.description: <泰林似乎还在受到奥术师法术的影响。既然凯尔丹纳斯本人已经帮不上忙了，一个活体实验体应该有助于塔莉萨探索他的研究。>

english.title: Subject 16
english.objectives: Deliver Theryn to Thalyssra.
english.description: <It seems Theryn is still under the arcanist's spell. In the absence of Kel'danath himself, a live subject could be useful in helping Thalyssra unravel his research.>

objectiveDetails.description: 治疗受伤的至高岭保卫者

text.title: 虫爪残骸
text.objectives: 在暗影沼泽杀掉15只虫爪鹰身人。
text.description: 好像光有莎拉达希尔那不断蔓延的根茎还不够似的，虫爪鹰身人也来趁火打劫。$b$b消灭他们，$r。他们趁虚而入，死不足惜。
text.completion: Such violence should not be necessary. Thank you, regardless.

english.title: Wormtalon Wreckage
english.objectives: Slay 15 Wormtalon Harpies in Shadowfen.
english.description: As if Shaladrassil's encroaching roots were not enough to deal with, now the Wormtalon harpies have come to take advantage of our plight. $b$bKill them, $r. They deserve nothing less for feeding on our misery.
english.completion: Such violence should not be necessary. Thank you, regardless.

text.title: 月之暗面
text.objectives: 在泰兰德向古代月亮井祈祷时保护她。
text.description: 萨维斯引导伊瑟拉行经此地，但他们的目的地却不清楚。这股扭曲的邪恶压制着我的思绪！$b$b难民说，在他们家园的废墟之中藏着一口古代月亮井。如果它可以抵抗这场腐化……$b$b我会恳求艾露恩为我们指点迷津。在她的光芒之下，我或许有机会找到我的丈夫。
text.completion: He is still alive, but the rest remains to be seen.

english.title: Dark Side of the Moon
english.objectives: Protect Tyrande while she holds her vigil at the Ancient Moonwell.
english.description: Xavius led Ysera past here, but their destination is unclear. This twisted wickedness smothers my mind!$b$bThese refugees tell of an ancient Moonwell hidden in the ruins of their home. If it somehow resisted this corruption...$b$bI will beg of Elune a vision to give me direction. With her light, I may find my husband yet.
english.completion: He is still alive, but the rest remains to be seen.

objectiveDetails.description: 在泰兰德祈祷时保护她
在暗影沼泽与泰兰德见面

text.title: 鱼叉零件
text.objectives: 从蓝风海湾的萨吉塔鱼叉手身上取得50个鱼叉零件。
text.description: 你在对付海巫的过程中表现很好，但是你还可以做得更好。$B$B她的力量远超我所对抗过的任何生物。要打败她的话，我们需要某种强大的，出乎她意料之外的东西……$B$B<托尔里冷笑起来。>$B$B某种他们自己设计的东西……$B$B尽力回收他们的鱼叉发射器零件，然后到贾德维克找我。

english.title: Breaking Down the Big Guns
english.objectives: Collect 50 Harpoon Parts from Sashj'tar Harpooners in Azuregale Bay.
english.description: You did well against that sea witch, but not well enough.$B$BHer power far surpasses any creature that I have ever fought. To defeat her, we will need something formidable. Something that she will not expect...$B$B<Toryl grins wryly.>$B$BSomething of their own design... $B$BSalvage as many parts from their harpoon launchers as you can carry and meet me back in Jandvik.

text.title: 梦魇之心
text.objectives: 穿越梦魇寻找玛法里奥的踪迹。
text.description:
我只知道我的丈夫在这片扭曲森林的深处。他还活着，但不知道他是否安然无恙。

<泰兰德看着你，表情凝重。>

如果玛法里奥有什么闪失，那么就算萨维斯向艾露恩祈求宽恕，我也不会放过他。
text.completion: No one is safe from this corruption.

english.title: Heart of the Nightmare
english.objectives: Track Malfurion's path through the Nightmare.
english.description:
I know only that my husband is somewhere deeper in this twisted forest. He is still alive, but it remains to be seen if he is whole.

<Tyrande's expression hardens into a scowl.>

Elune herself cannot protect Xavius if he is not.
english.completion: No one is safe from this corruption.

text.title: 保卫天禅院
text.objectives: 前往潘达利亚的翡翠林，到天禅院找祝踏岚。与五晨寺西边的泰克泰克交谈以飞往目的地。
text.description: 陈最近报告说，天禅院遭到了攻击！$B$B$n，他们需要你的帮助。到大殿西边去找泰克泰克，他可以让你快速抵达那里。

english.title: The Defense of Tian Monastery
english.objectives: Travel to the Jade Forest on Pandaria, then speak to Taran Zhu at Tian Monastery. Speak to Tak-Tak west of the Temple of Five Dawns to fly there.
english.description: Chen's recent report indicates that Tian Monastery is under attack!$B$B$n, they need your help. Go speak to Tak-Tak west of the main temple. He can get you there quickly.

text.title: 阻止邪能扩散
text.objectives: 摧毁3个邪能散播器。
text.description: 增援！真是雪中送炭！$B$B大宗师，寺院遇袭了。$B$B燃烧军团正在使用一种叫做邪能散播器的装置，放出邪能腐蚀我们脚下的每一寸土地。$B$B摧毁这些装置，遏制他们的恶行。

english.title: Slowing the Spread
english.objectives: Destroy 3 Fel Spreaders.
english.description: Reinforcements. Just what we needed! Grandmaster, the monastery is under attack.$B$BThe Legion is using a foul device known as a Fel Spreader to scorch the very earth we walk on with disgusting fel energy.$B$BDestroy those machines, and we can slow their efforts.

text.title: 殊死抗击
text.objectives: 消灭20个恶魔袭击者。
text.description: 太好了，你来得非常及时，$n。$B$B这些邪恶的军团生物已经侵入了我们的圣殿。我们的世界容不下他们。$B$B消灭你看到的任何恶魔，$G兄弟:姐妹;。

english.title: Desperate Strike
english.objectives: Kill 20 demon attackers.
english.description: Good, your timing couldn't have been better, $n.$B$BThese foul Legion creatures have invaded our sanctuary. They have no place here on our world.$B$BKill every demon you see, $Gbrother:sister;.

text.title: 风火雷电
text.objectives: 摧毁5个邪能尖刺，熄灭5处魔火，并摧毁5个被污染的酒桶。
text.description: 天禅院的情况很糟糕。$B$B播邪小鬼正在灼烧大地。邪能尖刺散发出邪恶的能量，腐化周围的土地。而且邪能魔法也渗入了寺院的酒桶里，污染了我们的美酒。$B$B尽你所能熄灭魔火，摧毁尖刺和被污染的酒桶。$B$B唉……百年佳酿……就这么毁了。$B$B我不想再听到这些事情了。去做事吧。

english.title: Storm, Earth, and Fire
english.objectives: Destroy 5 Fel Spikes, put out 5 Fel Fires, and destroy 5 Tainted Ale barrels.
english.description: Tian Monastery is in bad shape.$B$BFelspreader imps are torching the grounds. Fel spikes radiate foul energy, corrupting the nearby earth. And fel magic has seeped into the monastery's ale barrels, tainting the brew.$B$BUse your abilities to snuff the flames, shatter the spikes, and destroy the tainted barrels.$B$BSigh... hundreds of years of the finest ale... ruined.$B$BI don't wish to hear any more of it. Just get it done.

text.title: 凯丽翠丝之手
text.objectives: 消灭斯高拉·巨剑。
text.description: 恶魔的首领就在前面，掠夺俘虏！$B$B只要我们并肩作战……就能挺过这场可怕的风暴！

english.title: The Hand of Keletress
english.objectives: Kill Skola Greatsword.
english.description: The demons' leader is up ahead, taking prisoners it is said!$B$BThis dire storm, we will weather... if we fight her together!

text.title: 重建教派
text.objectives: 在迷踪岛与金刚不坏彭戍谈一谈。
text.description: 我代表天禅院的全体师徒感谢您，$n大宗师。$B$B想要重建我们的教派，前方还有许多艰巨的挑战，但我们将与你并肩奋斗。$B$B我们回迷踪岛去吧。

english.title: Rebuilding the Order
english.objectives: Speak to Iron-Body Ponshu at the Wandering Isle.
english.description: On behalf of all the students and teachers here at Tian Monastery, thank you, Grandmaster $n.$B$BYou have a difficult task ahead of you to rebuild our order, but we stand with you.$B$BLet us head back to the Wandering Isle.

text.title: 更上一层楼
text.objectives: 在大漩涡的艾泽拉斯之心与新晋萨满金矿谈一谈。
text.description: 想要与元素进行沟通的话，可以采用很多的方式。地精们拥有巧夺天工的技术，可以将元素之灵灌注到他们的机械设备上去。说实话，我并不知道其中的原理。但是在紧要关头，我们应该毫不迟疑地寻求任何可能的帮助。$b$b幸运的是，我们眼下就有一个被他们称作是“金矿”的地精正在为我们服务，他离经叛道的研究或许能够大幅增强我们的实力。他正在附近待命。

english.title: Tech It Up A Notch
english.objectives: Speak to Journeyman Goldmine at the Heart of Azeroth in the Maelstrom.
english.description: There are many ways to commune with the elements. In their ingenuity, the goblins have found ways to imbue their mechanical devices with the energy of elemental spirits. I do not pretend to understand. But in our hour of need, we should not hesitate to embrace a diversity of options.$b$bWe are fortunate to have at our disposal the services of the one they call "Goldmine," whose unorthodox research may significantly augment our power. He waits nearby.

text.title: 部队出勤
text.objectives: 使用侦察地图，完成“部队出勤”任务。
text.description: 该让我们来检验一下你新招募的小型元素的实力了。使用侦察地图，派出你的勇士和部队执行一个日常侦察任务。

english.title: Troops in the Field
english.objectives: Use the Scouting Map and complete the mission, "Troops in the Field."
english.description: It is time for us to test the strength of your newly summoned Lesser Elementals. Look at the Scouting Map and send your champions and troops on a routine scouting mission.

text.title: 腐化的牺牲品
text.objectives: 消灭守护者瓦雷索斯。
text.description: 能为老朋友做最后一点事吗？我的老伙伴，瓦雷索斯堕入了梦魇的魔掌。我们曾经并肩为保护这片土地而奋斗。正是他与这片土地的密切联系，才令他在这黑暗的时刻堕落。$b$b正如所有遭受这悲惨命运的人一样，他已无可拯救。$b$b拜托了，$n，送他回归平静吧。

english.title: Given to Corruption
english.objectives: Slay Keeper Varethos.
english.description: A final favor for an old friend, perhaps? My age-old companion, Varethos, has fallen to the nightmare's torment. We once worked in unison to protect this land. His close ties to the land brought him low in this dark hour.$b$bAs with all who suffer this fate, there is no restoring him.$b$bPlease, $n, bring him peace.

text.title: 意外的盟友
text.objectives: 在阿苏纳与奇拉·艾索尔谈一谈。
text.description:
要引导恶魔传送门的话，我们就需要一位精通燃烧军团知识的专家来帮忙。

我认识这么一个术士，不过我猜她如果听到我的名字，肯定会怒火攻心。最好还是由你去请求她的帮助。

english.title: An Unlikely Ally
english.objectives: Speak to Kira Iresoul in Azsuna.
english.description:
Channeling the demonic gateway will require the assistance of someone with intimate knowledge of the Burning Legion.

I know of such a warlock, though I imagine her blood still boils upon hearing my name. It might be best if you are the one to request her help.

text.title: 凯尔丹纳斯的遗产
text.objectives: 使用凯尔丹纳斯的法术石魅惑5名枯法者，并让他们前往沙尔艾兰。
text.description:
凯尔丹纳斯发现了不得了的东西：制伏甚至控制枯法者的力量。

我会替老朋友完成未尽之事。我们必须确保他没有白白丧命。

说不定，那些遭遇了比死亡更可怕的命运的可怜人，也能经由我们之手得到平静。

我需要更多实验对象。拿着凯尔丹纳斯的法术石，用它制伏更多枯法者。

english.title: Kel'danath's Legacy
english.objectives: Use the Spellstone of Kel'danath to charm 5 withered and send them to Shal'Aran.
english.description:
Kel'danath discovered something incredible - the power to subdue and even control the withered.

I will pick up where my old friend left off. We shall see to it that he did not die in vain. 

Perhaps in the end we can even find peace for the wretches who have been left to a fate worse than death.

I will need more subjects. Take Kel'danath's spellstone and use it to subdue more withered.

text.title: Winter Moose Roundup
text.objectives: Rescue 4 Talbuk at Kuuros Farm.
text.description: My father, Karmaan, owns this farm, and our main livestock are talbuk. One of the podlings must have opened the gate to their pen and they all escaped!$B$BThe little terrors could have slaughtered them in the cage, but they like to hunt their prey. I'm afraid that if I stay out here much longer, I'll be their next meal!$B$BWill you round up the talbuk and bring them here? I can't get them myself, and I can't let my dad find out about this!

english.title: Winter Moose Roundup
english.objectives: Rescue 4 Talbuk at Kuuros Farm.
english.description: My father, Karmaan, owns this farm, and our main livestock are talbuk. One of the podlings must have opened the gate to their pen and they all escaped!$B$BThe little terrors could have slaughtered them in the cage, but they like to hunt their prey. I'm afraid that if I stay out here much longer, I'll be their next meal!$B$BWill you round up the talbuk and bring them here? I can't get them myself, and I can't let my dad find out about this!

text.title: 夏多雷盟友
text.objectives: 在苏拉玛郊区与希尔格林谈一谈。
text.description: 虽然只有我们一部分人敢于公然反抗艾利桑德，但是她把燃烧军团迎进苏拉玛的决策已经使自己树敌无数。$B$B城里有我们的盟友，但是不知道具体有多少人。$B$B我要你去联系一个名叫希尔格林的魔法剑术家。他忠于我们的事业，从我们政变失败以来，他一直潜伏着等待时机。$B$B他通常会在城市最西侧巡逻。直呼他的名字，告诉他我们的事业还未幻灭！

english.title: Sympathizers Among the Shal'dorei
english.objectives: Speak with Silgryn in the Suramar Outskirts.
english.description: Elisande's decision to welcome the Legion into Suramar earned her plenty of enemies, though only some of us were bold enough to openly defy her.$B$BWe have allies in the city - we just don't know how many.$B$BI need you to make contact with a spell-fencer by the name of Silgryn. He is loyal to our cause, and has been lying in wait since our failed coup.$B$BHe patrols the western edge of the city. Address him by name and tell him our cause is not lost!

text.title: 触手可及
text.objectives: 在沙拉尼尔寻找玛法里奥。
text.description: 他就在附近，$r，我可以感觉到。$b$b我们必须搜索沙拉尼尔，寻找玛法里奥。如果我们不尽快找到他，恐怕一切就来不及了。$b$b初次见面的时候，我对你能力并不确定。我现在相信，你绝不会让我失望。$b$b我……非常感激。

english.title: Close Enough to Touch
english.objectives: Search for Malfurion within Shala'nir.
english.description: He is near, $r, I can feel it.$b$bWe must search Shala'nir for Malfurion. If we do not find him soon, I fear he will be lost to me forever.$b$bI was unsure of your worth when first we met. I know now that you will not fail me.$b$bI am... grateful.

objectiveDetails.description: 在村庄里寻找玛法里奥
跟随泰兰德进入沙拉尼尔

text.title: Wildlife Protection Force
text.objectives: Defeat Rocko in a pet battle.

english.title: Wildlife Protection Force
english.objectives: Defeat Rocko in a pet battle.

text.title: 冒险救援
text.objectives: 进入恶魔世界并营救失踪的议会成员。
text.description:
计划很简单，不过你负责的部分非常困难。

我和奇拉会召唤恶魔传送门，你必须只身进入传送门，并找回失踪的议会成员。

english.title: A Daring Rescue
english.objectives: Enter the demon world and rescue the missing council members.
english.description:
The plan is a simple one, but it will require great effort on your part.

Kira and I will summon the demonic gateway, but you will have to enter alone and recover the missing council members.

text.title: 灵魂信标
text.objectives: 举行召唤仪式，营救失踪的议会成员。
text.description:
我已将辛菲儿的灵魂与她的法杖相连，这样法杖就成了这个世界的锚点。

我们举行召唤仪式时，法杖会成为一个信标，指引辛菲儿穿越扭曲虚空，回到我们的世界。

english.title: Soul Beacon
english.objectives: Perform a ritual of summoning to retrieve the missing council member.
english.description:
I have bound Shinfel's soul to her staff, allowing it to serve as an anchor in this world.

When we perform the ritual of summoning, it will act as a beacon, guiding Shinfel through the Twisting Nether and back to our world.

text.title: 炼金师“疯子”欧尼
text.objectives: 在瓦尔莎拉找到炼金师“疯子”欧尼。
text.description:
在想办法治愈诅咒之前，我们得先弄清楚这到底是什么诅咒。

我认识一个叫“疯子”欧尼的炼金师，他因为经常使用争议手段而出名。他很久以前就被吉尔尼斯驱逐，如今恐怕就住在破碎群岛上。

希望他的知识能为我们打破这个诅咒迈出第一步。

english.title: Mad Ernie the Alchemist
english.objectives: Find Mad Ernie the Alchemist in Val'sharah.
english.description:
If we have any hope of curing this curse, we need to know what kind of magic we're dealing with.

I know of an alchemist who earned himself quite the reputation for his unconventional methods. Shunned from Gilneas long ago, I believe Mad Ernie has taken up residence in these lands.

His knowledge may be the first step to breaking this curse.

objectiveDetails.description: 在瓦尔莎拉找到“疯子”欧尼

text.title: 天空国度
text.objectives: 在旋云之巅和赛莱托斯谈一谈。
text.description: 风领主奥拉基尔死后，空气元素一直群龙无首。$b$b天空之墙从此陷入了混乱之中。奥拉基尔的王位原本应该由桑德兰继承，不过王子残留在雷霆之怒里的精华正在不断流失。如果我们不抓紧时间，桑德兰也许就会永远消失。$b$b将损坏的雷霆之怒带到旋云之巅，并与赛莱托斯谈谈。$b$b赛莱托斯是奥拉基尔忠实的仆从，他一定和我们一样盼望桑德兰重生。

english.title: The Skies Above
english.objectives: Speak with Celestos in The Vortex Pinnacle.
english.description: There has been no Windlord to lead the air elementals since the death of Al'Akir.$b$bThe realm of Skywall has been thrown into turmoil. The throne of Al'Akir is Thunderaan's by right, but what remains of the prince's essence within Thunderfury is diminishing. If we do not move quickly, Thunderaan may be lost forever.$b$bTake the damaged Thunderfury to Vortex Pinnacle and speak with Celestos.$b$bCelestos was a loyal servant of Al'Akir and he will share our desire to see Thunderaan reborn.

text.title: 充能之剑
text.objectives: 获得天墙之心。
text.description: 你取回了逐风者的祝福之剑，以及桑德兰王子残留在剑中的灵魂。$b$b雷霆之怒可以修复，但需要名为天墙之心的稀有精华。$b$b此物在东风公爵沃托斯手上，不过他肯定不愿乖乖交给你。$b$b必须击败沃托斯，并将天墙之心与剑合为一体。$b$b只有那样，桑德兰才能重生，并坐上风神王座。

english.title: Recharging the Blade
english.objectives: Obtain the Heart of Skywall.
english.description: You have recovered the Blessed Blade of the Windseeker, and with it you hold all that is left of the soul of Prince Thunderaan.$b$bThunderfury can be restored, but it will require a rare essence known as the Heart of Skywall.$b$bVortos, the Duke of the East Winds, possesses the heart... but he will not give it willingly.$b$bVortos must be defeated, and the Heart of Skywall must be combined with the blade.$b$bOnly then can Thunderaan return and claim the Throne of Four Winds.

text.title: 烈焰升腾者
text.objectives: 在火焰之地与雷加尔·大地之怒谈一谈。
text.description: 为了争夺控制权，火焰之地爆发了一场永无休止的战争。在两位有望获胜的炎魔领主中，斯莫德隆比较没有那么仇视凡人。$b$b如果我们助他打败对手并登上火元素领主之位，他或许会与我们结盟。$b$b大地之环的勇士已经前往火焰之地。到那里与雷加尔·大地之怒会合，设法化敌为友。$b$b先知，我相信只有你可以胜任这个艰巨的任务。$b$b愿元素与你同在。

english.title: Ascendant of Flames
english.objectives: Speak with Rehgar Earthfury in the Firelands.
english.description: As we speak, an endless war rages for control of the Firelands. Of the two aspiring Firelords, Lord Smolderon hates mortals less.$b$bIf we help him defeat his rival and ascend to Firelord, he may unite with us in return.$b$bThe champions of the Earthen Ring have already made their way to the Firelands. Go and meet with Rehgar Earthfury and find a way to turn an old enemy into a new ally.$b$bIf anyone can succeed at this impossible task, I have faith that it is you, Farseer.$b$bMay the elements be with you.

text.title: 炎魔之命
text.objectives: 击败派罗斯的部队。
text.description: 你好，凡人。我是领主斯莫德隆的使者，斯卡迪乌斯。$b$b我刚刚见过你们组织的其他人。他们说你会消灭反抗我主人的那些人。领主斯莫德隆对此非常开心。$b$b派罗斯和他的爪牙反对我主人的统治，必须让他们付出代价。消灭派罗斯和他的勇士！$b$b没有什么比死在凡人手中更耻辱了。完成之后你就可以觐见领主斯莫德隆。

english.title: The Firelord's Command
english.objectives: Defeat the forces of Pyroth.
english.description: Greetings, mortal. I am Scaldius, emissary of Lord Smolderon.$b$bI have just met with others from your order. They tell me that you will bring an end to those who oppose my master. This pleases Lord Smolderon.$b$bPyroth and his minions defy my master's rule and so an example must be made of them. You will slay Pyroth and his champions!$b$bNothing is more humiliating than death at the hands of a mortal. Do this and Lord Smolderon will grant you audience.

text.title: The Rival Lords of Fire
text.objectives: Return to Lord Smolderon with Garixxia's Smoldering Heart and the Core of Molten Rage.
text.description: You stand before the true Lord of the Firelands, mortal. This land is mine by right, claimed from the ashes of Ragnaros himself.$b$bHowever, there are still some who foolishly oppose my reign. I would take great pleasure in destroying their worthless souls, but I will not honor them with death by my hands.$b$bThey must be humiliated for their insolence, and there is nothing more humiliating than being slain by a mere mortal.$b$bAmuse me shaman. Prove your worth and destroy my rivals!

english.title: The Rival Lords of Fire
english.objectives: Return to Lord Smolderon with Garixxia's Smoldering Heart and the Core of Molten Rage.
english.description: You stand before the true Lord of the Firelands, mortal.
