This land is mine by right, claimed from the ashes of Ragnaros himself.$b$bHowever, there are still some who foolishly oppose my reign. I would take great pleasure in destroying their worthless souls, but I will not honor them with death by my hands.$b$bThey must be humiliated for their insolence, and there is nothing more humiliating than being slain by a mere mortal.$b$bAmuse me shaman. Prove your worth and destroy my rivals!

text.title: 伟大的石母
text.objectives: 与深岩之洲的塞拉赞恩交谈。
text.description: 要联合艾泽拉斯的四大元素领主，你必须找到塞拉赞恩并说服她加入保卫艾泽拉斯的事业中来。$b$b不过，石母正忙于对付在深岩之洲死灰复燃的暮光之锤。$b$b如果我们帮塞拉赞恩一把，她或许会同意与大地之环一起对抗燃烧军团。$b$b前往深岩之洲中心的塞拉赞恩王座，协助她打败暮光之锤并说服她一起保卫艾泽拉斯！

english.title: The Great Stonemother
english.objectives: Speak with Therazane in Deepholm.
english.description: In order to unite the four Elemental Lords of Azeroth, you will need to seek out Therazane and convince her to join the cause of Azeroth.$b$bHowever, the Stonemother currently has her hands full battling a Twilight's Hammer resurgence in Deepholm.$b$bIf we lend Therazane our aid she may agree to unite with the Earthen Ring against the Burning Legion.$b$bJourney to Therazane's Throne in the heart of Deepholm. Aid her in defeating the Twilight's Hammer and convince her to join the defense of Azeroth!

text.title: 领主归来
text.objectives: 召唤桑德兰王子。
text.description: 雷霆之怒已经充能完毕，桑德兰王子现在可以回到物质世界了。$b$b片刻之后，我会将主人的灵魂从祝福之剑里释放出来。$b$b仪式完成后，天空之墙就将迎来新一任的风元素领主。

english.title: Return of the Windlord
english.objectives: Summon Prince Thunderaan.
english.description: With Thunderfury recharged, Prince Thunderaan can now return to the physical realm.$b$bIn a moment, I will release my master's spirit from the blessed blade.$b$bWhen the ritual is complete, Skywall will once again have its Windlord.

text.title: 铲除邪教
text.objectives: 在暮光王座消灭15个暮光之锤异教徒。
text.description: 我们是阻止暮光之锤征服深岩之洲的仅存力量。$b$b艾泽拉斯无法同时对抗羽翼丰满的暮光之锤以及燃烧军团。我们必须赶在邪教完成重生之前将其击溃。$b$b跟我一起进入他们的要塞，肃清邪教党羽！

english.title: Destroying the Cult
english.objectives: Slay 15 Twilight's Hammer cultists at The Twilight Throne.
english.description: We are all that stands between the Twilight's Hammer and their conquest of Deepholm.$b$bAzeroth cannot hope to fight the full strength of the Twilight's Hammer and the Burning Legion at the same time. It is up to us to put an end to their cult before they are able to fully rebuild.$b$bAccompany me into their stronghold and we shall cut through their ranks together!

text.title: 启动熔炉
text.objectives: 用抑魔金熔炉销毁大法师卡莱的灌魔丝纹长袍。
text.description: 你了解抑魔金熔炉吗？它可以销毁制造的装备，产出珍贵的抑魔金。我个人很希望能看看它是怎么运转的。$b$b我有个崇拜者最近送给我一套探险服，不过它们的款式不适合我。$b$b把它们放到熔炉里去看看会发生什么。

english.title: Firing Up the Forge
english.objectives: Use the Obliterum Forge to obliterate Archmage Karlain's Imbued Silkweave Robes.
english.description: Are you familiar with the Obliterum Forge? It can be used to destroy crafted gear, yielding valuable Obliterum. I'm personally quite curious to see it in action.$b$bOne of my many admirers recently gifted me a set of adventuring robes, but I'm afraid they're not quite my style.$b$bPlace them inside the forge and see what happens.

text.title: 厄运降临
text.objectives: 找到欧内斯特制作延命药剂所需的材料。
text.description:
厄运诅咒相当棘手，以至于让许多术士一直都敬而远之。

这种魔法会随着时间的推移而增强，最终导致死亡。只有下咒者本人才能清除它。

我可以配置一副药剂来缓解诅咒的效果，不过你需要先收集各种材料。

english.title: Doom and Gloom
english.objectives: Recover the ingredients Ernest needs to create an Elixir of Suspension.
english.description:
Doom curses are serious business, so much so that many warlocks didn't deal in them for some time. 

The magic grows stronger as time goes on, eventually leading to death. Only the caster of the curse can remove it.

I can craft an elixir that will slow its progression, but you'll need to collect an assortment of ingredients first.

text.title: 牧羊
text.objectives: 抓捕灰角山羊，并把它们带回围栏。
text.description:
如果你还没有注意到的话，我可以告诉你这里遇到了一点麻烦。

玛尔把玉米地保护得很好，不过那场暴动把我的山羊吓得不轻。战斗一开始，它们就冲出了围栏，而现在又像发狂似的到处乱窜！

帮我把它们围起来，我一定会尽力帮你找出处理诅咒的办法。

english.title: Herding Goats
english.objectives: Catch Greyhorn Goats, then return them to their pen.
english.description:
In case you haven't noticed, things are a bit hectic around here.

Marl's doing a good job protecting the corn fields, but the commotion gave our goats quite the scare. They dashed out of their pen as soon as the fighting started, and are now running amuck!

Round them up for me and I'll do my best to figure out how to handle the curse you're dealing with.

text.title: 前往丘陵
text.objectives: 装满一瓶月亮井水，然后在灰熊丘陵找到莉娅·石爪。
text.description: 据说乌索克的一部分灵魂，他的愤怒和狂暴，在他死后留在了利爪之中。只有精于德鲁伊之道的人才可以挥舞它们，而不会被巨熊领主的暴怒所吞噬。$b$b<莉娅定睛看了你一会。>$b$b你经验丰富，我看得很清楚。$b$b很好，到林地最北边的月亮井里取些井水，然后回来找我。我会在诺森德的沃达希尔残桩处等你。

english.title: To The Hills
english.objectives: Fill a Vial of Moonwell Water and locate Lea Stonepaw within Grizzly Hills.
english.description: It is said that a fragment of Ursoc's spirit, his fury and rage, remained within the claws after his death. Only those who have attained mastery of discipline have any hope of wielding them without being overwhelmed by the bear lord's fury.$b$b<Lea looks intently at you for a moment.>$b$bBut you are no novice, I can see that clearly.$b$bVery well, draw water from the moonwell on the northern edge of the grove then come find me. I'll await your arrival within the broken stump of Vordrassil in Northrend.

objectiveDetails.description: （可选）：穿越梦境之路前往灰熊丘陵

text.title: 半神祭品
text.objectives: 在霜爪萨满祭司的遗体上搜索乌索尔的祭品，然后交给灰喉洞穴里的莉娅·石爪。
text.description: 利爪被封印之时也设立了魔法结界，以此阻止任何人接近它们。只有半神的力量才能让我们通过结界，而乌索克的兄弟乌索尔就可以办到。$b$b乌索尔是一位隐居的守护者，我们需要献上祭品才能让他现身。$b$b和乌索克一样，乌索尔曾经受到熊怪的崇拜，不过多年的战争已经摧毁了熊怪部落，而它们的祭司也早已归于黄土。$b$b在我准备祭坛的时候，你需要搜索它们的遗体，看看有没有什么祭品。

english.title: Fallen Offerings
english.objectives: Search the bodies of Frostpaw Shaman for Offerings to Ursol and return them to Lea Stonepaw within Grizzlemaw
english.description: When the claws were sealed away, magical wards were placed to prevent anyone from reaching their location. Only the power of a demigod can give us passage through the wards, one such as Ursol, the brother of Ursoc.$b$bUrsol is a reclusive guardian and requires an offering before he will appear to us.$b$blike Ursoc, he was worshipped by the furbolg, but years of war have decimated their tribes and their shaman lay dead.$b$bSearch the bodies of the fallen for their offerings while I prepare the shrine.

text.title: 争取时间
text.objectives: 把延命药剂交给辛菲儿·疫誓。
text.description:
别被气味给骗了，这种调合剂基本上是可以安全食用的。

被感染的人应该整瓶喝掉，一滴都不要剩！运气好的话，药剂会立刻见效。否则，唉……告诉他们风险自负，好吗？

记住，这只能起到缓解作用，并不能完全移除诅咒。

english.title: Borrowed Time
english.objectives: Give the Elixir of Suspension to Shinfel Blightsworn.
english.description:
Don't let the aroma deceive you, this concoction is mostly safe for consumption.

Whoever is afflicted should drink the entire contents of the vial, every last drop! If the elixir works, the effects should be immediate. If not, well... just tell them they drink at their own risk, alright?

Keep in mind, this will only weaken the curse, not cure it.

objectiveDetails.description: 把延命药剂交给辛菲儿

text.title: 寻找菲兹班
text.objectives: 在风暴峡湾找到露露贝拉·菲兹班。
text.description:
我有理由相信，威尔弗雷德·菲兹班的姐姐已经抵达风暴峡湾。

如果她拥有威尔弗雷德一半的力量和至少两倍的智慧，我们或许可以成功召唤艾瑞达双子。

english.title: Finding Fizzlebang
english.objectives: Find Lulubelle Fizzlebang in Stormheim.
english.description:
I have reason to believe that Wilfred Fizzlebang's sister has made her way to Stormheim.

If she has half his power, but at least twice his intelligence, then we just might succeed in summoning the eredar twins.

text.title: 7.0 Suramar - Vignette: Sea Giant King - twh

english.title: 7.0 Suramar - Vignette: Sea Giant King - twh

text.title: 别人的麻烦
text.objectives: 有人不负责任地在风暴峡湾召唤出一帮恶魔。去放逐他们。
text.description:
光有这份认罪书还不够，只要这些恶魔还在四处作乱，我总是要背锅。

必须有人把那个术士造成的混乱处理干净！但我不能自己去做，要是有人目击到我在犯罪现场就更说不清了。

不过你可以帮我放逐掉他们，这样问题就解决了。对新近召唤出的恶魔使用这个宝珠，就可以把他们送回他们来的地方——一劳永逸！

english.title: Someone Else's Mess
english.objectives: Banish demons that have been irresponsibly summoned in Stormheim.
english.description:
A confession alone won't be enough to clear my name. As long as those demons run amuck, people will blame their presence on me. 

Someone needs to clean up the mess that warlock made. I'd do it myself, but I can't be placed at the scene of the crime.

You could banish them though. That would do the trick. Use this orb on newly summoned demons to send them right back where they came from - permanently!

text.title: 强迫认罪
text.objectives: 找出不负责任地召唤出恶魔的术士，并让他为自己的恶行写一份认罪书。
text.description:
在我证明自己的清白之前，我的位置必须保密。

拜家族的名声所赐，只要有哪个倒霉的术士召唤出他们控制不了的恶魔时，人们都会怪我。

我上一次的“犯罪地点”就在附近一个洞穴里，那里游荡着一帮麻烦的小鬼和肮脏的恶魔。

找到真正应该负责的卑鄙术士，让他写一份认罪书。

english.title: Coercing a Confession
english.objectives: Find the warlock that has been irresponsibly summoning demons and obtain a written confession of his wrongdoings.
english.description:
My location has to be kept secret, at least until I have proof of my innocence.

Thanks to the legacy of my family name, any time some miserable warlock summons demons they can't control, I get the blame.

The scene of my latest "crime" is a nearby cave, where unruly imps and other nasty demons are roaming free.

Find the lousy warlock who's responsible, and get him to write a confession.

objectiveDetails.description: 消灭受诅咒的野生动物

text.title: 乌索尔的第一个试炼
text.objectives: 完成乌索尔的第一个试炼。
text.description: 燃烧军团……$b$b<乌索尔的双眼放出了强烈的光芒>$b$b是的……我很清楚地记得，很久以前，我兄弟牺牲的那一天。无数的恶魔倒在他的利爪之下，但是源源不断的敌人让他逐渐体力不支，最后壮烈牺牲。我的兄弟是熊的精神的真正化身！$b$b你必须证明你的心中里也有这样的精神。

english.title: The First Trial of Ursol
english.objectives: Complete the first of Ursol's trials.
english.description: The Legion...$b$b<the glow of Ursol's eyes begin to shine intensely>$b$bYes... I remember clearly that day long ago when my brother fell. Countless demons fell beneath his claws until, through the overwhelming numbers of the enemy, he was overtaken. My brother was the true spirit of the bear!$b$bYou must prove to me that the spirit of the bear resides within you as well.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成乌索尔的第一个试炼

text.title: 乌索尔的第二个试炼
text.objectives: 完成乌索尔的第二个试炼。
text.description: 即便身处绝境，乌索克在也绝不会在战斗中退缩。如果你想取得他的利爪，你就必须向我证明你也拥有同样的勇气。$b$b在下一个试炼中，你将面对我追随者的无情屠戮。打败所有的灵魂，证明你拥有巨熊的勇气！

english.title: The Second Trial of Ursol
english.objectives: Complete the second of Ursol's trials.
english.description: Ursoc never backed down from a battle, even when faced with overwhelming odds. If you would take up his claws you will show me that you possess the same courage.$b$bYour next trial will place you against an onslaught of my followers. Defeat all of the spirits and prove that you possess the courage of the bear!

objectiveDetails.description: 完成乌索尔的第二个试炼

text.title: 乌索尔的第三个试炼
text.objectives: 完成乌索尔的第三个试炼。
text.description: 你已经向我证明了你的力量和勇气，不过你是否拥有在关键时刻全身心投入的能力？$b$b最后的试炼将揭晓一切。

english.title: The Third Trial of Ursol
english.objectives: Complete the third of Ursol's trials.
english.description: You've proven to me your strength and your courage, but do you possess the ability to apply yourself when it matters most?$b$bThis final trial will reveal all.

objectiveDetails.description: 与乌索尔交谈以开始第三个试炼

text.title: 露露贝拉的援手
text.objectives: 与雷特森·焰怒谈一谈。
text.description:
你的计划风险可是很高的，你知道吗？召唤双子之一已经是非常困难的了，你还想一次召唤两个？真会找麻烦。

不过你走运了，我接受这个挑战。我会帮你跟其他的议会成员一起召唤那两个恶魔，这没准还有助于恢复菲兹班家族的名声。

english.title: Lulubelle on Loan
english.objectives: Speak to Ritssyn Flamescowl.
english.description:
What you plan to do is pretty risky, you know? Summoning one sister would be difficult enough, but both of them at once? That's just asking for trouble.

Luckily, I'm up for the challenge. I'll help you and the rest of the council summon those demons, and hopefully restore pride to the Fizzlebang name.

text.title: 召唤双子
text.objectives: 通过恶魔传送门前往召唤平台，完成召唤以后用血石控制艾瑞达双子。
text.description: 最好能在恐痕裂隙外边进行召唤仪式。一旦情况有变，至少可以把问题控制在基地上方漂浮的这块小岛里。$B$B一旦召唤出恶魔双子，就用血石控制他们。$B$B我会叫其他人准备开始。

english.title: Summoning the Sisters
english.objectives: Travel through the Demonic Gateway to reach the summoning platform and use the Bloodstone to subdue the eredar sisters once the summoning is complete.
english.description: It would be best to conduct the summoning on the outskirts of Dreadscar Rift. If things do not go as planned, at least the aftermath will be contained to a small island of land that floats above our order.$B$BOnce the sisters have been summoned, use the Bloodstone to enslave them.$B$BI'll let the others know it's time to begin.

text.title: 选定第六人
text.objectives: 选定最后一名议会成员。
text.description:
恶魔双子已经落到你手里，你不但削弱了孟菲斯托斯的军队，还为议会争取到了强大的盟友。

然而，我们的工作还没有结束。只要燃烧军团还在，恐痕裂隙就会不断遭到袭击。

如果要保护我们的新家，就必须重组议会。露露贝拉和奇拉表现出众，足以成为我们当中的一员，不过现在只有一席之缺。

你是黑暗收割者的首席，你来选一个吧。

english.title: Selecting a Sixth
english.objectives: Choose who will become the final member of the council.
english.description:
With the demon sisters under your control, you have managed to weaken Mephistroth's army and gain powerful allies for the council.

Our work is not done, however. Dreadscar Rift will remain a target as long as the Burning Legion remains.

If we wish to protect our new home, we must rebuild the council. Both Lulubelle and Kira have proven themselves worthy to join our ranks, though only one spot remains.

As First of the Black Harvest, the choice is yours.

text.title: 壮大部队
text.objectives: 与鬼母德雅拉谈一谈，并训练结群小鬼。
text.description:
人如其名，鬼母德雅拉擅长召唤小鬼。

议会已经控制了恐痕裂隙，在我们需要的时候，她可以助我们一臂之力。

如果你想训练结群小鬼的话，就去找她。

english.title: Recruiting The Troops
english.objectives: Speak to Imp Mother Dyala and train a Pack of Imps.
english.description:
As her name suggests, Imp Mother Dyala is adept at summoning imps.

While the council controls Dreadscar Rift, her services will be ours to use as we see fit.

Speak to her if you wish to train a pack of imps.

text.title: 不断壮大
text.objectives: 与征募官贾瑞德谈一谈。
text.description: 身为议会的首座，有许多助祭希望尽其所能地协助你。征募官贾瑞德负责甄别候选人，选出可以为我们所用的人才。$B$B现在，去跟他谈一谈。

english.title: Recruiting More Troops
english.objectives: Speak to Recruiter Jared.
english.description: As First of the council, you have acolytes devoted to helping any way they can. Recruiter Jared is in charge of screening candidates, only selecting those that possess the skills we desire.$B$BSpeak to him now.

text.title: The Gates of Valor
text.objectives: Obtain $1oa Chipped Titan Disc Fragments by surveying near the Gates of Valor in Stormheim.
text.description: Ye'd not normally know it, but the terraced entrance to the vrykul's Halls o' Valor is a fine place for findin' ancient artifacts. Problem is, the place is just a big mess with demons at the time.$b$bWell, ye've not got much choice. If the disc isn't elsewhere in Stormheim, it most likely lies at the Gates of Valor. Good luck, $n.

english.title: The Gates of Valor
english.objectives: Obtain $1oa Chipped Titan Disc Fragments by surveying near the Gates of Valor in Stormheim.
english.description: Ye'd not normally know it, but the terraced entrance to the vrykul's Halls o' Valor is a fine place for findin' ancient artifacts. Problem is, the place is just a big mess with demons at the time.$b$bWell, ye've not got much choice. If the disc isn't elsewhere in Stormheim, it most likely lies at the Gates of Valor. Good luck, $n.

text.title: 请求帮助
text.objectives: 找卡德加索要一个军团联络器的能量源。
text.description: 凯丽娅·邪魂是一个才华横溢的学生……不过后来投靠了燃烧军团。$B$B她也因此得到了奥达奇战刃，那原本是奥达奇最伟大勇士的武器，强大到可以撕裂灵魂。据说那位勇士最终被萨格拉斯亲手消灭。$B$B我们派了一支小队去找凯丽娅，不过他们后来音讯全无。杰斯有一部军团联络器，他认为我们可以用它来联络搜查队，现在我们还需要一个能量源。$B$B或许你可以问问卡德加有没有我们可以用到的东西？我们的盟友真的很少。

english.title: Asking a Favor
english.objectives: Ask Khadgar for a source to power the Legion communicator.
english.description: Caria Felsoul was a bright student... and a Legion traitor.$B$BIn her treason she was bestowed the Aldrachi Warblades, the soul-rending blades of the Aldrachi's greatest champion - they say he only finally fell to Sargeras himself.$B$BWe sent a small force to find Caria, but we have not heard word since. Jace has a Legion communicator he believes we can use to reach them- we just need a power source.$B$BPerhaps you could see if Khadgar has anything we could use? I'm afraid our allies are few.

text.title: 有求必应
text.objectives: 从大法师卡德加那里取得一个灵魂结晶。
text.description: 军团联络器？嗯……$B$B<卡德加静静思考了一会。>$B$B不瞒你说，我觉得我楼上的保险箱里正好有你需要的东西。

english.title: Ask and You Shall Receive
english.objectives: Obtain the Crystallized Soul from Archmage Khadgar.
english.description: A Legion communicator? Hmmmm.$B$B<Khadgar pauses to think for a moment.>$B$BYou know what, I think I have something in my lockbox upstairs that is just the ticket.

text.title: 回去找杰斯
text.objectives: 回去找杰斯·织暗。
text.description: 灵魂结晶的能量应该可以支持足够的时间，让你们联络到盟友。$B$B我必须提醒你要格外当心，$n。如果那部装置是燃烧军团制造的，那么你永远不会知道哪些人会窃听你们的讯息。$B$B我敢说，你的盟友一定很期待你回去。

english.title: Return to Jace
english.objectives: Return to Jace Darkweaver.
english.description: That crystallized soul should power your communicator long enough to reach your allies.$B$BI must urge you to be cautious, $n. If that device is of Legion origin, then you never know who among its creators might overhear your message.$B$BI'm sure your allies eagerly await your return.

text.title: 取得联系
text.objectives: 启动军团联络器并获取食魂者阿莱利的报告。
text.description: <杰斯看了看灵魂结晶。>$B$B没错，这非常有用。释放其中的能量以启动联络器——联络器应该早已设置好，可以用来联系阿莱利和她的队伍。$B$B如果凯丽娅在那里的话，我们一定会找到她，让她为自己的所作所为赎罪。

english.title: Establishing a Connection
english.objectives: Activate the Legion Communicator and receive Allari the Souleater's report.
english.description: <Jace glances at the crystallized soul.>$B$BYes, that will do nicely. Release its energy to activate the communicator - it should already be configured to contact Allari and her forces.$B$BIf Caria is out there, we will find her, and we will make her suffer for her transgressions.

text.title: 面具之下
text.objectives: 乔装打扮后与$3oa名假面狂欢者谈一谈，然后去找莉莉丝·月郡。
text.description:
许多夜之子把打垮大魔导师的希望寄托在塔莉萨身上。自从她消失以后，反对的声音逐渐消沉。

我们必须谨慎地在民众中散布消息。在这件事情上，莉莉丝·月郡是一个完美的盟友。她是社会名流，拥有庞大的关系网，而且她不是燃烧军团的朋友。

莉莉丝常会在自己的庄园举办化装舞会。在那里，谣言既是流通的货币，也是可以利用的武器。

我们这就去登门造访。

english.title: The Masks We Wear
english.objectives: Speak with $3oa Masqued Revelers while in costume, then speak with Ly'leth Lunastre.
english.description:
Many nightborne had pinned their hopes on Thalyssra deposing the Grand Magistrix. Since she disappeared, dissenting voices have grown silent.

We must spread the word, discreetly, among the populace. Ly'leth Lunastre will be a perfect ally in this. She is a socialite with many connections, and she is no friend of the Legion.

Ly'leth hosts a masquerade party at her estate where rumors are traded like coin - and brandished like daggers.

Let us invite ourselves in.

text.title: 铁拳
text.objectives: 在风暴峡湾的蔑魔战争营地与安古斯·铁拳谈一谈。
text.description: 是时候前往勇者之门执行救援任务了，$n。$B$B我会立刻准备好我们的部队，把他们派出去。我们需要一支可观的部队才能对抗风暴峡湾的军团。$B$B大宗师，您准备好后可以立刻出发。我会派我们的部队与您在战场上会合。

english.title: The Iron Fist
english.objectives: Speak to Angus Ironfist at Tideskorn Warcamp in Stormheim.
english.description: It's time to send a rescue operation to the Gates of Valor, $n.$B$BI will prepare our troops and send them at once. We will need a sizable army to take on the massive Legion force in Stormheim.$B$BGrandmaster, go ahead whenever you are ready. I will send our forces to meet you in the field.

text.title: 剑术大师
text.objectives: 从达瓦克斯身上取得钥匙，然后救出赛莱拉·影心。
text.description: 坏消息——我们没时间等援军过来！他们现在就要献祭俘虏了！多浪费一分钟，他们就多夺走一条人命！$B$B最重要的是，我的朋友赛莱拉就被关在对面的营地里。$B$B我们必须把她救出来——她是一名非常有价值的盟友。$B$B立刻行动，快！快！快！

english.title: The Master of Swords
english.objectives: Collect Dravax's Key from Dravax, then free Sylara Shadowheart.
english.description: I got bad news fer ya - we don't have time to wait for reinforcements. They're sacrificin' prisoners now! Every minute we wait here jabberin' is another life on the line!$B$BFirst things first, my friend Sylara is being held captive in the camp just across the road.$B$BWe need ta free her - she'll be a valuable ally.$B$BWe've got ta move move move!

text.title: 扭转局势
text.objectives: 在勇者之门消灭16个军团防御者。
text.description: <赛莱拉用坚毅的目光凝视着你。>$B$B我们的朋友身处险境。我们必须拯救他们。消灭任何挡道的军团恶魔。

english.title: Quelling the Tide
english.objectives: Kill 16 Legion defenders at the Gate of Valor.
english.description: <Sylara looks at you with determined eyes.>$B$BOur friends are in danger. We will save them. Kill any Legion in the way.

text.title: 一个也不能少
text.objectives: 救出6个受折磨的俘虏。
text.description: 大部分俘虏被关在勇者之门的主营地里。$B$B我们战败后遭到了酷刑折磨，如果不把其他人救出来的话，他们还将面临更加悲惨的命运。$B$B找到营地里的牢笼，救出尽可能多的武僧。$B$B我会与你并肩作战，把恶魔打个落花流水！

english.title: No Monk Left Behind
english.objectives: Free 6 Tortured Prisoners.
english.description: Most of the prisoners are being held in the main camp at the Gates of Valor.$B$BOur people have been beaten and tortured, and worse still awaits for them if we don't save them.$B$BFind the cages within the main camp and free as many monks as you can find.$B$BI'll be right beside you, knocking heads and taking names!

text.title: 阴差阳错
text.objectives: 取得风暴蜜酒，然后救出希罗。
text.description: 我想请你帮个忙，$n。我的好朋友希罗还在主营地里面。$B$B问题是，勇者之门聚集了我所见过最巨大、邪恶又可怕的军团恶魔。如果我们贸然前往，恐怕只会丢掉小命。$B$B不过，我看到维库人会饮用一种叫做风暴蜜酒的特殊饮料。那是一种战斗饮料，可以让他们变得更加高大威猛。$B$B我们去偷些那种饮料，然后冲进去把希罗救出来！

english.title: Zero to Hiro
english.objectives: Steal a Storm Brew, then save Hiro.
english.description: I have a favor to ask of you, $n. My good friend Hiro is still somewhere inside the main camp.$B$BOnly problem is, the Gates of Valor are swarming with the biggest, baddest, nastiest Legion creatures I've ever seen. If we walk in there, we'll just get slaughtered.$B$BBut I've seen these vrykul chugging some kind of special brew called Storm Brew. It's some kind of combat tonic that makes them bigger and stronger.$B$BLet's steal some of that drink, then storm in to save Hiro!

text.title: 为胜利添砖加瓦
text.objectives: 回迷踪岛找金刚不坏彭戍。
text.description: 那个武僧得救了，而且我们在那个艾瑞达女士的边上放了些荆棘。$B$B我要和我的朋友们一起回去了，但愿我晚上能睡在床上。$B$B我们回迷踪岛吧。我这辈子还是第一次因为看见海龟而这么激动。

english.title: Brick By Brick
english.objectives: Return to Iron-Body Ponshu on the Wandering Isle.
english.description: Da monks be free, and we put a thorn in dat eredar lady's side.$B$BI'm back wit my friends, and lookin' forward to sleepin' in a bed tonight.$B$BLet's go back ta da Wanderin' Isle. I've never been so excited ta see a turtle in my life.

text.title: 只有宠物可以预防森林火灾

english.title: Only Pets Can Prevent Forest Fires

text.title: 大仇必报
text.objectives: 从凯丽娅·邪魂的手中夺走奥达奇战刃。
text.description: 凯丽娅身处燃烧军团领地的中心——如果我们全力攻击，他们会立刻发现我们的踪迹。$B$B我们绝不能失败。$B$B不过，如果你只身潜入的话，就不需要跟军团正面交锋，从而争取到足够的时间。$B$B记住，$n，这不是救援行动。奥达奇战刃的力量或许可以扭转战局，如有必要，就让阿莱利和她的部队牺牲吧。

english.title: Vengeance Will Be Ours
english.objectives: Take the Aldrachi Warblades from Caria Felsoul.
english.description: Caria lies in the very heart of Legion territory - they'll see our forces immediately if we try to launch an all-out attack.$B$BFailure is not an option.$B$BHowever, if you go alone you might be able to slip by unnoticed long enough to avoid the brunt of the Legion army.$B$BRemember, $n - this is not a rescue mission. The power of the Aldrachi Warblades could tip the scales of this war in our favor; Allari and her men are expendable if need be.

text.title: 奈萨里奥的巢穴：瘟疫蝙蝠
Talked to Tyrande to Start Events

english.title: Talked to Tyrande to Start Events

text.title: 月郡女士
text.objectives: 在大步道上找到莉莉丝。
text.description:
我们的朋友莉莉丝联系了我。她希望你能在大步道的顶端与她会面，因为那里可以俯瞰整座城市。

准备好你的伪装以防万一，$n。

english.title: Lady Lunastre
english.objectives: Seek out Ly'leth at the Grand Promenade.
english.description:
Our friend Ly'leth contacted me. She requested that you meet her atop the Grand Promenade as it overlooks the city.

Have your disguise ready just in case, $n.

text.title: 贡多拉船娘
text.objectives: 接触贡多拉船娘。
text.description:
我需要你的帮助。

你慷慨大方地把那些酒分给了需要帮助的人，但那已经是我最后的珍藏了。没有酒的话，这些人可能就会屈服于他们的渴求，并最终成为枯法者。

长期以来，我都致力于阻止此事的发生。

有一个叫做德琳的女人，她除了经营船业之外，还经营着递送业务。

找到她，告诉她你是我的信使，然后在她下一次进货时给予帮助。

english.title: The Gondolier
english.objectives: Make contact with the Gondolier.
english.description:
I need your help.

The wine you so graciously distributed to the needy was the last of my reserves. Without more, these people here will risk succumbing to their thirst, and eventually becoming withered.

I am dedicated to preventing this for as long as possible.

There is a woman by the name of Deline who owns and operates a small delivery service out of her gondola.

Find her, identify yourself as my messenger, and offer your aid in acquiring the next shipment.

text.title: Den of Shadows
text.objectives: Make contact with Arluin Shadowblade.
text.description: Placeholder: Thalyssra sends you to find Arluin Shadowblade, a deft assassin once in her employ/social circle. (whichever fits) Indicate that he would be an invaluable asset to making progress in the City with covert operations.

english.title: Den of Shadows
english.objectives: Make contact with Arluin Shadowblade.
english.description: Placeholder: Thalyssra sends you to find Arluin Shadowblade, a deft assassin once in her employ/social circle. (whichever fits) Indicate that he would be an invaluable asset to making progress in the City with covert operations.

text.title: 火焰联盟
text.objectives: 在艾泽拉斯之心与预言者努波顿谈一谈。
text.description: 我的敌人已经死了，火焰之地再也没人敢反抗我的统治！$b$b按照约定，我会联合其他的元素领主，共同保卫艾泽拉斯。火焰之地的军队将用烈焰席卷战场，让敌人横尸遍野！$b$b去吧，凡人。告诉大地之环，火焰之地将与你们并肩作战！

english.title: Allegiance of Flame
english.objectives: Speak with Farseer Nobundo in The Heart of Azeroth.
english.description: My rivals lay dead and there are none within the Firelands who dare oppose my rule!$b$bAs promised, I will unite with the other Elemental Lords in the defense of Azeroth. The armies of the Firelands will scorch the battlefield with the corpses of our enemies!$b$bGo now, mortal. Tell your Earthen Ring that the Firelord himself stands with you!

text.title: 过去的突破
text.objectives: 制作一件石皮皮革骑甲。
text.description: 我们这就开始制作骑甲，怎么样？

english.title: Dazed of the Past
english.objectives: Construct a Stonehide Leather Barding.
english.description: Let's begin crafting this mount armor, shall we?

text.title: 月之暗面
text.objectives: 在泰兰德向古代月亮井祈祷时保护她。
text.description:
萨维斯曾来过这里，但他的目的地尚不清楚。梦魇遏制了我的意志！

这些难民说前方的废墟里藏有一口古代月亮井。

如果那口井没有被腐化，那么我就可以从中获得所需的集中力。借助艾露恩之光，我们会找到我丈夫的。

立即和我在月亮井碰头，$c。

english.title: Dark Side of the Moon
english.objectives: Protect Tyrande while she holds her vigil at the Ancient Moonwell.
english.description:
Xavius has been this way, but his destination is unclear. The Nightmare smothers my mind!

These refugees tell of an ancient Moonwell hidden in the ruins ahead.

If it is uncorrupted, it will give me the focus I need. By Elune's light, we will find my husband yet.

Meet me at the Moonwell at once, $c.

objectiveDetails.description: 在泰兰德祈祷时保护她
在暗影沼泽与泰兰德见面

text.title: 腐化的牺牲品
text.objectives: 消灭守护者瓦雷索斯。
text.description: 能为老朋友做最后一点事吗？我的老伙伴，瓦雷索斯堕入了梦魇的魔掌。我们曾经并肩为保护这片土地而奋斗。正是他与这片土地的密切联系，才令他在这黑暗的时刻堕落。$b$b正如所有遭受这悲惨命运的人一样，他已无可拯救。$b$b拜托了，$n，送他回归平静吧。
text.completion: My sight fades, but I am glad that he rests.

english.title: Given to Corruption
english.objectives: Slay Keeper Varethos.
english.description: A final favor for an old friend, perhaps? My age-old companion, Varethos, has fallen to the nightmare's torment. We once worked in unison to protect this land. His close ties to the land brought him low in this dark hour.$b$bAs with all who suffer this fate, there is no restoring him.$b$bPlease, $n, bring him peace.
english.completion: My sight fades, but I am glad that he rests.

objectiveDetails.description: 清除上古海滩的纳迦入侵者和玩家

text.title: 宗主的计划
text.objectives: 收集《宗主的日志》的各个部分。
text.description: 暮光之锤的目的永远不会变。他们想要毁灭世界。虽然他们的阴谋层出不穷，但是他们邪恶的企图始终如一。$b$b打败暮光之锤不仅仅意味着在战场上消灭他们这么简单。要取得最终的胜利，我们必须揭露他们的阴谋，并彻底终结他们的恐怖计划。$b$b我们这就开始行动，在营地里搜寻线索以查明他们在这里的真正目的。

english.title: The Master's Plan
english.objectives: Collect the excerpts from The Master's Journal.
english.description: The purpose of the Twilight's Hammer has always been the same. They seek to bring about the end of the world. Their schemes may change, but their wicked purpose remains constant.$b$bDefeating the Twilight's Hammer is not simply a matter of defeating them in battle. If we are to be successful, we will need to uncover their scheme and put an end to whatever terrible plans they have created.$b$bLet us start by searching the encampment for clues as to their true purpose here.

text.title: 释放元素
text.objectives: 把塞拉赞恩的仆从救出暮光深渊。
text.description: 根据《宗主的日志》记载，暮光之锤已经找到利用虚空来征服强大元素的方法。$b$b里面特别提及塞拉赞恩的子嗣被当成了实验体。关于此事，宗主的叙述是真实可信还是夸大其词，我不得而知。不管怎样，我们必须救出这些元素并且阻止这些黑暗的仪式。$b$b看来我们此次的旅程将会更加深入黑暗的深渊……

english.title: Unleashing the Elements
english.objectives: Release the Servants of Therazane from Twilight Depths.
english.description: According to The Master's journal, the Twilight's Hammer has discovered a method of harnessing the void to subjugate even the most powerful of elementals.$b$bThe journal specifically mentioned the children of Therazane as test subjects. Whether The Master was speaking literally or figuratively in this regard, I do not know. Regardless, we need to free these elementals and stop these dark rituals from continuing.$b$bIt appears that our journey here is going to take us deeper into the depths of darkness...

text.title: 俘虏！
text.objectives: 把10个暮光奴隶救出暮光深渊。
text.description: 这里有些被暮光之锤奴役的俘虏，先知$n。$b$b异教徒迫使他们在深渊无休止地采矿，直到油尽灯枯。$b$b我实在无法容忍这种残酷的虐待行为！让我们清出一条通往矿场的血路，救出尽可能多的暮光之锤奴隶，让他们回家与亲人团聚。$b$b暮光之锤必将为他们的罪恶付出代价！

english.title: Held Captive!
english.objectives: Rescue 10 Twilight Slaves from the Twilight Depths.
english.description: There are prisoners here, Farseer $n, that are enslaved by the Twilight's Hammer.$b$bThe cultists work them to death in the depths of the mine.$b$bI cannot abide such cruel mistreatment! Let us clear a path through the mine and rescue any Twilight's Hammer prisoners we find, so that they may return to their homes and families.$b$bThe Twilight's Hammer will pay for their crimes!

text.title: 大地的许诺
text.objectives: 在艾泽拉斯之心与顾问塞维尔谈一谈。
text.description: 深岩之洲感谢你，萨满。$b$b暮光之锤一直觊觎我的领地，但这一次他们造成了史无前例的巨大威胁。$b$b鉴于你对大地元素的帮助，我的军队将与大地之环结盟，共同保卫艾泽拉斯。$b$b虽然我并不喜欢凡人，但我绝不能容忍燃烧军团破坏这个世界。$b$b告诉大地之环，石母塞拉赞恩将与你们并肩作战！

english.title: A Promise of Earth
english.objectives: Speak with Advisor Sevel in the Heart of Azeroth.
english.description: Deepholm thanks you, shaman.$b$bThe Twilight's Hammer has always sought dominion over my kingdom, but this latest threat was far greater than their previous efforts.$b$bFor your service to the elements of earth, I will pledge my armies to the Earthen Ring in the defense of Azeroth.$b$bI have no love for the mortal races, but this world is not the Burning Legion's to destroy.$b$bTell your Earthen Ring that Therazane the Stonemother stands with them!

text.title: 风领主的誓言
text.objectives: 和顾问塞维尔谈一谈。
text.description: 凡人，谢谢你让我重生。不过，只言片语不足以表达我的诚意。$b$b我知道，大地之环致力于消灭燃烧军团。$b$b我会献上我的力量以及天空之墙的军队，共同保卫艾泽拉斯。$b$b等到战争打响，风元素领主将与大地之环并肩作战，对抗燃烧军团。

english.title: Oath of the Windlord
english.objectives: Speak with Advisor Sevel.
english.description: You have my thanks, mortal for bringing about my rebirth. However, thanks alone would not be honorable.$b$bI know that the Earthen Ring seeks to save Azeroth from the Burning Legion.$b$bI will pledge my sword, and the armies of Skywall to the aid of Azeroth.$b$bWhen the time for battle arrives, and the Earthen Ring stands upon the battlefield against the Burning Legion, the Windlord shall stand with you.

text.title: 天禅院的报告
text.objectives: 点击侦察地图，完成“调查天禅院”任务。
text.description: 我们收到了潘达利亚所有寺院的情报，唯独缺少天禅院的。$B$B我们放出飞鸟到天禅院送信，可至今没有得到任何回应。这样音信全无的情况很不正常。$B$B大宗师，我建议立刻派出陈·风暴烈酒勇士，前去调查情况。

english.title: Report from Tian Monastery
english.objectives: Use the Scouting Map and complete the mission, "Investigate Tian Monastery."
english.description: We have heard from all our temples on Pandaria, except for one.$B$BWe dispatched a message by bird to Tian Monastery, but no answer has yet arrived. This silence is quite unusual.$B$BGrandmaster, I recommend that we send our champion, Chen Stormstout, to scout the situation at once.

text.title: 急需帮助
text.objectives: 在笑鹤酒馆与老舒谈一谈。
text.description: 我到这里是来帮助残寺派的。$B$B我的职责是在这附近建立行动的坚固基地。现在，我们有很多伤员急需收治，很多饥民急需食品。这之后，我们还要为建立防御工事发愁。$B$B老舒是我们后勤储备的主管。去旅店里和他谈谈。

english.title: Appropriations
english.objectives: Speak to Lao Shu in The Laughing Crane inn.
english.description: I have come to lend my help to the Order of the Broken Temple.$B$BMy job is to create a solid base of operations around here. Right now, we have wounded to tend and bellies to feed. After this, we can worry about building our defenses.$B$BLao Shu is in charge of our supply inventory. Go and speak with him now in the inn.

text.title: 追踪蔑潮
text.objectives: 使用侦察地图并完成“追踪蔑潮”系列任务。
text.description: 我们派出了斥候去搜索被劫持的盟友，我们的努力终于有所收获。$B$B斥候发现他们被带到了维库人的家乡风暴峡湾，但陌生的环境让斥候的行动十分不便，很有可能会跟丢。$B$B我建议立即派出我们的勇士前去协助追踪。

english.title: Tracking the Tideskorn
english.objectives: Use the Scouting Map and complete the "Tracking the Tideskorn" missions.
english.description: We have sent scouts to search for our kidnapped allies, and our efforts may have finally paid off.$B$BThey've tracked them to the vrykul homeland of Stormheim, but the unfamiliar territory has slowed our progress and we're in danger of losing the trail.$B$BI suggest that we send our champions immediately to assist with the tracking effort.

text.title: 弗蕾亚之泉
text.objectives: 使用侦察地图，完成五个“弗蕾亚之泉”任务。
text.description: 首先，我们需要弗蕾亚之泉的水。$B$B每年一度，夏至来临，太阳照射在至高岭最高峰那白雪皑皑的山巅上。融化的雪水流经峡谷并汇集在一个结晶湖中。$B$B有人说这些水能让人长生不老。要我说，这传说愚蠢之极，但我们确实需要这种稀有而纯净的水来酿造我们的美酒。$B$B我建议我们派出勇士们收集一些样本，而你，其它地方会需要你的。

english.title: Freya's Spring
english.objectives: Use the Scouting Map and complete five "Freya's Spring" missions.
english.description: First, we need water from Freya's Spring.$B$BOnce a year, on the first day of solstice, the sun hits the white-capped summit of the highest peak in Highmountain. The melting snow runs through a ravine and collects in a crystalline pool.$B$BSome say these waters grant eternal youth. Silly stories if you ask me, but we will need this rare, purified water for our brew.$B$BI suggest sending our champions to collect us a sample, for your skills will be needed elsewhere.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成“弗蕾亚之泉”系列任务

text.title: 不朽啤酒花
text.objectives: 和瓦尔莎拉的芙勒瑞斯·星叶谈一谈，并用20张石皮皮革交换一包不朽啤酒花。
text.description: 我们的美酒所需要的啤酒花十分特别，也很难获得。$B$B不朽啤酒花只会在被称为翡翠梦境的地方生长，这意味着我们只能从德鲁伊手上获得这一原料。$B$B我从一个这样的供应商手上买到过这原料，但她可能会要拿一些东西去换。

english.title: Amaranthine Hops
english.objectives: Speak to Fleuris Asterleaf in Val'sharah and trade 20 Stonehide Leather for 1 bag of Amaranthine Hops.
english.description: The hops for our brew must be a very specific, and they will also be hard to acquire.$B$BAmaranthine Hops only grow in the realm known as the Emerald Dream, meaning we can only acquire this ingredient from a druid.$B$BThere is one such supplier from whom I receive this item, but she may ask for something in exchange.

text.title: 大师的遗产
text.objectives: 调查宝石切割大师的墓穴。
text.description: 你在帮杀人凶手和强盗做事。$b$b他想要的设计图？那是魔导师切割工艺，是我丈夫的心血。他为了保护这个秘密惨遭勒斯平的杀害。$b$b因为我们去不了泰安诺，所以我把他葬在城市北边的一个小山洞里。设计的秘密就在图鉴集里，跟他埋在一起。$b$b把设计图拿回来，不要让它落入贼人之手！
text.end: 调查宝石切割大师的墓穴。

english.title: The Master's Legacy
english.objectives: Investigate the Gemcutter's Tomb.
english.description: You work for a murderer and a thief.$b$bThat design he wants? It is called the magistrix cut, and it was perfected by my husband. He was killed by Lespin for his secret.$b$bI had him entombed in a small cave north of the city, for we could not make the trip to Tel'anor. Buried with him is a tome that contains the secrets of the design.$b$bRetrieve the design and keep it out of his hands!

text.title: 光明的前途
text.objectives: 在大步道营救$1oa名夏多雷起义者。
text.description: 我们得马上行动，$n。我必须在攻击开始前尽量多拯救一些同胞。$b$b城里已经有流言说，我们能够保护落难的夜之子，有些人已经不再害怕被流放。$b$b勇士，去一趟大步道吧。寻找愿意加入我们的人，并且告诉他们，逃跑的时机已经到了。

english.title: A Better Future
english.objectives: Rescue $1oa Shal'dorei Insurgents in the Grand Promenade.
english.description: We must move quickly, $n. I must save as many of my people as I can before the attack begins.$b$bWord has gotten out in the city that there is a safe haven with us and some no longer fear exile.$b$bVenture into the Grand Promenade, champion. Find those willing to join us and let them know it is time they made their escape.

text.title: 沉睡者的回归
text.objectives: 回梦境林地找大德鲁巨蹄。
text.description: 大德鲁巨蹄正在盼着任务成功的消息，但恐怕你得自己先回去了。$b$b萨维斯控制了乌索克，我一刻都不得安心。一想起这件事，我就气得发抖！就算找遍艾泽拉斯的每个角落我都要把他救回来！$b$b别担心，我们迟早会再见面的，$n。

english.title: The Dreamer Returns
english.objectives: Return to Arch Druid Greathoof in the Dreamgrove.
english.description: Arch Druid Greathoof will be expecting word on the success of our mission, but I'm afraid I must ask you to return alone.$b$bI can't rest knowing that Xavius has Lord Ursoc in his clutches. Just the thought of it makes me shake with rage! I'll find where he has been taken if I have to search every corner of Azeroth!$b$bOur paths will cross again, $n. Be sure of it.

text.title: 暗影现形
text.objectives: 与你在达拉然的线人交谈，了解阿卡丽·影血的下落。
text.description: 阿卡丽·影血是基尔加丹麾下的刺客，吞噬者之牙便是她的武器。刺杀阿卡丽的行动都有一样的结果……她在我们到达之前就消失无踪。$B$B<瓦莉拉在纸上写了几行字，然后交给你。>$B$B但这次可不一样。我们一直在跟这些线人合作，以寻找阿卡丽的下落，将吞噬者之牙收为己用。$B$B跟这些线人碰碰头，暗号是“暗影现形”。看看他们有什么情报。

english.title: The Shadows Reveal
english.objectives: Speak to your contacts in Dalaran to acquire intel on Akaari Shadowgore's whereabouts.
english.description: The Fangs of the Devourer are wielded by Akaari Shadowgore, one of Kil'Jaeden's personal assassins. Every attempt on her life ends the same... she's gone before we even arrive.$B$B<Valeera scrawls a few lines on a piece of paper, then hands it to you.>$B$BBut not this time. We've been working with these contacts to find Akaari so we can finally take the Fangs for our own purposes.$B$BGo to each contact and tell them "The shadows reveal." See what they know.

text.title: 方法才是关键
text.objectives: 从大法师塞琳德拉那里借一个传送门符文。
text.description: 传送门符文？！瓦尔祖恩以为自己是谁？$B$B<瓦莉拉深深地吸了口气。>$B$B代价是值得的，不过那些符文可不容易弄到手。除非……$B$B肯瑞托的传送门大师，大法师塞琳德拉在城中央有一间书房。我们潜行者在那里不太受欢迎。何况就算能进去，她也不可能轻易交出符文……$B$B<瓦莉拉意味深长地一笑。>$B$B不过，谁说我们要问她的意见了？

english.title: A Matter of Finesse
english.objectives: Borrow a Rune of Portals from Archmage Celindra.
english.description: A rune of portals?! Who does Val'zuun think he is?$B$B<Valeera takes a deep breath.>$B$BIt's worth the price, but those runes aren't exactly easy to come by. Unless...$B$BArchmage Celindra, the Kirin Tor's portal master, has a study in the center of town. We rogues aren't particularly welcome there, nor would she simply hand a rune over even if we were...$B$B<Valeera smirks.>$B$BBut who said anything about asking?

objectiveDetails.description: 与大法师塞琳德拉交手

text.title: 接近了
text.objectives: 在魔术旅馆中对战阿卡丽·影血。
text.description: 魔术旅馆离这儿不远。我们在附近的人手可以拿下那个地方。$B$B准备好一场恶战。阿卡丽可没那么容易对付。

english.title: Closing In
english.objectives: Confront Akaari Shadowgore in the Legerdemain Lounge.
english.description: The Legerdemain Lounge isn't far from here. We have agents nearby who can secure the area.$B$BCome prepared for a fight. Akaari won't go down easily.

text.title: 叛徒！
text.objectives: 在下水道阶梯与瓦莉拉·萨古纳尔碰头。
text.description: 那个满口谎言的恶魔渣滓！我早该料到的。$B$B是该让瓦尔祖恩瞧瞧惹了无冕者会是什么下场。

english.title: Traitor!
english.objectives: Join Valeera Sanguinar in the Underbelly Descent.
english.description: That lying demon SCUM! I should have known.$B$BLet's show Val'zuun what happens to people who dare cross the Uncrowned.

text.title: 吞噬者之牙
text.objectives: 从阿卡丽·影血身上获得吞噬者之牙。
text.description: 假如你愿意饶了我，我可以用你的传送门符文打开一道传送门，带你去阿卡丽在扭曲虚空中的城堡。$B$B当然，在她的地盘杀死燃烧军团的刺客大师可不是一件容易的事，但是吞噬者之牙绝对值得你冒这个险，不是吗？$B$B<瓦尔祖恩露出了笑脸。>$B$B等你抵达后，我会成为你在城堡里的向导，但你需要独力击败阿卡丽。

english.title: Fangs of the Devourer
english.objectives: Obtain the Fangs of the Devourer from Akaari Shadowgore.
english.description: If you spare me I can use the rune of portals you provided to open a gateway to Akaari's citadel in the Twisting Nether.$B$BOf course, killing the Legion's master assassin in her own domain will be no simple feat, but surely the Fangs of the Devourer are worth the risk, no?$B$B<Val'zuun smiles.>$B$BI will guide you through the citadel once you arrive, but you will have to defeat Akaari on your own.

text.title: 诅咒烙印
text.objectives: 获得余烬之痕，诅咒烙印。
text.description: 我需要一个可以宣示炎魔领主统治的象征——一把让反抗我的人闻风丧胆的武器！$b$b在烬网巢穴深处，有一把诞生于火焰之地中心的上古长矛：余烬之痕。它是一把具有生命的武器，其威力超乎凡人的想象。$b$b证明你的实力，以我的名义取得余烬之痕！如果你能活着回来，或许我就会帮助你们这些可悲的凡人对抗燃烧军团。

english.title: The Brand of Damnation
english.objectives: Retrieve Emberscar, Brand of Damnation.
english.description: I require a symbol of my dominion as Firelord. A weapon that will strike fear into the hearts of all who dare to oppose my rule!$b$bDeep within the den of the Cinderweb, there is an ancient spear born from within the heart of the Firelands. Emberscar is a living weapon whose wicked power is beyond mortal comprehension.$b$bProve your strength and claim Emberscar in my name! If you survive, perhaps I will aid the feeble races of humanity against the Burning Legion.

objectiveDetails.description: 飞往贝丝缇拉克的巢穴

text.title: 战斗训练
text.objectives: 占位符
text.description: 占位符

english.title: Combat Training
english.objectives: [PH] Log Description
english.description: [PH] Description

text.title: 玄牛派田吉
text.objectives: 使用侦察地图，并完成任务“田吉需要帮助”。
text.description: 你好，大宗师。我旁边的就是侦察地图。你可以用它调遣我们的盟友，完成破碎群岛各地的重要任务。$b$b我们的第一个任务十分重要。田吉是非常有名的玄牛派武术训练师，她在前往破碎群岛的路上遭到了攻击。$B$B我建议派出陈·风暴烈酒去帮她一把。他说这个任务的最佳人选。

english.title: Tianji of the Ox
english.objectives: Use the Scouting Map and complete the mission, "Tianji Needs Help".
english.description: Greetings, Grandmaster. Beside me is the Scouting Map. From it, you can direct our allies to carry out vital assignments across the Broken Isles.$B$BThe first task is critical. Tianji, a renowned trainer in the ox school style of martial combat, was on her way to the Broken Isles when she was attacked.$B$BI suggest we send Chen Stormstout to help her. He will be uniquely suited to this task.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成“田吉需要帮助”任务

text.title: 组建部队
text.objectives: 与征募官田吉交谈，训练一名玄牛弟子。
text.description: 征募官田吉是一位精通玄牛派技艺的著名武僧，她的天赋让我们的勇士如虎添翼。$B$B她的酿酒手艺非常有名，对我们的教派十分重要。她已经开始训练一批新的弟子。$B$B现在，去跟她谈谈并训练一名玄牛弟子。

english.title: Building Our Troops
english.objectives: Speak to Recruiter Tianji and train an Ox Initiate.
english.description: Our champions acquired the talents of Recruiter Tianji, a famed monk skilled in the school of the ox.$B$BShe is known for her brewmaster techniques, and is a valuable addition to the temple. She is already beginning to train a new batch of pupils.$B$BSpeak to her now and train an initiate of the ox.

text.title: Cry More Thunder!
text.objectives: Fly with Vethir and kill 150 of the God-King's allies in Hrydshal.
text.description:
You have proven yourself an ally of the Thorignir and we will lend you our strength. I would ask one last favor of our new champion, though. 

The dragon who guided you to me awaits his vengeance against the vrykul. Together I wish for you to show these Drekirjar what it means to cross the Thorignir. Their toll must be paid in blood.

Speak to Vethir when you are ready.

english.title: Cry More Thunder!
english.objectives: Fly with Vethir and kill 150 of the God-King's allies in Hrydshal.
english.description:
You have proven yourself an ally of the Thorignir and we will lend you our strength. I would ask one last favor of our new champion, though. 

The dragon who guided you to me awaits his vengeance against the vrykul. Together I wish for you to show these Drekirjar what it means to cross the Thorignir. Their toll must be paid in blood.

Speak to Vethir when you are ready.

text.title: 守备官的请求
text.objectives: 在达拉然的急救中心：急你所急门口与守备官波鲁斯碰面。
text.description: 守备官波鲁斯从达拉然发来了援助请求。$b$b守备官找到一名从燃烧军团手中逃脱的士兵！他身受重伤，但是所有的医疗手段都无法缓解他的伤势。这种事通常会交由助祭处理，不过他在呓语中提到了图雷！我一直以为这颗神圣的瑰宝已经遗失！$b$b圣光让你无比强大，或许你可以做到别人做不到的事情。$b$b如有需要，拉瑞修士可以提供飞行工具带你前往达拉然。

english.title: The Vindicator's Plea
english.objectives: Meet with Vindicator Boros in front of First to Your Aid in Dalaran.
english.description: I've obtained a request from Vindicator Boros in Dalaran asking for our help.$b$bHe has recovered a soldier who escaped from the Legion! He was injured and his wounds are resisting every healing treatment available to them. Normally this would fall to an acolyte to handle, but the soldier mentioned T'uure in his delirium! I thought the holy gem was lost!$b$bYou are strong with the Light, perhaps you can succeed where they can't?$b$bIf you need it, Brother Larry can provide you with a flight to Dalaran.

text.title: 黑鸦堡垒的财物
text.objectives: 把守望者玺戒带给加洛德·影歌。
text.description: 箱子里有各种小玩意，里面藏着一枚刻有独特纹章的玺戒。$B$B这枚戒指由一种坚不可摧的银质金属打造，但是由于主人常年佩戴，加上不经意的扭动和摩擦而留下了痕迹。

english.title: Black Rook Holdings
english.objectives: Take the Warden's Signet to Jarod Shadowsong.
english.description: Inside the chest, hidden amongst various knickknacks, is a signet engraved with a unique crest.$B$BThe band, made from a silvery, unbreakable metal, has been worn down by time, as if absently twisted and rubbed against its owner's finger.

text.title: 援助请求
text.objectives: 治疗防御者巴伦姆的伤势。
text.description: 在破碎海滩的悲剧发生后，我还以为防御者巴伦姆已经永远地离开了我们，天知道有多少像他这样的勇士失去了生命。$b$b当我发现他还活着时我着实吃了一惊。是我们的巡逻队把他带回来的，他们发现他浮在海面上。一般的德莱尼受了这么重的伤早就死了。$b$b现在的问题是我们所做的任何治疗措施都无法治愈他的伤口。拜托了，$c，同为圣光的战友，我请求你尽力救治他。

english.title: House Call
english.objectives: Treat the wounds of Defender Barrem.
english.description: I thought Barrem was lost to us after the tragedy at Broken Shore, light knows we lost far too many good soldiers just like him there.$b$bI was shocked to see he was still alive when one of our patrols arrived carrying him. They found him floating in the sea with wounds that would kill any lesser Draenei.$b$bThere is something about those wounds that resists everything we've done to treat them. Please, $c, as a brother in the light I ask you to do all that you can to help him to recover.

text.title: 脱离黑暗
text.objectives: 前往破碎海滩附近的黑石岛，寻找奥萝拉。
text.description: 奥萝拉跟我通过一扇军团传送门逃回了艾泽拉斯，不过我们的好运也到了头。$b$b传送门把我们丢到破碎海滩西边的一座小岛上。他们很快就发现了我们，逼得我们只能跳海自救。我跳下去的时候受了伤。但是奥萝拉……她绊倒了，我眼睁睁看着她被拖回去。$b$b求你救救她！我会在地图上标记他们营地的位置，别让她再遭受那样的折磨了。

english.title: Out of the Darkness
english.objectives: Travel to Darkstone Isle near the Broken Shore and search for Alora.
english.description: Alora and I were were able to escape through one of the Legion's portals back to Azeroth but that's about as far as our luck got us.$b$bThe portal put us on a small isle somewhere to the west of the Broken Shore. They saw us quickly and we made a run for the protection of the water. As I attempted to leap to safety, I was wounded. But Alora... she tripped and I watched them drag her back.$b$bRescue her, please! I'll mark where the camp is on your map, just don't let her go through that ordeal again.

text.title: Traversing the Heavens
text.objectives: Escort Farseer Nobundo through the Vortex Pinnacle.
text.description: If you are not opposed, $n, I would accompany you on your journey through Skywall.$b$bThere are wonders here that my eyes have never before beheld, and it would be my great honor to join you.$b$bOur quest to resurrect the mighty Thunderaan and unite the four great elemental lords will be no easy task.$b$bLead the way, Farseer, and I shall follow.

english.title: Traversing the Heavens
english.objectives: Escort Farseer Nobundo through the Vortex Pinnacle.
english.description: If you are not opposed, $n, I would accompany you on your journey through Skywall.$b$bThere are wonders here that my eyes have never before beheld, and it would be my great honor to join you.$b$bOur quest to resurrect the mighty Thunderaan and unite the four great elemental lords will be no easy task.$b$bLead the way, Farseer, and I shall follow.

text.title: 高烧患者的请求
text.objectives: 将3个野外急救包带到地图上标记的地点。到达之后，治疗发烧的探险者。
text.description: 我一定是出现幻觉了，因为我竟然看到一座巨大的雕像正在跟我说话。$b$b我能把这事写下来也挺好的。还要写点啥呢。帮帮忙？

english.title: Fevered Request
english.objectives: Bring 3 Field Packs to the location marked on your map. Treat the Fevered Explorer when you arrive.
english.description: I must be hallucinating because I swear I can see a giant statue talking to me right now.$b$bIt's a good thing I'm writing this down. And this. And that. Help?

text.title: 同族之血
text.objectives: 击败安纳瑞斯，并带$G他:她;去见莉莉丝·月郡。
text.description: 看到我亲爱的$G弟弟:妹妹;刚才那样，就知道艾利桑德降下屏障的决定让夜之子十分不安。$B$B拥护者和恶魔在街上横行，我们的内心充满了恐惧和猜忌，甚至连家族之间也反目成仇。$B$B我会协助塔莉萨煽动新一波的反抗，不过首先我们必须搞定安纳瑞斯。$B$B我不想手足相残，只要让$G他:她;明白道理就好。$B$B安纳瑞斯应该还在为父亲追悼会的事情不开心。把$G他:她;活捉回来。

english.title: Blood of My Blood
english.objectives: Defeat Anarys Lunastre and deliver $Ghim:her; to Ly'leth Lunastre.
english.description: As my darling $Gbrother:sister; has demonstrated, Elisande's decision to bring down the shield has sown unrest among the nightborne.$B$BLoyalists and demons march together in the streets. Fear and distrust grip our hearts. Family turns against family.$B$BI will help Thalyssra stir a new rebellion, but first we must deal with Anarys.$B$BI do not wish to spill the blood of my blood - only to help $Ghim:her; see reason.$B$BAnarys is likely brooding over our father's memorial. Bring $Ghim:her; to me alive.

objectiveDetails.description: 带安纳瑞斯去见莉莉丝

text.title: 神圣的救赎
text.objectives: 突发的状况打断了你的谈话，处理一下！
text.description: 飞艇向破碎群岛坠落时，我正在上面服役。我一定是晕过去了，我只记得后来自己被摇醒。当时，我身处一片破碎的土地，上方站着一个手持黑暗水晶法杖的堕落者。那根法杖就是图雷，绝对错不了！$b$b我一生之中听过无数关于图雷的故事，据说它周身流动着蕴含治愈能量的光芒。但不知如何，水晶已经被堕落者变得黯淡。我们必须把它夺回来，让它恢复纯净！

english.title: Salvation From On High
english.objectives: Something unexpected has interrupted your discussion, deal with it!
english.description: I was serving aboard the airship that crashed on the way to the Broken Shore. I must have blacked out as the next thing I remember was being jolted awake. I was on a broken land and above me stood a man'ari carrying a staff of darkened crystal. There is no mistaking it, that staff was T'uure!$b$bAll my life I've heard stories about how T'uure flowed with the healing power of the light. Somehow the crystal has been darkened by Man'ari. We must get it back and restore it to its pure form!

objectiveDetails.description: 释放沙拉尼尔的德鲁伊

text.title: 寻找真相
text.objectives: 在达拉然与欧瑞克·图哈特谈一谈。
text.description: 你可能听说过欧瑞克·图哈特。诺森德战役过后，他将自己的时间奉献给了提尔的相关研究。$b$b欧瑞克证实了提尔在很久以前曾铸造过一面强大的盾牌。在烈日行者的帮助下，我们终于有机会找到那面盾。$b$b请立即与他对话。
text.completion: I'm glad yer coming. I've been wanting to pursue this for some time now. With help from the Seers, I think it can be done!

english.title: Seeker of Truth
english.objectives: Speak with Orik Trueheart in Dalaran.
english.description: You may be familiar with Orik Trueheart. He has devoted his time after the Northrend campaign to learning more about Tyr. $b$bOrik has evidence of a powerful shield crafted by Tyr long ago. With the help of the Sunwalkers, we may finally be able to seek it out.$b$bPlease speak to him immediately.
english.completion: I'm glad yer coming. I've been wanting to pursue this for some time now. With help from the Seers, I think it can be done!

objectiveDetails.description: 与欧瑞克以及塔胡交谈

text.title: 艾露尼斯，护法者之杖
text.objectives: 在达拉然的紫罗兰城堡与卡雷见面。
text.description:
艾露尼斯……强大又危险的武器。如果传闻可信，那么艾露尼斯其实是一个古老而强大的奥术实体，被上古魔法融入了法杖之中。

艾露尼斯已经从艾格文手中退役多年，它曾被托付给肯瑞托。而肯瑞托对那种难以驾驭的力量颇为顾虑，便又将它交给蓝龙军团秘密保管。只有蓝龙知道法杖的下落。

蓝龙卡雷现在是达拉然的六人议会的成员，他最有可能帮助我们。

english.title: Aluneth, Greatstaff of the Magna
english.objectives: Meet Kalec at the Violet Citadel in Dalaran.
english.description:
Aluneth... a powerful and dangerous weapon. If tales are to be believed, Aluneth is actually the name of a very old and very powerful arcane entity, somehow bound to a staff through ancient magic.

When Aegwynn relinquished Aluneth many years ago, it was entrusted to Kirin Tor, who, fearing its unbridled power, handed it to the blue dragonflight to secure away in secret. Only they would know exactly where it was taken.

The dragon Kalec may be our best chance. He now resides on the Council of Six.

text.title: 前往诺森德
text.objectives: 在嚎风峡湾的盾牌岭与欧瑞克·图哈特碰头。
text.description: 当然，我已经先打听到了一些消息。我认为这个高沃德就埋在嚎风峡湾的盾牌岭。$b$b塔胡可以帮忙找到墓穴的位置，只要进行一个小小的仪式就可以找到答案！$b$b到嚎风峡湾的盾牌岭和我们碰头，然后我们再进行下一步行动。
text.completion: I trust the journey wasn't too long or hard.$b$bLet's go find our dead adventurer, eh?

english.title: To Northrend
english.objectives: Meet Orik Trueheart on Shield Hill in Howling Fjord.
english.description: Naturally I've done some legwork already. I believe this Gorvold is buried at Shield Hill in the Howling Fjord.$b$bTahu can help locate the grave, and with a short ritual we should have our answers!$b$bMeet us at Shield Hill in the Howling Fjord and we'll move on to the next step.
english.completion: I trust the journey wasn't too long or hard.$b$bLet's go find our dead adventurer, eh?

objectiveDetails.description: 在盾牌岭寻找欧瑞克·图哈特
（可选）使用传送门前往龙眠神殿

text.title: 传记的结局
text.objectives: 从传记里的英雄口中了解故事的结局。
text.description:
你应该读一读这份传记，就在这里。

我们来这是为了和我之前所说的那个维库人的灵魂进行沟通。塔胡·慧风是一位强大的先知，他应该可以把那个灵魂带回人世，而我们则负责让灵魂开口。

你去跟塔胡说一下，我们就可以开始了。
text.completion: I think I already have a lead on that island. Word around the tavern was a great warrior had broken into a vrykul king's tomb on an island in Stormheim.$b$bThat's got to be the one we're looking for!

english.title: The End of the Saga
english.objectives: Get the end of the story from the spirit of the saga hero.
english.description:
Ye should read the saga yerself, it's right here.

We're here to speak to the spirit of that vrykul I spoke of. Tahu Sagewind is a powerful Seer and he should be able to bring his spirit back. It will be up to us to convince him to speak.

You should speak with Tahu so we can get started.
english.completion: I think I already have a lead on that island. Word around the tavern was a great warrior had broken into a vrykul king's tomb on an island in Stormheim.$b$bThat's got to be the one we're looking for!

text.title: 新的威胁
text.objectives: 在碧蓝巨龙圣地寻找与魔枢现状有关的线索。
text.description:
如果你想前往魔枢，一定要多加小心。考达拉最近怪事频频，你最好在出发之前弄清楚情况。

我上次到龙骨荒野时，曾在碧蓝巨龙圣地感受到异常的能量。在魔枢之战中，玛里苟斯的计划与那个地方密不可分，你或许可以在那里找到跟魔枢现状有关的线索。

拿上这块影像水晶。我必须留在达拉然处理肯瑞托的事务，不过我们可以通过水晶保持联系。祝你好运。

english.title: A New Threat
english.objectives: Search the Azure Dragonshrine for clues regarding the current state of the Nexus.
english.description:
If you seek the Nexus, be wary. There are strange happenings in Coldarra, and it would be best to understand them before proceeding.

During my last visit to Dragonblight, I sensed unusual energies from the Azure Dragonshrine. Since this place was integral to Malygos' plans during the Nexus War, whatever is there may explain the current state of the Nexus.

Here, take this image crystal. I must remain in Dalarn on Kirin Tor business, so we will speak through it. Good luck.

objectiveDetails.description: 使用达拉然的传送门前往龙眠神殿（可选）

text.title: 被遗忘的敌人
text.objectives: 在碧蓝巨龙圣地启动虚灵通讯装置。
text.description:
这部装置仍然散发着能量的嗡鸣。它应该是在不久前被弃置的。

旁边的开关似乎可以启动它。

english.title: A Forgotten Enemy
english.objectives: Activate the Ethereal Communication Device at the Azure Dragonshrine.
english.description:
The device still hums with power. It must have been abandoned not long ago.

The nearby switch appears to activate it.

text.title: 巨龙之眼
text.objectives: 在考达拉的关键地点进行侦察。
text.description:
你最好立刻前往北风苔原的考达拉，$n。到那以后，我建议你对一些关键地点进行侦察，然后向我汇报情况。

我很了解那片地区，应该可以给你行动建议。

快去吧！

english.title: Eyes of the Dragon
english.objectives: Scout out the key locations in Coldarra.
english.description:
You should travel at once to Coldarra in Borean Tundra, $n. There, I would recommend you scout out a few key locations and report back to me. 

I know the area well, and should be able to tell you how to proceed.

Make haste!

text.title: 驾驭奥术
text.objectives: 击败奥术畸变体，或者从魔枢地基周围的奥术能量裂隙中吸收能量，从而用不稳定的奥术能量强化自己。
text.description:
艾露尼斯的能量从被弱化的魔枢宝库中喷涌而出。我们或许可以利用这股纯粹的混乱能量。

如果我们能把能量灌入湍流之针，应该可以造成……毁灭性的效果。

english.title: Harnessing the Arcane
english.objectives: Empower yourself with Unstable Arcane Energy by defeating Arcane Aberrants or siphoning from Breaches of Arcane Energy around the foundation of the Nexus.
english.description:
The energy from Aluneth lashes out from within the weakened Nexus Vault.  We may be able to use this raw, chaotic energy to our advantage.

If we can harness this energy and feed it into the Surge Needles, it should cause a rather... destructive reaction.

objectiveDetails.description: 被不稳定的奥术能量所强化

text.title: 释放奥能
text.objectives: 使用累积的不稳定奥术能量摧毁考达拉的湍流之针。
text.description:
你已经具备摧毁湍流之针的力量。

湍流之针破土而出的位置会汇集庞大的虚空能量。将艾露尼斯的能量灌入汇集点，这样就可以造成能量超载从而摧毁上方的湍流之针。

事不宜迟。复仇军可不会坐视你破坏他们的计划。

english.title: Arcane Unleashed
english.objectives: Use your built up Unstable Arcane Energy to destroy the Surge Needles in Coldarra.
english.description:
You have the power you need to destroy the Surge Needles. 

At the location of the breaches where the Surge Needles pierce the ground, there will be a large concentration of void energy. Focus the power of Aluneth into these points. The reaction should cause an overload, destroying the Surge Needle above.

You must act quickly. The Ethereum won't sit idly by as you lay waste to their machinations.

text.title: 魔枢宝库
text.objectives: 击败节点亲王拜拉尔并取得艾露尼斯，护法者之杖。
text.description:
如果复仇军能够抓住艾索雷苟斯，那他们比我想象的还要强大。

虽然我跟艾索雷苟斯说不上和睦，但我们终究血脉相连。既然你想消灭复仇军，取得艾露尼斯，我请求你趁机把我兄弟从他们手里救出来。

湍流之针被摧毁以后，护盾已经消失。魔枢在等待着你，$n。

english.title: The Nexus Vault
english.objectives: Defeat Nexus-Prince Bilaal and claim Aluneth, Greatstaff of the Magna.
english.description:
If the Ethereum managed to capture Azuregos, then they are more powerful than I imagined. 

We have not always seen eye to eye, Azuregos and I, but he is still my kin. Since you seek to put an end to the ethereals and claim Aluneth, I ask that you also free my brother from their grip.

With the Surge Needles destroyed, the shield has dissipated. The Nexus awaits, $n.

text.title: 真理守护者祭坛
text.objectives: 前往盾憩岛并取得真理守护者。
text.description: 我们要直接飞到岛上。我朋友说在我们之前赶到的那个战士没有进入祭坛，而是在寻找某座墓穴。$b$b如果维库英雄没有进入祭坛，我敢打赌，那里仍然有提尔力量的保护。我觉得我们比其他人更有机会。$b$b我的朋友卡托会在那里跟我们碰头。我们可能会需要一位优秀的治疗者！
text.completion: I am heartened that your quest was a success, $n. We have been awaiting your return.

english.title: Shrine of the Truthguard
english.objectives: Go to Shield's Rest in Stormheim and claim the Truthguard.
english.description: We'll be flying straight to the island. My friend said that the warrior who came here before us never entered the shrine itself, since they were after one of the tombs.$b$bIf a vrykul hero couldn't enter the shrine, I bet it's still protected by Tyr's power. I'm thinkin' we have a good shot at this.$b$bMy pal Cato will meet us there. We might be needin' the talents of a good healer!
english.completion: I am heartened that your quest was a success, $n. We have been awaiting your return.

enders.name: 玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯男爵
玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯男爵

objectiveDetails.description: 搭乘银色角鹰兽前往风暴峡湾
在黑鸦堡垒竞技场消灭敌人
Lead the fight against the Legion

text.title: 可怕的增长
text.objectives: 和纳拉雷克斯碰面，种下鞭笞者的种子，观察效果。
text.description: 纳拉雷克斯邀请你过去。他已准备好分析从莎拉达希尔取回的样本了。

english.title: Dire Growth
english.objectives: Meet with Naralex, plant the Lasher Seed, and analyze its effects.
english.description: Naralex asks for you to join him. He is ready to analyze the sample that he brought back from Shaladrassil.

text.title: 梦魇样本
text.objectives: 完成任务“梦魇样本”。
text.description: 关于梦魇，我们还有许多不清楚的地方。$B$B在我们对抗它之前，我们必须得弄清它蔓延的方式。$B$B我们可以将我们的勇士派往瓦尔莎拉的莎拉达希尔根部，然后带一些样本回来研究。

english.title: Sampling the Nightmare
english.objectives: Complete the mission, "Sampling the Nightmare."
english.description: There is still so much that we don't know about the Nightmare.$B$BBefore we can fight it, we must understand how it spreads.$B$BLet us send our champions to the roots of Shaladrassil in Val'sharah, and ask them to bring back samples to study.

text.title: 玛洛恩的庇护所
text.objectives: 在瓦尔莎拉的玛洛恩的庇护所和布罗尔·熊皮对话。
text.description: 我知道了……正如我们一直所担心的那样。翡翠梦魇已经找到了我们的世界。$B$B我们必须呼唤上古半神，玛洛恩。$B$B前往东南边的玛洛恩庇护所神殿。那里有我们德鲁伊保管了数千年的圣物，白鹿半神亲赐的礼物。$B$B我已经派布罗尔·熊皮先去告诉他们你即将动身的消息。

english.title: Malorne's Refuge
english.objectives: Speak to Broll Bearmantle at Malorne's Refuge in Val'sharah.
english.description: I see... it is as we have always feared. The Emerald Nightmare has found our world.$B$BWe must call upon the ancient god, Malorne.$B$BTravel southeast to the shrine at Malorne's Refuge. There, we druids have kept a sacred relic for thousands of years, a gift from the white stag himself.$B$BI already sent Broll Bearmantle ahead to give word of your arrival.

text.title: 梦魇之握
text.objectives: 消灭5个暗魔掠夺者，救出赛兰德拉·林歌并调查玛洛恩祭坛。
text.description: 大多数德鲁伊得以逃脱，但神殿中依旧挤满了敌人。 $B$B神殿领袖赛兰德拉·林歌想要夺回玛洛恩神像，所以并没有跟上来。我们必须回去帮助她。

english.title: Grip of Nightmare
english.objectives: Kill 5 Darkfiend Raiders, rescue Sylendra Gladesong, and examine the Altar of Malorne.
english.description: Most of the druids were able to escape, but the shrine is still swarming with enemies.$B$BThe shrine's leader, Sylendra  Gladesong, stayed behind to recover Malorne's Idol. We must go back and help her.

text.title: 追踪敌人
text.objectives: 使用猎豹形态追踪萨特的痕迹。
text.description: 虽然神像被盗，但我们还有一线希望。$B$B我被困在祭坛的时候，看到萨特掠夺者把圣物带走了。他们的踪迹还很清楚。$B$B凭借我们敏锐的感官，应该可以找出他们的下落。$B$B我们必须跟着他们的痕迹穿越森林，找回神像！

english.title: Tracking the Enemy
english.objectives: Use your Cat Form to follow the satyr's tracks.
english.description: The Idol may be stolen, but there is still hope.$B$BWhile I was trapped at the shrine, I saw the satyr raiders make off with the relic. Their tracks will still be fresh.$B$BWith our heightened senses, we may still be able to pick up their trail.$B$BWe must follow their signs through the forest and recover the Idol!

objectiveDetails.description: 找到第三处萨特的痕迹
找到第二处萨特的痕迹
找到第一处萨特的痕迹

text.title: 荒野神像
text.objectives: 攻击6个暗魔萨特，并从他们口中撬出荒野神像的下落。
text.description: 我们从这个家伙的口中套出了一份情报。他们的领袖将神像带到月爪谷之中，但他的藏身之处却不得而知。$B$B这些萨特肯定知道神像的去向。$B$B去从这些萨特身上取得必要的情报吧，他们的生死不在我们的考虑之中。

english.title: Idol of the Wilds
english.objectives: Attack 6 Darkfiend Satyr and extract information about the Idol of the Wilds.
english.description: We were able to wrest a confession out of this one. We know that their leader took the idol into Moonclaw Vale, but he could be hiding anywhere.$B$BSurely one of these satyrs will know where it was taken.$B$BGet the information out of these satyrs, even if it's the last thing they do.

objectiveDetails.description: 从暗魔萨特身上获取情报

text.title: 集合织梦者
text.objectives: 完成“集合织梦者”系列任务以集结德鲁伊。
text.description: 现在你已经取回了荒野神像，是时候利用它和玛洛恩沟通了。想要成功地完成仪式，我们需要集合众多德鲁伊的力量。$B$B派出你的勇士们去召集组织中的德鲁伊，并让他们在诺达希尔和我们汇合。这个任务需要我们所有人同心协力才能完成。

english.title: Gathering the Dreamweavers
english.objectives: Retrieve druids by completing "Gathering the Dreamweavers" missions.
english.description: Now that you've recovered the Idol of the Wilds, it's time to put it to use to commune with Malorne. However, the ritual will need the combined power of many druids.$B$BSend your champions to gather the druids of our order, and tell them to meet us in Nordrassil. We will need to do this together.

text.title: 通往诺达希尔
text.objectives: 与翡翠梦境之路的大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾交谈。
text.description: 是时候了，我们要使用荒野雕像与玛洛恩沟通。$B$B这项仪式需要大量的能量，因此我们决定聚集在诺达希尔，并吸收世界之树的精华。$B$B别浪费时间了，从翡翠梦境之路过去应该是最快的方法。去吧，我们会跟上你的。

english.title: The Way to Nordrassil
english.objectives: Speak to Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem in the Emerald Dreamway.
english.description: The time has come for us to use the Idol of the Wilds and commune with Malorne.$B$BThe ritual will require a great deal of power, so we have decided to convene at Nordrassil and draw upon the World Tree's essence.$B$BThere is no time to waste. The fastest path will be through the Emerald Dreamway. Go ahead, and we will follow.

enders.name: 大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾
